Activities relating to the conduct of activities that support the operations of Payment Service Providers (PJP) and/or Payment System Infrastructure Operators (PIP) in processing payment transactions. Examples: card printing, payment personalization, provision of data centers and/or disaster recovery centers, provision of terminals, provision of security features for payment instruments and/or payment transactions, provision of contactless transaction support technology, and provision of routing of data supporting payment-transaction processing.
Kelayakan Teknis sebagai produsen dari i: Technical Feasibility as a manufacturer from the competent authority.
Kelompok Ini Mencakup Usaha Pertanian Se: This group covers the farming of other cereals, assorted legumes, and other oilseeds, comprising land preparation, planting, cultivation, harvesting, and post-harvest activities where these form a single integrated activity, for cereal crops other than rice, maize, and wheat, other assorted legume crops, and other farming not yet classified under groups 01111 through 01118.
Kelompok ini kegiatan pembuatan air minu: This group covers the production of drinking water that can be directly consumed, in the form of refill water depots, whether operated manually by people or by automatic tap-water machines. This activity comprises the processing of raw water into drinking water using filtration equipment.
Kelompok ini mencakup\n- aktivitas penge:
This group covers:
- tourism management activities making use of fast-flowing rivers to conduct white-water rafting as the principal activity in a particular area, such as Arung Jeram Sobek Bali and Arung Jeram Arus Liar Citarik, including rafting tubing, river boarding, canoeing, kayaking, and body-rafting experiences.
- management activities to conduct diving, providing the sale, rental, and repair of diving equipment, and organizing diving tour trips on a local, national, and international scale, including activities related to the purpose of safeguarding and maintaining the condition of the marine and coastal environment, as well as other similar activities supporting environmental conservation in a particular area as the principal activity, including snorkeling, free diving, and sea walker activities.
- entertainment and recreation activities related to marina infrastructure;
- the management of water-tourism activities such as windsurfing, parasailing and jet skis, motor boating, sailing, surfing, rafting, traditional/dragon boat racing, boating adventures, sail training adventures, submarine experiences, and flying board as the principal activity in a particular area, which may be complemented by the provision of various types of facilities, including food and beverage services and various other supporting facilities.
Kelompok ini mencakup\n- aktivitas yang:
This group covers:
- activities relating to air and space transport of passengers, animals, or goods not classified elsewhere.
Kelompok ini mencakup\n- kegiatan kebers:
This group covers
- general cleaning of all types of buildings, such as offices, houses or apartments, factories, shops and shopping premises, and institutions;
- general cleaning of other business and professional premises and of multi-unit residential or housing buildings.
This general cleaning mainly comprises interior (indoor) cleaning, although it may also include cleaning of related exterior (outdoor) areas, such as window or corridor cleaning of buildings.
This group does not cover
- specialised cleaning activities, such as cleaning of windows, chimneys, fireplaces/furnaces, stoves, incinerators, and flues or vents, see subgroup 8129.
Kelompok ini mencakup\n- kegiatan pembua:
This group covers
- the manufacture of ready-made garments (confection) from textiles/fabric (woven, knitted or non-woven) by cutting and sewing into ready-to-wear items, such as shirts, trousers, kebaya, blouses, skirts, baby clothing, dance costumes, nightgowns, dressing gowns, pyjamas and sportswear, including the manufacture of disposable textile garments and bra parts such as bra straps and cups;
- the manufacture of ready-made garments (confection) from embroidered fabric and patchwork fabric.
This group does not cover the manufacture of clothing for animals (see group 15122).
Kelompok ini mencakup\n- pembuatan peral:
This group covers
- the manufacture of household electro-thermal appliances, such as electric water heaters for cooking, electric blankets, electric hair-care appliances (dryers, combs, brushes and curlers), electric irons, space heaters, electric ovens, microwave ovens, cookers, hot plates, toasters, coffee and tea makers, fry pans, roasters, electric grills (electric barbecue grills and others), kitchen range hoods, and electric heating resistors.
This group does not cover
- the manufacture of commercial refrigerators and freezers, air conditioners, attic fans, permanent space heaters, commercial ventilation/exhaust fans, commercial cooking equipment, commercial laundry and dry-cleaning equipment, commercial vacuum cleaners and the like for commercial purposes, see division 28.

This group covers
- the manufacture of non-electric household cooking and heating appliances, such as cooking stoves, grills, water heaters, food warmers and plate warmers;
- the manufacture of non-electric space heaters, such as furnaces or fireplaces.
This group does not cover
- the manufacture of commercial refrigerators and freezers, air conditioners, attic fans, permanent space heaters, commercial ventilation/exhaust fans, commercial cooking equipment, commercial laundry and dry-cleaning equipment, commercial vacuum cleaners and the like for commercial purposes, see division 28.
Kelompok ini mencakup\n- penggalangan da: ... including the trading and brokerage of crypto-assets without associated liabilities (not by a monetary authority); ... This group does not cover: ... the trading and brokerage of crypto-assets with associated liabilities, see subclass 6612; ...
Kelompok ini mencakup\n- pengoperasian f:
This group covers
- the operation of charging facilities or stations for electric vehicles such as cars, motorcycles, scooters, and electric bicycles, or public electric-vehicle charging stations (SPKLU) not integrated with a generating facility;
- the operation of charging facilities for electrical equipment, such as mobile phones or laptops.
This group does not cover
- the operation of public electric-vehicle charging stations (SPKLU) integrated with a generating facility, see group 35140.

This group covers
- the operation of generating facilities that produce electricity from renewable energy sources, such as biofuel, hydropower, onshore and offshore wind power, solar photovoltaic power, as well as thermal, geothermal and tidal, wave, and ocean energy.
This group also covers
- the sale of carbon units (carbon credits) carried out by electricity-generating companies.
This group does not cover
- the production of electricity from non-renewable energy sources, see subgroup 3511;
- the production of electricity through the incineration of waste, see subgroup 3821.

This group covers
- the operation of generating facilities that produce electrical energy from non-renewable energy sources derived from fossil fuels, such as natural gas, coal, petroleum, petroleum products, peat, and other fossil fuels.
This group also covers
- the activity of selling carbon units (carbon credits) carried out by electric power generation companies.
This group does not cover
- the production of electricity from non-renewable energy sources that do not produce emissions, see group 35112;
- the production of electricity from renewable energy sources, see subclass 3512;
- the production of electricity through the incineration of waste/refuse, see subclass 3821.

This group covers
- the operation of generating facilities that produce electrical energy from non-renewable, non-emitting energy sources, such as nuclear, hydrogen, and ammonia.
This group also covers
- the sale of carbon units (carbon credits) carried out by electricity-generating companies.
This group does not cover
- the production of electricity from non-renewable, emitting energy sources, see group 35111;
- the production of electricity from renewable energy sources, see subgroup 3512;
- the production of electricity through the incineration of waste, see subgroup 3821.
Kelompok ini mencakup Pengolahan Limbah: This group covers the processing of non-hazardous waste and refuse to produce electricity.
Kelompok ini mencakup Pengolahan Sampah: This group covers the processing of non-hazardous waste to produce bioenergy products and/or renewable fuel oil.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktiivitas sertifi: This group covers professional certification activities for the certification of work/professional competence of human resources for the benefit of partners and their suppliers, such as second-party professional certification activities.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas angkutan: This group covers sea-freight transport activities connecting remote areas as well as areas that are potential but not yet developed and not yet commercially profitable to sail, to areas that are already developed. Pioneer sea-transport activities are established on fixed and regular routes (liner) with vessel deployment to promote the development of remote areas, including the chartering of sea-transport vessels together with their operators.

This group covers sea-transport activities intended to carry goods and/or animals using sailing vessels, traditional motor vessels, and motorized sailing vessels of a certain size between domestic ports and foreign ports, including the chartering of sea-transport vessels together with their operators.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas biro per: This group covers the activities of travel agencies engaged in planning and arranging tour packages, such as nature tourism and sports tourism, encompassing various forms of travel and experiences involving physical activity, competition, or sports-based entertainment; organising and selling tour packages by distributing them through travel agents and/or selling them directly to tourists or consumers; providing tour-guide services related to the tour packages sold, whether online or offline; providing tourist transport services, making reservations for accommodation, meals, convention venues, as well as tickets for arts and cultural events and tourist attractions; and handling travel documents in the form of passports and visas or other equivalent documents.

This group covers the activity of travel agencies that plan and arrange umrah and special hajj pilgrimage travel packages by distributing them through travel agents and/or selling them directly to consumers. This activity covers the provision of services related to the umrah and special hajj pilgrimage packages sold, whether online or offline; the provision of transportation, accommodation and meal services; as well as the handling of travel documents in the form of passports and visas or other equivalent documents.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas dana pas:
This group covers money-market fund activities, e.g. collective investment schemes that raise funds by issuing shares or units to the public, the proceeds of which are invested primarily in short-term assets, e.g. assets with a maturity of one year or less. These units may be regarded as substitutes similar to deposits.
This subclass does not cover
- non-money-market investment fund activities, see subclass 6432.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas fotograf:
This group covers aerial photography activities, including photography by aircraft, unmanned aircraft, and the like.
This group does not cover
- air transport for sightseeing, see subclass 5110.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas jasa int:
This group covers intermediation service activities for the rental and leasing of cars, motorhomes, and trailers, by bringing together clients and service providers for a fee or commission, without the intermediary having to provide the rental and leasing service for the goods being intermediated. This intermediation activity may be carried out on digital as well as non-digital platforms (face-to-face, including door-to-door, telephone, mail, etc.). The fee or commission may be received from either the clients or the rental and leasing service providers. Revenue from intermediation activities may include other revenue sources, such as advertising revenue.
This group also covers reservation services for car rental.
This group does not cover
- the rental and leasing of vehicles or trucks with a driver, see subclass 4922, motorhomes and trailers, see subclass 4923;
- intermediation services for passenger transport, see subclass 5232.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas jasa pen: This group covers ship-management services in the technical field of vessels, comprising maintenance, docking preparation, supply of spare parts, provisioning, crewing, handling of insurance, and handling of maritime vessel certification.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas jasa tek: This group covers other information technology and computer service activities not elsewhere classified, such as computer disaster-recovery services, personal-computer installation/setting-up services, and software installation services. This group also covers other IT support services, such as incident management and digital forensics, except for information-system consulting or planning activities (see subclass 6220).
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas layanan:
This group covers postal-service activities carried out under the universal-service obligation by one or more designated universal-service providers, namely the delivery of certain types of post that the government is obliged to guarantee in order to reach the entire domestic territory, enabling the public to send and/or receive items from one place to another anywhere in the world. The activities carried out involve the use of the universal-service infrastructure, including retail locations, sorting and processing facilities, and delivery routes for collecting and delivering mail. Deliveries may include postal mail, namely letters, postcards, printed documents (newspapers, magazines, advertising material, printed matter in special bags, and so on), small packets, parcels, literature for the blind (cécogrammes), other goods or documents, as well as other services required to support the universal-service obligation.
This group covers
- pick-up, sorting, transport, and delivery (domestic or international) by postal services operating under the universal-service obligation, comprising letters, postcards, printed documents, and small packets (letters containing goods), literature for the blind (cécogrammes), printed matter dispatched in special bags addressed to recipients at the same address, and postal parcels. One or more modes of transport may be used, and these activities may be carried out using own (private) transport or public transport;
- collection of letters and parcels from public letter boxes or from post offices.
This group does not cover
- postal giro, postal savings, and money-order remittance activities, see subclass 6419.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas olahraga: This group covers the activities of sportspeople/athletes acting on their own individual behalf, such as the activities of individual e-sport competitors.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pascapro:
This group covers post-production activities for films, videos, audiovisual works, and television programs, such as editing, cutting, dubbing, titling and credits, closed captioning, animation and special effects, film or tape transfer, and conversion to streaming video formats, including the activities of film studios and specialized animation-film studios that carry out the development and processing of films and the reproduction of films for distribution to cinemas, as well as the activities of documenting/archiving stock footage of films or other moving images managed by the private sector for a fee.
This group also covers
- post-production activities for films, videos, and/or television programs containing sports media content managed by the private sector;
- the censorship of films, videos, and/or television programs carried out by business entities or business actors managed by the private sector as part of the post-production process.

This group covers post-production activities for films, videos, audiovisual works, and television programmes, such as editing, cutting, dubbing, titling and credits, closed captioning, animation and special effects, film or tape transfer, conversion to streaming video formats, including the activities of film studios and special animation-film studios that carry out the development and processing of films and the reproduction of films for distribution to cinemas, as well as the documentation of stock footage of films or other moving images managed by the government on a fee basis.
This group also covers
- post-production activities for films, videos, and/or television programmes containing sports media content managed by the government;
- censorship activities for films, videos, and/or television programmes carried out by business entities or operators managed by the government as part of the post-production process.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pemberia: This group covers the activity of providing primary health services and/or advanced health services by offering outpatient and/or inpatient care organized by the community, whether by individuals or business entities. These activities include primary clinics and main clinics, including the activities of occupational health clinics that provide health services to workers to support occupational health efforts and private health clinics specifically for athletes.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pembiaya:
This group covers the financing of asset purchases on behalf of clients or customers. The capital owner or lessor is the legal owner of the asset, and the client or lessee bears the risk during the period of use, which usually covers the expected useful life of the asset. The client or lessee obtains all the benefits of using the asset.
This subclass also covers
- finance leasing with a purchase option over durable goods, such as vehicles.
This subclass does not cover
- operating leasing (without a purchase option), based on the type of goods leased, see division 77.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pembuata:
This group covers the production or making of moving images, including films, videos, audiovisual works (e.g. 2D animation, 3D animation, stop-motion animation, or a combination of several such animation techniques), television programmes, television advertising spots, television news programmes, vlogs (video blogging), and video podcasts managed by the government on a fee basis.
This group also covers
- the production of sports media content in the form of films, videos, or television programmes managed by the government;
- the production of films for television broadcasting, as well as film-delivery services and film-booking agencies managed by the government.
This group does not cover
- film duplication and reproduction of audio or video recordings onto CDs, DVDs, or other physical media from master copies, see group 18202;
- post-production animation activities, see subclass 5912.

This group covers the creation or production of motion pictures, including films, video, and audiovisual works (for example 2D animation, 3D animation, stop-motion animation, or a combination of several of these animation techniques), television programmes, television commercials, television news programmes, vlogs (video blogging), and video podcasts managed by the private sector on a fee basis.
This group also covers:
- the production of sports media content in the form of films, video, or television programmes managed by the private sector;
- the production of films for television broadcast, as well as film delivery services and film booking agencies managed by the private sector.
This group does not cover:
- the duplication of films and the reproduction of audio or video recordings onto CDs, DVDs, or other physical media from master copies, see group 18202;
- post-production animation activities, see subclass 5912.

This group covers activities for producing original sound master recordings (master recording); sound recording services, including the production of recorded (non-live) radio programmes, audio podcasts, audio for film, television, books, and other media; as well as the conversion of sound recordings into audio streaming formats.
This group does not cover:
- the distribution of motion pictures, including film, video, or audiovisual works and similar products, see groups 59131 and 59132;
- software publishing activities, see division 582.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pemeriks:
This group covers the inspection and aviation-security control of cargo or post to be carried by aircraft, including unmanned aircraft (drones), to meet national and international aviation-security standards, as part of the air supply-chain security system. These activities are usually carried out by entities engaged in cargo agency or shipping.
This group also covers
- security-inspection activities for cargo or post using approved methods such as ionizing-radiation sources (radioactive substances and ionizing-radiation generators), explosive trace detection (ETD), or other internal security procedures, before the goods are handed over to the airline;
- activities of controlling access to restricted areas, monitoring the movement of goods, controlling carrier vehicles, and supervising the process of handing over goods to airlines.
This group does not cover
- inspection and security control of aviation cargo by storage and warehousing providers, see subclass 5210;
- inspection and security control of aviation cargo by post and courier services, see division 53.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pemerint:
This group covers government activities in the operation and preservation of heritage sites resulting from human intervention in the environment, whether in the form of landscapes, parks, buildings, or sites (built cultural heritage or natural heritage) that hold significant value for history, science, and culture, and are deemed to be of significant value for history, science, education, religion, and culture, such as temples, the tombs of saints (wali), and historic mosques.
This group also covers government activities in:
- the operation and preservation of historic sites and buildings;
- the operation and preservation of archaeological sites open to visitors.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pemrogra:
This group covers the programming and/or development of application software based on immersive media, such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and mixed reality (MR). These activities comprise the design of structure and content, as well as the writing, modification (including updates and patches), customization, testing, and technical support of computer program code to create and implement immersive-media-based software. This group also covers the creation or customization of digital content such as three-dimensional visuals (3D visuals), 360-degree video, or modifications thereof specifically for display and operation through immersive media.
This group does not cover consultancy activities and the provision of advice/input regarding software requirements, which are already covered in group 62209.

This group covers the activities of programming and/or developing application software to support electronic trade transactions of goods and/or services over the internet (e-commerce). These activities comprise the design of structure and content, as well as the writing, modification (including updates and patches), customization, testing, and technical support of the computer program code required to create and implement internet trade applications.
This group does not cover consultancy activities and the provision of advice/input regarding software requirements, which are already covered under group 62209.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pencaria: This group covers the activities of gathering, collecting, processing, and disseminating news by the government through the media (whether print or electronic), publishers, or broadcasters, with the aim of conveying it to the public as information.

This group covers the activities of gathering, collecting, processing, and disseminating news by the private sector through the media (whether print or electronic), publishers, or broadcasters, with the aim of conveying it to the public as information.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pendistr:
This group covers the distribution of films, videos, or audiovisual works and similar productions to motion-picture or feature-film cinemas, television networks and stations, and exhibitors, carried out by the government on a fee basis.
This group also covers
- the distribution of films, videos, and television programmes containing sports media content, managed by the government;
- the acquisition of distribution rights to films, videos, audiovisual works, or similar products, managed by the government.

This group covers the distribution of films, videos, or audiovisual works and similar productions to motion-picture or feature-film cinemas, television networks and stations, and exhibitors, carried out by the private sector on a fee basis.
This group also covers
- the distribution of films, videos, and television programmes containing sports media content, managed by the private sector;
- the acquisition of distribution rights to motion pictures, including films, videos, audiovisual works, or similar productions, managed by the private sector.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas peneliti: This group covers systematic (regularly conducted) research and development activities relating to the use of nuclear technology.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penerbit:
This group covers music publishing activities, comprising the acquisition and registration of copyrights for musical compositions; the promotion, licensing, and use of musical compositions in recordings, radio, television, films, live performances, print media, podcasts, and other media; as well as collaboration in the publishing and distribution of sound recordings, whether to wholesalers, retailers, or directly to the public, or through streaming platforms and digital downloads.
This group also covers the publishing of music books and sheet-music books (scores).

This group covers the publishing of online video-game software ready for operation across all operating-system platforms and devices.
This group also covers
- the provision of online video games by the publisher, including in-game and in-app purchase features, for all types of users including subscribing customers;
- intermediation services for the publishing of online video-game software.

This group covers the publishing of other video-game software ready for operation across all operating-system platforms and devices, as well as intermediation services for the publishing of other video-game software, including offline-based video games.

This group covers the issuance of debt securities whose coupon payments and principal repayments are secured by the payment of specific assets or future income streams not yet originated by the issuing unit. This group also covers the securitisation of housing mortgage loans (KPR) by secondary housing finance companies and the securitisation of business loans.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pengangk: This group covers the transport of goods from one province to another using ferry vessels operating on a fixed route.

This group covers the transport of goods on rivers, canals, lakes, swamps, and other inland waters carrying dangerous materials from the place of loading to the place of final unloading, including hazardous and toxic waste, fuel oil, crude oil, refined products, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), liquefied natural gas (LNG), and compressed natural gas (CNG).

This group covers the transport of goods on rivers, canals, lakes, swamps, and other inland waters, where the goods carried may be of more than one type, except for dangerous goods, special goods, or heavy equipment.

This group covers the transport of goods by sea using sea-going vessels between domestic ports and foreign ports, operating on fixed and regular scheduled routes (liner) or on non-fixed and irregular routes (tramper), including the chartering of sea transport together with its operator.

This group covers the transport of general goods by sea using sea-going vessels between domestic ports, operating on fixed and regular scheduled routes (liner) or on non-fixed and irregular routes (tramper), including the chartering of sea transport together with its operator.

This group covers the transport of passengers or goods by sea or along the coast at ports not yet equipped with complete facilities, using port-water transport (rede transport) as a link from the wharf (port) to the vessel or vice versa, from the main vessel to other vessels within port waters or vice versa, or from the wharf or vessel to structures/installations in sea waters or vice versa.

This group covers the transport of passengers from one city to another across regencies/municipalities within a single province, operating on a fixed route.
This group also covers
- transport in regencies/municipalities that share a direct border and are not yet served by intercity or intracity routes;
- pioneer intercity-within-province transport, which typically serves remote, outermost, and underdeveloped areas that are not yet commercially profitable to serve.

This group covers the transport of passengers from one city to another across regencies/municipalities and spanning more than one province, operating on a fixed route.
This group also covers
- pioneer interprovincial intercity transport, which typically serves remote, outermost, and underdeveloped areas that are not yet commercially profitable to serve.
This group covers the transport of passengers from one province to another using ferry vessels operating on a fixed route.

This group covers the transport of passengers from one place to another within a single regency that does not intersect with urban transport routes.
This group does not cover
- intracity passenger transport, see group 49213.
This group covers the transport of passengers using passenger cars bearing special markings and equipped with a taximeter, providing door-to-door service within a limited operating area.
This group covers passenger transport for tourism on rivers, canals, lakes, swamps, and other inland waters, whether for individual, group, family, or social purposes.

This group covers ferry transport across seas, straits, and gulfs between regencies/cities for goods, connecting remote areas as well as areas that are potential but not yet developed and not yet commercially viable to serve, to areas that are already developed, including the leasing of ferry transport together with its operator.

This group covers ferry transport across seas, straits, and gulfs between provinces for goods, connecting remote areas as well as areas that are potential but not yet developed and not yet commercially viable to serve, to areas that are already developed, including the leasing of ferry transport together with its operator.

This group covers ferry transport across seas, straits, and gulfs between regencies/cities for passengers, connecting remote areas as well as areas that are potential but not yet developed and not yet commercially viable to serve, to areas that are already developed, including the leasing of ferry transport together with its operator.

This group covers ferry transport across seas, straits, and bays, between ferry ports in different regencies/cities, acting as a moving bridge connecting two specific points, as a continuation of the road and/or rail network, including the leasing of ferry transport together with its operator.

This group covers ferry transport across seas, straits, and gulfs between ferry ports within a regency/city, acting as a moving bridge connecting two specific points, which is a continuation of the road and/or rail network, including the leasing of ferry transport together with its operator.

This group covers ferry transport across seas, straits, and gulfs between provinces for passengers, connecting remote areas as well as areas that are potential but not yet developed and not yet commercially viable to serve, to areas that are already developed, including the leasing of ferry transport together with its operator.

This group covers other ferry transport across seas, straits, and gulfs not elsewhere classified, acting as a moving bridge connecting two specific points, which is a continuation of the road and/or rail network.
This group covers:
- international ferry transport for goods;
- the leasing of ferry transport together with its operator.

This group covers other ferry transport across seas, straits, and gulfs not elsewhere classified, acting as a moving bridge connecting two specific points, which is a continuation of the road and/or rail network.
This group covers:
- international ferry transport for passengers;
- the leasing of ferry transport together with its operator.

This group covers ferry transport for passengers across seas, straits, and gulfs between ferry ports across regencies/cities, acting as a moving bridge connecting two specific points, which is a continuation of the road and/or rail network, including the leasing of ferry transport together with its operator.

This group covers transport for tourism or recreation at sea, and/or marine tourism.
This group also covers:
- the operation of passenger submersible craft for tourism (sightseeing);
- the leasing of sea transport for tourism (sightseeing) together with its operator.

This group covers the transport of tourists by sea using cruise ships from a domestic port to a foreign port or vice versa.
This group also covers:
- the leasing of sea transport together with its operator.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pengelol: This group covers the management of accommodation with a range of dedicated support facilities for the elderly, operated commercially with professional caregivers (companions for the elderly) and other professional staff, and designed to take into account the diverse activity needs and limitations that the elderly may experience.

This group covers the management of nature reserve areas characterized by the diversity and/or uniqueness of fauna species, where their habitats are managed to ensure their survival; that is, nature reserve areas with distinctive flora, fauna, and ecosystems or particular ecosystems that are protected and whose development proceeds naturally, for example the Pulau Rambut Wildlife Reserve (DKI Jakarta), the Rawa Singkil Wildlife Reserve (Aceh), and the Dataran Tinggi Yang Wildlife Reserve (East Java).
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas pengorga:
This group covers the activities of organizing the shipment or packing of goods in large volumes, by rail transport, land transport, sea transport, or air transport.
This group also covers
- the arrangement and handling of the shipment of goods, whether in groups or individually, on behalf of clients.
This group does not cover
- the packaging or packing of goods carried out by third parties on a fee or contract basis, see subclass 8292.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penjuala:
This group covers the resale of telecommunications services obtained through cooperation with a Telecommunications Service Operator, including the resale of internet access services over networks between subscribers and an Internet Service Provider (ISP) that are not owned or operated by that ISP, such as dial-up internet access, and so on.
In carrying out the activities of this group, the Operator is obliged to guarantee the continuity of service, while the reseller uses the Operator's trademark (with the possibility of adding its own brand), meets the established service quality standards, and books all revenue as the Operator's revenue. Billing is conducted in the name of the Telecommunications Service Operator. For internet protocol-based services, the reseller is obliged to use the public IP addresses and Autonomous System Number belonging to the Telecommunications Service Operator.
This group does not cover:
- the provision of internet access services by telecommunications operators that own and operate their own network infrastructure, see group 61104.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penunjan:
This group covers other transport support activities not elsewhere classified.
This group covers:
- the arrangement or organization of transport operations by rail, road, sea, or air;
- logistics consultancy activities, namely the planning, design, and support services for transport, warehousing, and distribution operations, including the logistics management of sports equipment/gear;
- goods handling operations, such as temporary packaging solely for the purpose of protecting goods during transit, unpacking, sampling, and weighing of goods.
This group does not cover:
- packing services on a fee or contract basis unrelated to transport activities, see subgroup 8292.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penyedia:
This group covers activities providing computing and hosting infrastructure, as well as various other related services that support the activities of managing and distributing data digitally, including the provision of cloud-computing infrastructure, such as Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Platform as a Service (PaaS); the provision of hosting services, such as web hosting, streaming-service hosting (without managing or curating content), and application hosting.
This group also covers the provision of mainframe facilities on a shared basis (time sharing) to clients, the rental of server and network space in data centers (data-center colocation), the electronic storage of data and documents for restricted-access purposes, and other computer data-storage services.
This group does not cover data-processing and data-entry activities at the customer's/client's request, see group 63101.

This group covers the activity of providing food and beverage intermediation services that bring clients together with food and beverage providers in return for a fee or commission, where the intermediary service provider does not supply the food and beverages themselves. This intermediation activity may be carried out through a digital platform or through non-digital channels (face-to-face, telephone, post, etc.). The fee or commission may be received either from the client or from the food and beverage provider. Revenue from intermediation activities is also derived from other sources of income, such as advertising revenue.
This group covers
- restaurant reservation services.
This group does not cover
- the operation of online platforms that allow people to order food delivery services, see subclass 5330.

This group covers the activity of providing food services to customers located in non-fixed/non-permanent structures, whether or not they have the capacity to be moved and assembled/disassembled, as well as those sold itinerantly using motorized or non-motorized vehicles, such as tent stalls, itinerant food vendors with push carts, food trucks, and food stands.

This group covers the provision of digital intermediary services connecting customers with postal and courier service providers.
This group also covers:
- the management of online platforms or portals that facilitate the ordering, tracking, and payment for the delivery of goods and documents by various postal and courier companies, without carrying out the physical delivery directly;
- the operation of online platforms that enable the public to order food delivery.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penyelen: This group covers the provision of consultancy services in the field of cybersecurity, including information-security planning and oversight, security audit or assurance, as well as the development and implementation of information-security systems. This group also covers system testing, vulnerability analysis, data-protection planning, and the formulation of information-security policies and procedures.

This group covers the provision of voice call or voice communication services based on internet protocol (Voice-over Internet Protocol, or VoIP) without owning and operating transmission facilities, including the provision of long-distance direct-dial telephony services and international direct-dial services over the internet network.

This group covers the provision of call services with additional features in the form of user authentication or call management systems that use special access codes and are typically intended for the purpose of controlling usage and for prepaid or managed billing.
This group covers the provision of premium-rate telephone call services connected to premium call agents and/or recorded information using premium-call intelligent network (IN) access codes.

This group covers the provision of content-delivery services transmitted via text messaging (SMS), including premium text messaging (premium SMS), over cellular mobile networks, with payment made through prepaid credit deduction or postpaid billing of subscribers. The content provided may take the form of text, audio, images, animation, or a combination thereof, such as polling services, quizzes, ring-back tones (RBT), subscription-based information, and other interactive services.

This group covers the provision of telecommunications services consisting of the supply of data communication services based on internet protocol and/or other than internet protocol over telecommunications networks and/or foreign satellites that have obtained landing rights, in order to meet various specific needs, with guaranteed connectivity, quality, and security.
This group also includes:
- the provision of data communication types within data communication system services, such as point-to-point communication, remote host communication, server-to-client communication, machine-to-machine communication, and Internet of Things (IoT) communication;
- the provision of data communication system services supporting remote sensing, remote measurement (telemetry), remote control, and remote office services.

This group covers the provision of telecommunications services that deliver converged content services comprising radio, television, video, audio, text, graphics, and data transmitted over networks based on internet protocol (IP), with guaranteed quality of service, security, reliability, and the capability for two-way interactivity between provider and subscriber.

This group covers the provision of telecommunications services that deliver internet traffic routing and forwarding services for other telecommunications service providers so that they can connect to the international internet network (IP Transit), interconnect with fellow Network Access Point (NAP) service providers, and serve as a point for the domestic distribution of internet access (Internet Exchange), as well as the temporary storage (caching) and/or management of the distribution of internet content.

This group covers the provision of telecommunications services that deliver basic telephony services to end users using circuit-switched technology or other technologies, whether over fixed networks, mobile networks, or satellite. These services comprise basic voice communication provided directly to subscribers.

This group covers operation activities including the operation of railway infrastructure, comprising railway tracks, railway stations, and other railway facilities such as signalling, telecommunications, and electrical systems.
This group also covers:
- switching and shunting.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas penyiapa:
This group covers the activities of preparing and providing food on the basis of a contractual agreement with the customer, at a location determined by the customer for a particular event. This group covers the service of providing prepared (ready-to-consume) food carried out through orders for office events, celebrations, parties, seminars, meetings, and the like. Usually, ready-to-serve food is delivered to the workplace, party, seminar, meeting, and the like, together with waitstaff who will serve the guests/seminar or meeting participants while the party, seminar/event is taking place.
This group does not cover
- the production of perishable food types for resale, see group 10750;
- the retail sale of perishable food types, see group 472.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas perancan:
This group covers the design of structure and content, as well as the writing, modification (including updates and patches), customisation, testing, and support of the computer program code required to create and implement software systems and applications not already covered in other groups, including the development of software systems (such as operating systems and middleware), application software for the Internet of Things (IoT), cybersecurity, business needs, finance, databases, graphics, modelling, web pages, and other specialised applications. This group also covers software customisation, such as the modification and configuration of applications to function in accordance with the user's/client's information system environment.
This group does not cover consultancy or planning activities for information systems (see subclass 6220), as well as software customisation activities carried out as an inseparable part of the sale of software (see group 47403).

This group covers the activities of designing the structure and content of, as well as writing, modifying (including updates and patches), customising, testing, and supporting the computer program code required to create and implement artificial intelligence (AI) modules, libraries, or frameworks that are reusable and are not developed for the needs of specific end users, but rather to be used by other developers as components in building and developing AI-based systems or applications.
This group does not cover
- the publishing of artificial intelligence (AI)-based software, see subclass 5829.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas perawata: This group covers other physical health-care and treatment activities besides those covered in groups 86101 through 86105.

This group covers physical health-care and treatment activities that provide comprehensive primary health services and/or advanced (follow-up) health services, organised by the central government (ministries/agencies, the police, or the armed forces) or by regional governments. These activities are classified by service capability into primary clinics (klinik pratama) and main clinics (klinik utama), whether outpatient or inpatient, including special government-run health clinics for athletes.

This group covers health-care and physical-treatment activities, for both outpatient and inpatient (hospitalization) care, carried out by private general hospitals, private maternity hospitals, and private specialized hospitals.

This group covers physical health care and treatment activities, both for outpatient care and inpatient care (hospitalization), carried out by general hospitals, maternity homes, and specialized hospitals (sanatoria, leprosy hospitals) managed by the government.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas perencan: This group covers other specialized design-planning activities not elsewhere classified.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas sertifik: This group covers professional certification activities carried out collectively by industry associations/professional associations to assess and certify the work/professional competence of workers/professionals in their respective industry sectors, such as third-party professional certification activities.

This group covers professional certification activities to assess and certify the work/professional competence of an entity's own employees or students, such as first-party professional certification activities.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas transpor:
This group covers space transport activities for passengers using launch vehicles on all types of routes and launch schedules.
This group also covers
- the renting of space transport with operator for passenger transport purposes.
This group does not cover
- space transport for freight, see group 51203.

This group covers freight transport activities using non-motorised vehicles, such as carts, wagons and pack/draught animals.
This group does not cover
- non-motorised transport for passengers, see group 49297.
This group covers transport activities from one city to another crossing national borders, operating on a fixed route.

This group covers transport activities from one place to another within an urban area bound to a fixed route.
This group does not cover
- urban rail and commuter rail transport for passengers, see group 49211;
- rural passenger transport, see group 49214.

This group covers long-distance (intercity) transport activities for passengers not elsewhere classified.
This group does not cover
- the operation of transport on city-to-airport or city-to-station routes, see group 49212.

This group covers cargo transport activities by aircraft on fixed and regular flight routes and schedules, against payment of certain published tariffs.
This group does not cover
- non-scheduled transport of goods by air, see group 51202;
- the launching of satellites and space vehicles, see group 51203.

This group covers cargo transport activities, including fuel oil, petroleum, refined products, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), liquefied natural gas (LNG) and compressed natural gas (CNG), by aircraft on non-fixed and irregular flight routes and schedules, against payment of a tariff agreed between the air transport service provider and the service user and not published.
This subclass also covers
- the renting of air transport with operator for freight transport purposes.
This group does not cover
- transport of goods by air on fixed routes and schedules, see group 51201;
- the launching of satellites and space vehicles, see group 51203;
- space transport for passengers, see group 51103.

This group covers sea transport activities for passengers connecting remote areas and potential but as-yet-undeveloped areas that are not yet commercially viable to serve, with developed areas. Pioneer (perintis) sea transport activities operating on fixed and regular routes (liner) and the deployment of their vessels to foster the development of remote areas, including the renting of sea transport together with its operator.

This group covers sea transport activities intended to carry goods and/or animals using sailing vessels, traditional motorboats and motorised sailing vessels of a certain size, including the renting of sea transport together with its operator.

This group covers freight/cargo transport activities using launch vehicles on all types of routes and launch schedules.
This group also covers
- the launching of satellites and space vehicles;
- the renting of space transport with operator for freight transport purposes.
This group does not cover
- space transport for passengers, see group 51103.

This group covers passenger transport activities by sea using vessels between domestic ports, whether through sea transport services operating on fixed and regular routes (liner) with a schedule and named ports of call, or on non-fixed and irregular routes (tramper), including the operation of passenger vessels run by the government or other private parties, as well as the renting of sea transport together with its operator.
This group also covers
- domestic community shipping (pelayaran rakyat) sea transport for passengers using sailing vessels, traditional motorboats and motorised sailing vessels of a certain size.

This group covers passenger transport activities with a fixed origin and/or destination, comprising shuttle transport, employee transport, residential-area transport and intermodal feeder transport.
This group also covers
- the operation of school vehicles/buses and employee shuttle vehicles/buses;
- the operation of shuttle buses to/from stations, ports or airports.
This group does not cover
- ambulance transport, see group 86994.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas yang mel:
This group covers activities providing certification of a person's competence based on independent and impartial competency assessment carried out other than by an association.
This group also covers
- independent professional certification activities in the field of sport.
This group does not cover
- professional certification activities by an association, see group 85693.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas yang mem: This group covers activities providing dental health care and treatment services carried out independently by dentists.

This group covers activities providing care and treatment services for specialized diseases, such as eye, ear-nose-throat (ENT), internal medicine, and skin and venereal diseases, carried out independently by specialist physicians.
This group covers activities that provide care and treatment services for general illnesses carried out independently by physicians.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas yang men: This group covers activities that provide a place and facilities for fishing as their main activity, whether in freshwater, such as rivers, estuaries, lakes, beaches, archipelagic waters, and fishing ponds, or in saltwater such as onshore (shallow seas) and offshore (open seas). These activities may be aimed at recreational as well as sporting purposes (sport fishing). This group may also include the provision of recreational fishing guide services as well as other supporting services, such as the provision of food and beverages.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivitas yang uta:
This group covers activities mainly serving beverages, both alcoholic beverages (such as spirits, beer, wine, whisky) and non-alcoholic beverages.
This group also covers:
- beach clubs mainly providing beverages;
- bar activities on board means of transport such as trains or ships, when carried out by separate units.
Kelompok ini mencakup aktivtias pembiaya: This group covers financing activities through equity participation and/or financing for a certain period in order to develop the business of an investee partner or debtor, the management of venture funds, and other business activities carried out on a conventional basis.
Kelompok ini mencakup asuransi jiwa syar: This group covers Sharia life insurance conducted wholly on Sharia principles, comprising risk management on Sharia principles for the purpose of mutual assistance and protection by providing payment based on the death or survival of the participant, or other payment to the participant or another entitled party at a certain time as stipulated in the agreement, the amount of which has been determined and/or is based on the results of fund management.
Kelompok ini mencakup asuransi jiwa yang: This group covers life insurance conducted on a conventional basis, comprising the provision of risk-management services that provide payment to the policyholder, the insured, or another entitled party in the event of the insured's death or survival, or other payment to the policyholder, the insured, or another entitled party at a certain time as stipulated in the agreement, the amount of which has been determined and/or is based on the results of fund management.
Kelompok ini mencakup asuransi umum sela: This group covers general insurance other than life insurance carried out on a conventional basis, comprising the operation of risk-coverage services that provide indemnity to the insured or policyholder for loss, damage, costs incurred, loss of profit, or legal liability towards third parties that the insured or policyholder may suffer as a result of the occurrence of an uncertain event.
Kelompok ini mencakup asuransi umum syar: This group covers Sharia general insurance other than life insurance conducted on Sharia principles, comprising risk management on Sharia principles for the purpose of mutual assistance and protection by providing indemnity to the participant or policyholder for loss, damage, costs incurred, loss of profit, or legal liability to a third party that the participant or policyholder may suffer as a result of the occurrence of an uncertain event.
Kelompok ini mencakup benefisiasi atau p:
This group covers the beneficiation or upgrading of coal in the form of cleaning, sizing, sorting, crushing and compacting coal in order to classify it, improve the quality or calorific value of the coal, or facilitate its transport or storage, carried out separately from the coal-mining process.
This group does not cover coal-mining activities, whether or not accompanied by quality upgrading, see group 05101.
Kelompok ini mencakup berbagai mesin-mes: This group covers various other special-purpose machinery not included in the preceding groups, such as machinery for working soft rubber or plastics or for making products of these materials, such as extruders, moulders, machines for making pneumatic tyres or for retreading tyres, other machinery for making products from special plastics or rubber, machinery for printing and bookbinding and machinery for supporting printing on various materials, three-dimensional (3D) printing machines, machinery for producing tiles, bricks, ceramic adhesives, pipes, graphite electrodes, blackboard chalk, cast-iron moulds and the like, semiconductor-manufacturing machinery, industrial robots performing various special-purpose tasks, machinery for assembling electric and electronic lamps, tubes or bulbs, machinery for producing or hot-working glass or glassware, glass fibre or yarn, and machinery or equipment for isotope separation, equipment for aligning and balancing tyres (except wheel balancers), machines for fitting and removing tyres (including tyres for heavy equipment and defence equipment), centralised lubrication systems, aircraft launching gear, aircraft-carrier catapults and related equipment, automatic bowling-alley equipment (pin-setters), roundabouts, swings, shooting galleries, and other amusement-park or recreational equipment, machines for making briquettes from agricultural products, as well as additive-manufacturing machinery.
Kelompok ini mencakup dana bukan pasar u:
This group covers non-money-market funds, for example collective investment schemes that raise funds by issuing shares or units to the public, the proceeds of which are invested mainly in financial assets other than short-term assets and in non-financial assets (usually real estate). Such units or shares are not close substitutes for deposits.
This subclass does not cover
- money-market fund activities, see subgroup 6431.
Kelompok ini mencakup intermediasi selur:
This group covers the intermediation of all types of accommodation by bringing together clients and service providers in exchange for a fee or a specified commission. This intermediation activity may be carried out on a digital platform or through non-digital channels (telephone, mail, etc.). The fee or commission may be received either from clients or from accommodation providers. Revenue from intermediation activities may include other revenue sources, such as revenue from the sale of advertising space.
This group also covers
- time-share exchange services;
- accommodation booking services.
This group does not cover
- activities that combine accommodation, holidays, and meals, such as travel agencies and tour operators, see subclasses 7911, 7912
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa aktuaria, yai: This group covers actuarial services, namely activities applying mathematical principles to determine or calculate probabilities based on statistical data in compiling or designing various types of life-insurance programmes and in setting premium rates.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa eksplorasi, p:
This group covers services for the exploration, injection, and safe and permanent storage of carbon emissions in geological formations in depleted oil and gas fields, saline aquifers, coal seams, igneous rock (basalt), onshore and subsea. This group also covers support services for carbon storage on a fee or contract basis.
This group does not cover
- the extraction of petroleum using carbon for enhanced oil recovery, see group 06100.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa intermediasi: This group covers intermediation services in the repair and maintenance of computers, personal and household goods, cars and motorcycles by bringing together service users and service providers in return for a reward or commission, without the intermediary providing the service being intermediated. Intermediation activities may be carried out through a digital platform or through non-digital channels (face-to-face, including door-to-door; telephone; mail; and others). The reward or commission may be received from either the user or the provider of the repair service. Income from intermediation activities may also include other sources, such as advertising revenue.

This group covers personal-service intermediation services that bring together clients and service providers for a fee or commission, where the intermediator does not provide the service being intermediated. These intermediation activities may be carried out through digital platforms or through non-digital channels (face-to-face, including door-to-door; telephone; mail). The remuneration or commission may be received from either the client or the personal-service provider. Income from intermediation activities may include other revenue sources, such as advertising income. This group also covers the activities of laundry and dry-cleaning agents.

This group covers intermediation services for medical, dental, and other human-health services, by bringing together clients and service providers for a fee or commission, without the provision of the medical, dental, and other human-health services intermediated by the broker. These intermediation activities may be carried out through digital platforms or non-digital channels (face-to-face, including door-to-door, telephone, mail, etc.), for example telemedicine services. The fee or commission may be received from the client or from the provider of medical, dental and other human-health services. Income from intermediation activities may include other sources of revenue, such as advertising income. This group also covers:
- the booking of appointments for medical visits.
This group does not cover:
- intermediation services for residential-based care activities, see subclass 8791.

This group covers intermediation services for the renting and leasing of tangible goods and non-financial intangible assets, by bringing together clients and service providers for a fee or commission, without the intermediary having to provide the renting and leasing services for the goods being intermediated. These intermediation activities may be carried out on digital as well as non-digital platforms (face-to-face including door-to-door, telephone, mail, etc.). The commission may be received from the client or from the rental service provider. Income from intermediation activities may include other sources of revenue, such as advertising income. This group also covers the provision of intermediation between households offering their goods for rent and households renting the goods, for example lawn mowers, ladders, and bicycles.
This group does not cover:
- units that hold ownership of the tangible goods and/or non-financial intangible assets that are ultimately rented out, see classes 772 and 773;
- the renting and leasing of personal goods, household goods, and other equipment and tangible goods, see classes 772 and 773.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa kehutanan bid: This group covers forestry services in the field of forest-area use without changing the function and designation of the forest area.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa konstruksi un: This group covers construction services for the building, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of geothermal upstream and downstream facilities, such as wells, steam-field facilities, and transmission pipelines.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa konsultasi ke: This group covers consultancy services for geophysical survey, geological survey, seismic survey, and geochemical survey activities
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa penangkapan e:
This group covers carbon-emission capture services from various sources to prevent their release into the atmosphere. This group covers the capture of carbon emissions from industrial sectors such as power plants and manufacturing factories; the capture of carbon emissions through pre-combustion, post-combustion, and oxy-fuel combustion technologies; the direct capture of carbon emissions from ambient air; the separation, compression, and temporary storage of carbon prior to transport.
This group does not cover:
- natural carbon absorption and storage (carbon sequestration), see group 02101.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa pendidikan da: This group covers education and/or training services for pilots and flight instructors.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa pendidikan pe: This group covers privately provided education services for aviation personnel, such as aircraft personnel, airport personnel, air navigation personnel, and aviation security personnel. This group also covers the dedicated transport of flight crew for training purposes.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa penunjang per: This group covers other agricultural support services not yet included in the agricultural support service groups above, such as the provision of irrigation/watering and the supply of agricultural equipment together with its operators, and the maintenance and servicing of agricultural equipment on a fee or contract basis. The dedicated rental of agricultural equipment without its operator is classified under 77305.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa perantara kur: This group covers intermediary services for courses and tutoring by facilitating transactions between clients and training-service providers, whether on a fee or commission basis, without the intermediary-service provider directly delivering the training or tutoring. The intermediary activities may be carried out through digital platforms or through non-digital channels (face-to-face, including door-to-door; telephone; mail; and others). The fee or commission may be received from the client or from the training- or tutoring-service provider. Income from intermediary activities may also include other sources, such as advertising revenue.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa perantaraan d: This group covers intermediation services in specialized construction, bringing together service users and providers in exchange for a fee or commission, where the intermediary does not provide the intermediated service itself. The intermediation activity may be carried out through a digital platform or through non-digital channels (face-to-face, including door-to-door; telephone; mail; and others). The fee or commission may be received from either the user or the provider of specialized construction services. Income from intermediation activities may also include other sources, such as advertising revenue.

This group covers other retail trade intermediary services not elsewhere covered, such as retail trade intermediary services by mail or telephone; the activities of auction houses for third-party goods, whether new or used goods, including auctions through online media; as well as retail car trade agents.
Kelompok ini mencakup jasa reparasi dan: This group covers repair and maintenance services for transport equipment in class 301, such as repair and maintenance services for ships, boats, yachts, vessels or boats for recreation and sports and the like, including repair, maintenance, and modification services for offshore structures.
This group covers repair and maintenance services for locomotives and railway carriages and other rail vehicles (except the rebuilding and conversion industry) in class 302.
Kelompok ini mencakup jenis kegiatan yan: This group covers types of activities located in part or all of a permanent building that sell and serve jamu (herbal tonic) beverages or natural-ingredient medicines to the public at their place of business, whether or not equipped with equipment/facilities for the preparation and storage process. This group also covers the provision of beverage-serving services that serve ready-to-consume jamu beverages prepared at a fixed location that can be moved or assembled and disassembled, usually using a tent, such as jamu stalls.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegaitan pertamban: This group covers the mining and dressing of precious metal ores other than gold and silver ores, such as platinum ores.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan\n- penemp:
This group covers the activities of
- forging, press-forming, and forming of metal, whether steel, iron, or non-ferrous metal, into metal in the form of forgings, pressings, or rolled metal;
- manufacture of metal articles directly from metal powder by heating or pressing processes, such as powder metallurgy.
This group also covers the activities of
- cutting or descaling of metal after the forming process, with no further processing.
This group does not cover
- manufacture of metal powder, see subgroups 2410 and 2420.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan\n- perdag:
This group covers the activities of
- wholesale of products of metal-ore smelting and casting, such as ingots, bars, rods, billets, slabs, matte; wholesale of rolled steel, tubes, pipes, sections, hollow sections, and the like; wholesale of metal powder and metal flakes; wholesale of uninsulated or non-enamelled metal wire;
- wholesale of steel sheet on own account, including cutting operations normally associated with the trade.
This group does not cover the trade of gold bullion, see category L.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan Badan Nas: This group covers the activities of the National Disaster Management Agency and government bodies in the field of firefighting and fire prevention, such as the administration and operation of general and specialized fire brigades for fire prevention, firefighting, rescue of people and animals, assistance in national disasters, floods and road accidents, and the provision of assistance for domestic emergencies, such as restoring order after a disaster.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan administr: This group covers the administration of financial markets, commodity futures markets, and similar markets not elsewhere classified.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan advisori: This group covers investment advisory activities carried out by individuals or companies, namely providing advice to other parties regarding the sale or purchase of securities for a service fee.

This group covers the activities of commodity futures trading advisory, namely advising others on the buying and selling of commodities under futures contracts, sharia derivative contracts, and/or other derivative contracts in exchange for a fee, including for parties acting as futures advisory representatives.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan agen penj:
This group covers the activities of gas sales agents arranging the sale of gaseous fuels through a gas distribution system operated by others.
This group also covers
- the activities of sales agents for the exchange of commodity capacity and distribution for gaseous fuels.
This group does not cover
- storage and distribution or supply of natural gas to users through the main system by the producer (on own account), see class 352;
- intermediation service activities for the transport of gaseous fuels, see subgroup 5231.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan angkutan: This group covers passenger transport activities on rivers, canals, lakes, swamps, and other inland waters on non-fixed and non-scheduled routes and not for tourism purposes.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan badan usa: This group covers the activities of a business entity that operates and provides systems and/or facilities to bring together offers (buy and sell) of other parties' securities for the purpose of trading securities among them.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan bantuan n: This group covers advisory assistance, guidance and operational activities concerning the business and the organizational and management problems of industrial enterprises, including industrial-services consulting, such as strategic and organizational planning; decisions relating to finance; marketing objectives and policies; human resources planning, practices and policies; production scheduling planning and control.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan berbagai: This group covers the activities of making various kinds of ice cream whose main ingredient is milk, including the making of ice-cream premixes, whether in powder or liquid form. This group does not cover the activity of making ices whose main ingredient is not milk, see group 10504.

This group covers the manufacture of various ices whose main ingredient is not milk, such as sorbet, ice lollies, ice drops, ices in various other flavours, ice mambo, ice puter, and premixes for various-flavoured ices.
This group does not cover
- the manufacture of dry ice, see group 20112;
- the manufacture of ice cubes and ice blocks, see group 35302.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan biro perj: This group covers travel agency activities not covered in groups 79121 and 79122, whether online or offline, comprising the provision of transport, accommodation, food, and convention venues, as well as the handling of travel documents in the form of passports and visas or other equivalent documents. Examples of activities in this group are the planning and packaging of components for business travel, such as travel for athletes and sports teams competing at international-level events.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan broker da:
This group covers the activities of brokers and sales agents of electricity through an electric power distribution system operated by others.
This group also covers
- the sale of electricity tokens;
- sales agency activities for the operation of electric power, the exchange of distribution and transmission capacity for electric power.
This group does not cover
- storage and distribution or supply of electric power to users (through the main system) by the producer (on own account), see class 351.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan budi daya: This group covers the farming of local chickens and their crossbreeds to produce pullets, ready-to-slaughter local meat chickens, and table eggs.
This group covers the farming of pure-breed chickens to produce broilers.
This group covers the farming of pure-breed chickens to produce table eggs and others.
This group covers pig farming in the form of fattening to produce ready-to-slaughter pigs, and pig breeding to produce pig breeding stock, semen, and embryos.
This group covers farming in the form of fattening to produce meat goats, and breeding to produce meat-goat breeding stock, semen, and embryos.
This group covers the farming of pigeons to produce meat pigeons or others, and breeding to produce pigeon breeding stock and hatching eggs.
This group covers the farming of quail to produce meat quail, laying quail, and table eggs, and breeding to produce quail breeding stock and hatching eggs.
This group covers the farming of edible ostriches to produce meat ostriches, eggs and others, and breeding to produce ostrich breeding stock or hatching eggs.

This group covers the farming and breeding of swiftlets, including other activities, to produce swiftlets and swiftlet nests. This group does not cover the processing of swiftlet nests, see subgroup 1079.
This group covers the farming and breeding of worms to produce breeding stock, meat, and other products.
This group covers the farming and breeding of other animals, such as guinea pigs, dogs, cats, caterpillars, and crickets, to produce breeding stock, meat, hides, and other products.
This group covers the farming and breeding of rabbits to produce meat, fur, and other products.
This group covers the keeping and breeding of bees to produce products such as honey, beeswax, propolis, and honeycomb, as well as bee-breeding activities.
This group covers the farming and breeding of deer to produce breeding stock, meat, hides, and other products.
This group covers the rearing and breeding of silkworms to produce silkworm cocoons.
This group covers the raising of dairy sheep to produce milk and breeding activities to produce dairy-sheep breeding stock, semen, and embryos.
This group covers the raising of meat sheep through fattening to produce sheep ready for slaughter and breeding activities to produce meat-sheep breeding stock, semen, and embryos.
This group covers the raising of ducks to produce meat ducks, laying ducks, table eggs, and other products, and breeding activities to produce hatching eggs and duck breeding stock.
This group covers the raising of dairy buffalo through fattening and milk production, and breeding activities to produce dairy-buffalo breeding stock, semen, and embryos.
This group covers the raising of meat buffalo through fattening to produce buffalo ready for slaughter and breeding to produce meat-buffalo breeding stock, semen, and embryos.

This group covers the raising of horses to produce horses, such as meat horses, dairy horses, racehorses, riding horses, draught horses, cavalry horses, polo horses, and pet horses, mules, hinnies, and the like; and the breeding of horses and similar animals to produce horse and similar breeding stock, semen, and embryos.
This group also covers the production of milk from horses and similar animals. This group does not cover the operation of stables for racing and equestrian sports, see subgroup 9319.
This group covers the raising of dairy cattle through fattening and milk production, and breeding activities to produce dairy-cattle breeding stock, semen, and embryos.
This group covers the raising of beef cattle through fattening to produce cattle ready for slaughter and breeding activities to produce beef-cattle breeding stock, semen, and embryos.

This group covers the raising of other poultry, such as turkeys, geese, and guinea fowl, to produce meat poultry, laying poultry, and table eggs, and the breeding of such poultry to produce breeding stock or hatching eggs.
This group covers raising activities to produce milk and breeding activities to produce dairy-goat breeding stock, semen, and embryos.

This group covers raising activities to produce meat camels, dairy camels, and similar animals such as llamas, alpacas, vicuñas, and guanacos, and breeding activities to produce camel and similar breeding stock, semen, and embryos. This group also covers the production of milk from camels and similar animals.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan distribus: This group covers the distribution of rupiah currency, the storage of rupiah currency in vaults, the processing of rupiah currency, and/or the replenishment, withdrawal, and/or monitoring of rupiah-currency sufficiency in automated teller machines (ATMs), cash deposit machines (CDMs), cash recycling machines (CRMs), and/or other rupiah cash-transaction machines. This group also covers cooperation activities for the carriage of foreign banknotes into and out of Indonesia's customs area, and the provision and maintenance of automated teller machines (ATMs), cash deposit machines (CDMs), cash recycling machines (CRMs), and/or other rupiah cash-transaction machines.
