Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan ekstrusi:
This group covers the extrusion of non-ferrous metals, whether of circular, square, or other cross-sections, such as aluminium bars, copper bars, aluminium rods, copper rods, and other non-ferrous metal extrusion products. It includes non-ferrous metal extrusion products that function as electrical conductors.
This group does not cover the manufacture of pipes and pipe fittings, see group 24205.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan intermedi: This group covers intermediation activities for the issuance and trading of instruments and the execution of transactions in the money market and foreign exchange market other than through an exchange.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa insp: This group covers technical inspection services and equipment safety examination in oil and gas business activities, as well as Non-Radiation Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) technical testing activities by Oil and Gas Inspection Business Entities.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa inte: This group covers information-technology-based money-lending intermediation services, comprising the provision, management, and operation of financial services to bring together lenders and borrowers for the purpose of entering into conventional lending agreements.

This group covers intermediation services for residential care activities, bringing together clients and service providers for a fee or commission. This intermediation may be carried out through digital platforms or through non-digital channels (face-to-face, including door-to-door, telephone, mail, etc.). Fees or commissions may be received either from clients or from residential-care service providers. Income from intermediation activities may include other revenue sources, such as advertising income.
This group does not cover intermediation services for medical, dental, and other human health services, see subgroup 8691.
This group covers money-lending intermediation services comprising the provision, management, and operation of financial services to bring together lenders and borrowers based on sharia principles.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa kons: This group covers drilling/excavation construction services and the construction of drilled wells/dug groundwater wells.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa lain: This group covers other services directly related to the provision and use of electric power, including electric-energy conservation services, but not covered in groups 35151 to 35152, such as meter-reading and billing services.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa medi: This group covers veterinary medical services in the form of care, examination, treatment, diagnosis, and animal-health consultation for livestock, pets, aquatic animals, and wildlife, managed by a business entity in the form of an animal clinic, animal hospital, animal health centre, animal ambulatory service, as well as animal laboratory and animal shelter accompanied by animal-health services.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa pena: This group covers real estate property valuation (appraisal) services.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa peni: This group covers custody services for financial assets traded in financial markets, such as securities, assets relating to collective investment portfolios, commodity futures contracts, bullion financial assets, and digital financial assets.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa penu: This group covers other agricultural support service activities not elsewhere included in the agricultural support service groups above, such as the operation of irrigation/watering systems and the provision of agricultural equipment together with its operators, as well as the maintenance and servicing of agricultural equipment on a fee or contract basis. This group does not cover the rental of agricultural equipment without an operator; see group 77392.

This group covers other livestock support service activities on a fee or contract basis, such as shearing of livestock, fitting and assignment of livestock identification, cleaning of livestock pens, and also includes grass-cutting/foraging services, the keeping and care of animals, and the grazing of livestock. This group also covers the activities of farriers and animal castration.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa perj: This group covers other travel-tour service activities not yet included in groups 79901 through 79903.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa pram: This group covers the activities of tour-guide services, known as tour guiding, namely business activities encompassing accompaniment and guidance services, including cultural and natural interpretation, and assisting with everything required by tourists, including the activity of coordinating freelance tour guides to meet the needs of individual tourists or the needs of travel agencies.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jasa repa:
This group covers the repair and maintenance of footwear and leather goods, such as shoes, boots, sandals, suitcases and bags, including heel-fitting services.
This group does not cover the activities of shoe shiners, see subclass 9690.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of furniture and home furnishings, such as upholstering, finishing, repairing and restoring furniture and home furnishings, including office furniture and the assembly of self-standing furniture.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of household appliances, such as refrigerators, stoves, washing machines, clothes dryers, air conditioners, electric irons, vacuum cleaners and various other electrical goods and appliances for household use, including the repair and servicing of home and garden equipment, such as lawn mowers, edgers, snow and leaf sweepers, trimmers and the like.
This group does not cover:
- repair and maintenance of power-driven hand tools, see subclass 3312;
- repair and maintenance of central air-conditioning systems, see subclass 4322.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of consumer electronics, such as televisions and radio receivers (including antenna installation), audio and video players, video cameras of the household-user type, and video game devices.

This group covers repair and maintenance services for computers and their peripherals, such as desktop computers, laptops, magnetic disk drives, flash drives, disk drives, printers, monitors, keyboards, mice, joysticks, and trackballs, internal and external computer modems, computer terminals, computer servers, scanners, including bar code scanners, smart card readers, virtual reality helmets, webcams, and computer projectors. This group also covers repair and maintenance services for computer terminals, such as automatic teller machines (ATM) and point of sale (POS) terminals that are not mechanically operated, and handheld computers (PDA).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jual beli: This group covers the buying and selling of commodities under futures contracts, sharia derivative contracts and/or other derivative contracts on the instruction of clients, by collecting a sum of money and/or certain securities as margin to guarantee such transactions, including parties acting as futures broker representatives, the opening of futures brokerage branch offices, the channelling of overseas orders, and participants in the alternative trading system.

This group covers the buying and selling of derivative contracts other than futures contracts and sharia derivative contracts, for and on one's own behalf within the mechanism of the alternative trading system.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan jual dan: This group covers the activities of buying and selling foreign banknotes as well as the purchase of traveller's cheques.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan juri, dan: This group covers the activities of professional judges and referees acting on behalf of individuals.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan kawasan p: This group covers the activities of nature conservation areas intended for the collection of plants and/or wildlife, whether natural or non-natural and whether native or non-native species, in order to operate the provision of nature-tourism facilities within the utilization block, such as Tahura Cut Nyak Dhien (Aceh), Tahura Bukit Barisan (North Sumatra), Tahura Juanda (West Java), Tahura Sultan Adam (South Kalimantan), Tahura R. Suryo (East Java), Tahura Ngurah Rai (Bali), and Tahura Bukit Soeharto (East Kalimantan).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan kegiatan:
This group covers real estate intermediation service activities for the purchase, sale, and rental of real estate by bringing together clients and sellers or service providers in order to earn a fee or commission. These real estate intermediation service activities may be carried out on a digital platform or through non-digital channels (face-to-face, including door-to-door, telephone, mail, etc.). The fee or commission may be received from clients or real estate sellers or real estate service providers. Revenue for intermediation activities may include other sources of income, such as income from the sale of advertising space to third parties.
This group covers the provision of real estate activities by real estate agents or independent real estate agents:
- intermediation services in the purchase, sale, and rental of real estate on a fee or contract basis.
This group also covers:
- real estate listing services.

This group covers the activities of sports organizations for persons with disabilities and other sports organizations, regulatory bodies and sports leagues that provide rules of competition/contest and organize periodic, tiered competitions/contests for a number of persons, groups of persons or clubs competing in a sports games event (multi-event) or championship (single-event).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan kelembaga: This group covers the institutional activities of the MPR, DPR and DPRD together with their secretariats, whose principal function is to make fundamental constitutional decisions of a basic and principled nature in formulating government policy. The scope of activities in this group includes the making, amending or repealing of laws or government regulations as well as overseeing the administration of government in implementing government policy and the laws, government regulations and other applicable provisions, including the making, determination and ratification of revenue and expenditure budgets, investment budgets, and long-term plans.

This group covers the institutional activities of government in the field of finance, taxation and customs and excise in supporting the smooth conduct of governmental administration, including their secretariat activities, such as government institutions in the field of finance, the Directorate General of Taxes, and the Directorate General of Customs and Excise.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan kepialang:
This group covers securities and commodity contract brokerage and the activity of transacting in financial markets on behalf of others (acting as a broker) not elsewhere covered, such as bullion trading transactions on behalf of others (brokerage).
This group does not cover the activity of trading in financial markets on one's own behalf, see group 64994.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan khusus pe: This group covers the specialized installation of steel framing as part of the work covered under building construction.

This group covers the specialised work of installing the frame and roof of residential and non-residential buildings as part of the work included in building construction, including guttering and roof painting.
This group covers the specialized erection of scaffolding on buildings, roads/bridges, water structures, docks and the like.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan kliring d: This group covers the clearing and settlement of transactions in financial markets, including the clearing and settlement of securities transactions, commodity contracts, money market and foreign exchange transactions, digital financial assets, and other financial market transactions.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan konstruks: This group covers the activity of constructing prefabricated buildings (produced by other units) at the construction site, namely the installation of factory-produced materials such as precast concrete, steel, plastic, rubber, wood, aluminium, sandwich panels, and other factory-produced products, using fabrication, erection, and/or assembly methods, for buildings.

This group covers the civil construction of nuclear reactors, such as nuclear reactors for energy, nuclear reactors for research and testing, and reactors for the production of radioisotopes and radiopharmaceuticals.

This group covers the civil construction of facilities that use ionizing radiation sources, such as radiotherapy facilities; nuclear medicine facilities; diagnostic and interventional radiology facilities; non-destructive testing facilities; radioisotope and radiopharmaceutical particle accelerator facilities; irradiation facilities; calibration facilities; and radioactive material storage facilities.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan lain yang: This group covers other activities relating to sport not classified in groups 93191 to 93196, such as activities relating to the promotion of sporting activities, the operation of racehorse stables, racing-dog kennels and the like, the activities of individual e-sport participants, the activities of mountain guides, the operation of vertical aerodynamic wind tunnels, and activities relating to the training of animals for sport and entertainment, as well as activities supporting fishing and hunting as a sport or recreation.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan lembaga p: This group covers the activities of government institutions in respect of guidance, development and administration to create efficiency and business not yet covered in groups 84141 through 84148, for example government institutions in the field of administrative reform of the state apparatus and government institutions in the field of cooperatives and micro, small and medium enterprises.

This group covers the activities of government institutions in respect of guidance, development and administration in the field of manpower, for example government institutions in the field of manpower.

This group covers the activities of government institutions in respect of guidance, development and administration in the field of construction, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of public works.

This group covers the activities of government institutions in respect of guidance, development and administration in the field of trade and tourism, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of trade and government institutions in the field of tourism.

This group covers the activities of government institutions in respect of guidance, development and administration in the field of transport, for example government institutions in the field of transport.

This group covers the activities of government institutions in respect of guidance, development and administration in the field of industry, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of industry.

This group covers the activities of government institutions in respect of guidance, development and administration in the field of mining, quarrying, geology and mineral resources and in the field of electricity, gas and water, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of energy and mineral resources.

This group covers the activities of government institutions in respect of guidance, development and administration in the field of agriculture, such as food-crop/plantation-crop agriculture, animal husbandry, forestry, hunting and fisheries, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of agriculture, government institutions in the field of marine affairs and fisheries, and government institutions in the field of forestry.

This group covers the activities of government institutions in the guidance of communication and informatics. Guidance of communication and informatics comprises guidance in the field of postal and informatics resources and devices, the conduct of postal and informatics services, informatics applications, and public information and communication, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of communication and informatics.

This group covers the activities of government bodies in the field of planning, in formulating and coordinating government policy for the conduct of governance, including their secretariat activities, for example government bodies in the field of national development planning (Ministry of National Development Planning/Bappenas).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan lembaga,: This group covers the activities of non-ministerial government institutions, agencies, or bodies with specialized mandates and their secretariats, charged with supporting the smooth conduct of governance, such as the National Archives of the Republic of Indonesia, the National Civil Service Agency, the National Institute of Public Administration, the Ministry of Population and Family Development/BKKBN, the National Research and Innovation Agency, the National Cyber and Crypto Agency, and Statistics Indonesia. This group does not cover disaster management agencies (see group 84234).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan lembaga/b: This group covers the activities of institutions, agencies, or offices of foreign-country missions, other international and regional bodies, international financial and monetary bodies, the World Bank, the World Customs Organization, the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development, the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries, the European Community, the European Free Trade Association, and others, such as missions of the UN and its sub-organizations, UNICEF, UNESCO, UNDP, WHO, ILO, ASEAN, IMF, OECD and OPEC, and others, as well as embassies, consulates, military bases, scientific bases, and others governed by the host country rather than by the country they represent.

This group covers the activities of other government institutions, agencies, or offices with specialized mandates and their secretariats, charged with supporting the smooth conduct of governance, not covered in groups 84111 through 84115, for example non-structural institutions.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan memberika: This group covers the activity of providing consulting and/or intermediation services in the provision of re-guarantees and the handling of claims settlement, acting for and on behalf of the guaranteed party.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan memproduk: This group covers the activity of producing and distributing steam and hot water for heating, power generation, and other uses, such as the production, collection, and distribution of steam and hot water for heating, energy, and other uses, as well as the production and distribution of chilled air. This group also covers the storage of geothermal energy.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan menghasil:
This group covers the activities of producing similar basic household goods; in other words, such household activities are engaged in various activities producing goods for their own needs.
These activities cover hunting and gathering, farming, the provision of shelter and clothing, and other goods produced by the household for its own needs. In practice, if the household is also engaged in the production of marketed goods, it is classified under the corresponding goods-producing industry in accordance with the KBLI.
If it is principally engaged in the production of specific basic goods, it is classified under the corresponding goods-production industry of the KBLI.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan modal ven: This group covers sharia venture capital activities, venture fund management, and other business activities carried out entirely on the basis of sharia principles, comprising financing through equity participation and/or financing for a specified period in connection with the business development of investee partners at the early start-up stage; profit-sharing-based financing; the provision of services; and/or other activities.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan museum ya: This group covers the activities of museums operated by the private sector.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan notaris,: This group covers the activities of notaries and other notarial activities, public notaries, civil-law notaries, and other activities of bailiffs, arbitrators, examiners, and liquidators; included in this group are activities related to land and building sale-and-purchase agreements by land-deed officials (PPAT).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan orang per: This group covers the activities of individuals possessing knowledge and experience in the field of sharia, or business entities whose management and staff possess knowledge and experience in the field of sharia, that provide advice on and/or supervise the implementation of sharia principles in the capital market in a company's business activities and/or issue statements of sharia compliance for sharia products or services in the capital market.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan organisas: This group covers the activities of professional organizations engaged in the field of natural sciences and technology, such as the Institution of Engineers Indonesia (PII) and the Indonesian Surveyors Association (ISI).

This group covers the activities of professional organizations engaged in the field of social sciences and society, such as the All-Indonesia Press Workers Association (HIPSI), the Indonesian Journalists Association (PWI), the Indonesian Medical Association (IDI), the Teachers' Association of the Republic of Indonesia (PGRI), the Indonesian Economists Association (ISEI), the Indonesian Secretaries Association (ISI), and the Indonesian Midwives Association (IBI).

This group covers the activities of organizations engaged in the field of politics and their supporting organizations, such as youth organizations affiliated with political parties. Such organizations are concerned chiefly with influencing decision-making in public government bodies by placing members of, or persons sympathetic to, the party in political bodies, and with the dissemination of information, public relations, fundraising, and the like.

This group covers the activities of organizations engaged in advancing the interests of workers in an organized manner, or trade unions, and the activities of associations whose members are workers advancing the interests of workers with respect to wages and working conditions and collective action through the organization, such as the All-Indonesia Workers' Union (SPSI), the Central Organization of Indonesian Self-Reliant Workers (SOKSI), and the Corps of Civil Servants of the Republic of Indonesia (KORPRI).
This group does not cover:
- educational activities provided by such organizations, see section 85;
- the activities of professional membership organizations, see subgroup 9412.

This group covers the activities of professional, semi-professional, or amateur golf organizations/clubs that give their members the opportunity to take part in sporting activities, whether or not they provide a venue and facilities for the sport.

This group covers the activities of professional, semi-professional, or amateur martial arts organizations/clubs that give their members the opportunity to take part in sporting activities, whether or not they provide premises and facilities for the sport.

This group covers the activities of professional, semi-professional, or amateur bowling organizations/clubs that give their members the opportunity to take part in sporting activities, whether or not they provide premises and facilities for the sport.

This group covers the activities of professional, semi-professional, or amateur fitness organizations/clubs that give their members the opportunity to take part in sporting activities, whether or not they provide the venue and facilities for the sport.

This group covers the activities of professional, semi-professional, or amateur swimming organisations/clubs that give their members the opportunity to take part in sporting activities, whether or not they provide a place and facilities for the sport.

This group covers the activities of professional, semi-professional, or amateur football organizations/clubs that give their members the opportunity to take part in sporting activities, whether or not they provide premises and facilities for the sport.

This group covers the activities of professional, semi-professional, or amateur tennis organizations/clubs that provide their members with the opportunity to take part in sporting activities, whether or not they provide premises and facilities for the sport.

This group covers the activities of professional, semi-professional, or amateur boxing organizations/clubs that give their members the opportunity to take part in sporting activities, whether or not they provide premises and facilities for the sport.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pelatihan: This group covers other job-training activities conducted by enterprises that are not covered in groups 85581 through 85587, including the fields of job-training methodology, Occupational Health and Safety (K3), motivational training, self-development, career development, neuro-linguistic programming, and others, conducted by enterprises.

This group covers other privately organized job training activities not yet covered in groups 85571 to 85578, including education and training for overseas or migrant workers, in the fields of job-training methodology, occupational health and safety (K3), nuclear matters or matters relating to radiation and radioactivity, motivational training, self-development, career development, neuro-linguistic programming, and others organized by the private sector.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at building skills/expertise in the field of business and management, conducted by enterprises. The activities falling under this group include training in secretarial work, office administration, ICT for secretaries, finance, commerce/sales, foreign languages, productivity promotion, consultancy guidance, productivity measurement, productivity-improvement management, entrepreneurship, and others.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at adding skills/expertise in the field of business and management, organised by the private sector. Activities included in this group are training in secretarial work, office administration, ICT for secretary, finance, commerce/sales, foreign languages, productivity promotion, consultancy guidance, productivity measurement, productivity-improvement management, entrepreneurship, and others.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at building skills/expertise in the fields of agricultural mechanization, food crops, horticulture, mixed farming, soil management, land conservation, crop cultivation, fishing, fish farming, fisheries machinery, agricultural-produce processing, fisheries-produce processing, livestock-produce processing, crop-production agribusiness, livestock-production agribusiness, aquatic-resources-production agribusiness, and others, conducted by enterprises.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at building skills/expertise in the fields of agricultural mechanization, food crops, horticulture, mixed farming, soil management, land conservation, crop cultivation, fishing, fish farming, fisheries machinery, agricultural-produce processing, fisheries-produce processing, livestock-produce processing, crop-production agribusiness, livestock-production agribusiness, aquatic-resources-production agribusiness, and others, conducted by the private sector.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at building skills/expertise in the fields of production machinery, pipe installation, plate work, metal casting, CNC, industrial welding, fabrication, underwater welding, light-vehicle engineering, motorcycle engineering, heavy-equipment engineering, lighting installation, power installation, industrial automation, mechatronics, telecommunications, instrumentation and control, audio-video, domestic refrigeration, air-conditioning engineering, stone and concrete construction, timber construction, building drafting, furniture, light-steel construction, gypsum work, surveying and mapping, reinforcement-steel work, and others, conducted by enterprises.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at building skills/expertise in the fields of production machinery, pipe installation, plate work, metal casting, CNC, industrial welding, fabrication, underwater welding, light-vehicle engineering, motorcycle engineering, heavy-equipment engineering, lighting installation, power installation, industrial automation, mechatronics, telecommunications, instrumentation and control, audio-video, domestic refrigeration, air-conditioning engineering, stone and concrete construction, timber construction, building drafting, furniture, light-steel construction, gypsum work, surveying and mapping, reinforcement-steel work, and others, conducted by the private sector.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at building skills/expertise in the fields of networking, technical support, computer engineering, programming, multimedia, database, system analysis, graphic design, office tools, animation, artificial intelligence, IT governance, public relations, public speaking, and others, conducted by enterprises.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at increasing skills/expertise in the fields of networking, technical support, computer engineering, programming, multimedia, database, system analyst, graphic design, office tools, animation, artificial intelligence, IT governance, public relations, public speaking, and others, organised by the private sector.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at building skills/expertise in the fields of household management, elderly care, infant/toddler care, child care, cooking, and others, conducted by enterprises.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at building skills/expertise in the fields of household management, elderly care, infant/toddler care, child care, cooking, and others, conducted by the private sector.
This group covers job-training activities aimed at building skills/expertise in the field of hospitality, conducted by enterprises.
This group covers job-training activities aimed at building skills/expertise in the field of hospitality, conducted by the private sector.

This group covers vocational training activities aimed at developing skills/expertise in metal engraving, wood carving, crochet, embroidery, weaving, screen printing, wickerwork, hand-drawn batik (batik tulis), stamped batik (batik cap), leather tanning, leather finishing, manufacture of leather products, sewing (knitting, woven), machine embroidery, pattern-making, fashion design, fashion technology, skin beauty care, hair beauty care, and the like, organized by enterprises.

This group covers job-training activities aimed at increasing skills/expertise in the fields of metal-engraving techniques, wood-carving techniques, crocheting, embroidery, weaving, screen printing, plaiting, hand-drawn batik (batik tulis) techniques, stamped batik (batik cap) techniques, leather tanning, leather finishing, the manufacture of leather products, sewing (knitting, woven), embroidery techniques, pattern-making techniques, fashion design, fashion technology, skin beauty care, hair beauty care, and others, organised by the private sector.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pelayanan: This group covers the provision of veterinary medical services such as supervision, care, examination, treatment, diagnosis, and animal-health consultation for livestock, pets, aquatic animals, and wildlife, in the form of private practice or self-employed individual practice carried out by veterinarians; paramedics; reproduction-technique assistants under the supervision of a veterinarian; animal chiropractors; as well as animal nutritionists for horses, aquatic animals, and wildlife. This group also covers ambulatory (mobile) veterinary services.

This group covers health support service activities managed by either the government or the private sector, such as blood management units, medical laboratories, public health laboratories, health service facilities providing optometry, diagnostic centres, stem-cell and/or cell processing laboratories, eye banks, plasma banks, cell or tissue banks, biobanks, biorepositories, health service facilities providing precision medicine and/or genetic testing and analysis laboratories, hearing-aid centres, and other medical support services.

This group covers services provided by non-profit Social Welfare Institutions (Lembaga Kesejahteraan Sosial/LKS), comprising the provision of residential care combined with medical assistance, nursing care, and rehabilitation. These facilities maintain a permanent core staff of registered or licensed practical nurses together with other staff, providing nursing care combined with personal care. Medical or nursing care services typically include administering medication, performing medical diagnoses, and treating wounds, and are generally provided without the on-site supervision of a medical doctor at the facility.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemanenan: This group covers crop harvesting activities on a fee or contract basis.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemanfaat: This group covers the utilization of environmental services/conditions within forests, ranging from the use of environmental conditions in the form of ecosystem potential (such as conservation and protection functions), the use of forest environmental services (water, air), climatic conditions, natural phenomena, distinctive species, and species uniqueness. These activities may be carried out in natural forests, semi-natural forests, or plantation forests.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemasanga:
This group covers the installation and maintenance of gas piping systems, including fuel gas and medical gas, in residential and non-residential buildings as well as other civil structures.
This group does not cover:
- construction of oil and gas pipelines for long-distance transport, see group 42991;
- installation of pipes and machinery in chemical plants, refineries, and similar facilities for processing or unrelated to heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning (HVAC), see subgroup 3320.

This group covers the installation and maintenance of mechanical conveying and lifting equipment in residential and non-residential buildings as well as other civil structures, such as elevators, escalators, conveyors, travelators, gondolas, automatic doors, and fire escape stairway equipment.

This group covers the installation and maintenance of heating and geothermal equipment in residential and non-residential buildings, whether electric or non-electric, such as pipework, ducting, and sheet-metal works; central heating control systems; connection to district heating systems; domestic boilers and burners; brick heating furnaces; solar thermal collectors; thermal insulation of pipes or tanks; weatherproof exterior wall thermal insulation; thermal insulation (for hot and cold water pipes, steam boilers, and drainage ducts); fireproof insulation; and fire-protection systems.

This group covers the installation and maintenance of systems and equipment related to navigational aids for maritime, river, and air navigation, marine/aviation telecommunications, hydrography and meteorology, traffic lanes, and pilotage, for the purposes of shipping and aviation safety.
This group covers the installation and maintenance of ventilation and air conditioning (AC) for buildings, whether residential or non-residential, including pipework, ducting, and sheet-metal work.

This group covers the installation of telecommunications networks in buildings, whether residential or non-residential, such as antenna installation. This group also covers the installation, repair, and maintenance of telecommunications networks at telephone/telegraph exchanges, microwave radar transmitter stations, small earth stations/satellite stations, and the like, including the installation of transmission and telecommunications networks in buildings and civil structures.

This group covers the installation of glass in walls, windows, doors, or other openings as part of the finishing of residential and non-residential buildings as well as civil engineering works. This group also covers the installation of curtain walls using glass and aluminium, glass colour-modification and coating works; the installation of doors (except automatic doors and revolving doors), frames, windows, as well as door and window frames made of wood or other materials.

This group covers the installation of small, medium, or large meteorological, climatological, and geophysical equipment, such as automatic weather stations, humidity gauges, and volcanic activity monitors.

This group covers the installation of electronic systems in buildings, whether residential or non-residential, and airport electronics as well as information technology (including telecommunications and information technology systems), such as the installation of alarm systems, closed-circuit TV and sound systems, and commercial management systems (pre-paid electricity vouchers), including the installation of access control, scoring boards, timing systems, perimeter pixel displays, master clocks, and other electronic facilities. This group does not cover maritime, river, and air navigation electronic systems, see group 43214.

This group covers the installation, maintenance, and repair of electric-based road equipment, such as street lighting, electronic traffic signs, and traffic signal devices. This group does not cover the installation of non-electric-based road equipment, see subgroup 4390.

This group covers the installation, repair, and maintenance of clean-water, wastewater, and drainage lines, and of sanitary fittings in residential and non-residential buildings. This group covers the installation of water lines, clean-water distribution pipes, and water treatment plant (WTP) or reverse osmosis (RO) installations, as well as foul-water pipes.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemasaran: This group covers the marketing of guarantee (suretyship) business activities for and on behalf of guarantee companies or sharia guarantee companies.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembangki:
This group covers the generation of electric power, the transmission of electric power through transmission and/or distribution networks, the storage of electric power, and the sale of electric power to end consumers, carried out as a single integrated business.
This group also covers:
- operation of public electric vehicle charging stations (SPKLU) integrated with power generation.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembangun: This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of irrigation water channel networks and drainage networks.
This group covers the construction of reservoirs, intakes, control gates, penstocks, and outflows for hydroelectric power plants.

This group covers tunnel construction using boring machines and/or explosives, formwork, reinforcement, and concrete casting; the maintenance and repair of tunnel structures underwater, in hills or mountains, and below ground level.

This group covers the construction, installation, repair, maintenance, and reconstruction of electrical networks in buildings, whether for residential or non-residential use, such as the installation of low-voltage electrical networks, photovoltaic systems, power storage systems, and electric chargers. This group also covers the installation and maintenance of electrical networks in civil engineering structures, such as highways, railways, and airfields.
This group covers the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil-engineering structures for water infrastructure and similar facilities not elsewhere classified.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and repair of telecommunications exchange structures and their equipment, such as telephone and telegraph exchange buildings, transmitter tower structures, microwave radar receivers, small earth station buildings, and satellite stations, including local and long-distance communication pipe networks, transmission networks, and telecommunications/telephone cable distribution networks above ground, underground, and underwater.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of buildings using conventional methods, intended for uses other than those in groups 41011 through 41018, such as places of worship (mosques, Catholic churches, Protestant churches, Hindu temples, Buddhist monasteries, Chinese temples), terminal/station buildings, railway workshops (balai yasa), monumental buildings, state and central/regional government buildings, airport buildings, aircraft hangars, airport fire-fighting buildings (PKPPK), historic buildings, prison buildings, assembly halls, warehouses, generator-set buildings, pump houses, depots, power-house buildings, data-center buildings, electrical substation buildings, signal cabin buildings, tower buildings, and storage buildings, including the storage of explosives. This group also covers the alteration and renovation of other buildings.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of buildings using conventional methods for office buildings, such as offices and shop-offices (rukan). This group also covers the alteration and renovation of office buildings.

This group covers the activities of construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of buildings using conventional methods used for residential purposes, such as dwelling houses, temporary dwelling houses, flats (rumah susun), as well as apartments and condominiums. This group also covers the alteration and renovation activities of residential buildings.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of buildings using conventional methods intended for industrial use, such as industrial/factory buildings, workshop buildings, and factory buildings for the management and processing of nuclear materials. This group also covers the alteration and renovation of industrial buildings.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of buildings using conventional methods used for lodging, such as hotel buildings, hostels, and inns. This group also covers the alteration and renovation of lodging buildings.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of buildings using conventional methods that are used for commerce, such as commercial buildings/markets/malls, department stores, shops, shop-houses (ruko), and stalls. This group also covers the alteration and renovation of commercial buildings.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of buildings using conventional methods intended for healthcare facilities, such as hospitals, polyclinics, community health centres (puskesmas), treatment centres, healthcare service buildings, and laboratory buildings. This group also covers the alteration and renovation of healthcare buildings.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of buildings using conventional methods intended for educational facilities, such as school buildings, training centres, and laboratories. This group also covers the alteration and renovation of educational buildings.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of buildings using conventional methods intended for entertainment venues, such as cinemas, cultural/arts buildings, tourism and recreation buildings, and sports buildings. This group also covers the alteration and renovation of entertainment and sports buildings.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of jetty, trestle, and port facility structures and the like for fishing ports, including the construction of waterways or canals, ports and river-route facilities, docks, locks (Panama Canal lock, Hoover Dam), and others.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of sports-facility structures such as stadium buildings, field sports venues (football, baseball, rugby, car and motorcycle racing circuits), basketball courts, hockey fields, tennis courts, golf courses, swimming pools, athletics tracks, archery ranges, and sports arenas.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of telecommunications facility structures for maritime navigational aids, air navigation telecommunications structures, railway signalling and telecommunications structures, including tower/mast/pipe/antenna structures, earth stations, and similar structures.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of bridge structures (including rail bridges), flyovers, underpasses, and overpasses. These activities may be accompanied by the construction, upgrading, and maintenance of supporting elements, ancillaries, and fittings for bridges and flyovers, such as retaining walls/fences, road drainage, road markings, and road signs.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of other civil-engineering structures not covered in groups 42201 through 42207, including the arrangement of buildings and the environment, and infrastructure for residential areas, industrial estates, hospitals, and the like.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of coastal protection structures, including groins, breakwaters, seawalls, artificial headlands, beach nourishment, artificial reefs, and other similar works.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of raw-water intake and conveyance structures, raw-water treatment plants, drinking-water treatment plants, drinking-water towers, drinking-water reservoirs, clean-water distribution pipe/conveyance networks, as well as drinking-water tanks and other ancillary drinking-water structures.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of water-resources infrastructure such as dams, weirs, retention basins (embung), sluice gates, lifts, water-regulating gates, aqueducts (viaducts), siphons, check dams, embankments and flood-control channels, free-intake structures, reservoirs and the like, as well as pumping stations.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of facilities and infrastructure for treating solid, liquid, and gaseous waste, waste reservoirs, waste piping networks, urban wastewater-network structures (collection networks for domestic/human wastewater and industrial wastewater), waste disposal and incineration structures (incinerators), and ancillary structures for solid, liquid, and gaseous waste, final waste-disposal sites together with their ancillary structures, as well as installation services for septic-system construction and for the construction of waste-treatment units arising from thermal, hydro, geothermal, and other new and renewable energy (NRE) power generation.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of electrical civil-engineering structures such as civil works for the generation, transmission, distribution, and utilization installations of electric power (for example, electric-vehicle charging stations); solar and wind energy fields; local and long-distance power line networks, including the construction of substations and the installation of electricity poles and towers.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of civil-engineering structures for upstream and downstream oil and gas business activities, whether above ground, underground, or underwater, such as long-distance oil and gas transport pipelines and offshore platforms.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of various types of road structures on the ground surface, such as highways, secondary roads, minor roads, airfield runways (runways, taxiways, and aprons), and container yards. These activities may be accompanied by the construction, upgrading, and maintenance of road retaining walls/fences.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of civil-engineering processing facilities, such as basic-chemical processing plants; fertilizer processing; plastics plants and rubber processing plants; agrochemical processing; other chemical processing plants, including pharmaceutical and petrochemical product processing plants; microelectronics plants, microprocessor production, silicon chips and wafers, microcircuits, and semiconductors; textile and clothing processing plants; iron and steel processing; and other processing plants.
This group excludes the construction of civil-engineering processing facilities using ionizing radiation sources, see group 42997.
This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of mining exploration and production-operation facilities, including environmental-impact control.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of railway tracks, such as railway tracks, underground tracks, and conductor rails for railways. These activities may be accompanied by the laying of rails and railway sleepers and the placing of ballast for the railway roadbed. This group excludes the construction of rail bridges.

This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of other civil-engineering structures, such as car parks, playgrounds, and other residential-area facilities (outside buildings). This group covers the subdivision of land together with its development (for example, the addition of roads and public infrastructure).
This group covers the construction, maintenance, and/or reconstruction of structures for military facilities such as forts, shelters, and military testing centers, including spaceport facilities.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembatika: This group covers batik-making using wax as a dye-resist medium to produce patterns on fabric. Batik fabric may be made by the hand-drawn (tulis) method, the stamped (cap) method, or a combination of both.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembelian:
This group covers the purchase of trade receivables (for example, invoices) from third parties at a certain discount (return) rate.
This subclass excludes:
- debt financing carried out with receivables as collateral, see subclass 6495.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembeniha: This group covers the seedling production of forest trees raised up to a certain age. The seedling production of trees other than forest trees is covered in group 01309.

This group covers the seed production of forage crops and the seed production of beet (other than sugar beet) to produce seed in the form of grain, comprising land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. Forage crops include forage grasses and forage legumes/pulses, such as elephant grass, king grass, dwarf elephant grass (rumput odot), setaria grass, alfalfa, calliandra, gliricidia, leucaena (lamtoro), and Indigofera zollingeriana.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemberian: This group covers the provision of consultancy and/or intermediary services in the granting of guarantees, as well as the handling and settlement of their claims, acting for and on behalf of the guaranteed party.
This group covers the provision of rating services for micro, small, and medium enterprises and cooperatives.

This group covers the provision of other credit not covered elsewhere, such as investment financing, working-capital financing, and multipurpose financing, carried out on a conventional basis or in accordance with sharia principles. This group also covers the activities of moneylenders.
This group covers the coloring or dyeing of furskins used in finished leather goods.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembesara: This group covers the grow-out farming of non-protected brackish-water plants, such as seaweed/Gracilaria spp., including the seedling production of brackish-water plants. This group also covers the cultivation of brackish-water plants aimed at the natural absorption and storage of carbon, as well as the sale of carbon credits or emission-reduction certificates resulting from the cultivation activities. These activities may be carried out on land, in waters, and in other artificial facilities that use brackish water as the cultivation medium.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembiayaa:
This group covers conduit financing activities, for example, units established by a group of financial or non-financial institutions to raise or borrow funds (mostly in the open market) and channel those funds to the parent company or other entities within the corporate group.
This subclass also covers:
- the activities of captive financial institutions engaged in lending between entities within a group;
- brass-plate companies engaged in raising funds and channeling them to their parent company, for example, units owned by non-resident units (whether directly or indirectly) whose balance sheets consist mostly of claims on and liabilities to non-resident units, which have few or no employees and have a small physical location or no physical location at all within the company's jurisdiction.
This subclass excludes:
- public fund- and debt-management services, see subclass 8411.

This group covers infrastructure financing carried out on a conventional basis, comprising financing in the form of the provision of funds to infrastructure projects, namely direct lending for infrastructure financing, refinancing of infrastructure that has been financed by other parties, and/or the provision of subordinated loans related to infrastructure financing.

This group covers infrastructure financing carried out entirely in accordance with sharia principles, comprising financing in the form of the provision of funds to infrastructure projects, namely direct lending for infrastructure financing, refinancing of infrastructure that has been financed by other parties, and/or the provision of subordinated loans related to infrastructure financing.

This group covers non-banking microfinance activities carried out on a conventional basis, comprising business-development and community-empowerment services, whether through micro-scale lending to members and the community, the management of savings, or the provision of business-development consultancy services.

This group covers non-bank Sharia micro-financing activities conducted entirely on the basis of Sharia principles, comprising business-development and community-empowerment services, whether through micro-scale business financing to members and the community, savings management, or the provision of business-development consultancy services.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembibita: This group covers the breeding of local chickens and their crossbreeds to produce day-old chicks and hatching eggs of local layer and broiler chickens and their crossbreeds.
This group covers the breeding of broiler and layer chicken strains producing hatching eggs, day-old chicks (DOC), and other outputs.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembongka: This group covers the mechanical demolition or dismantling of multi-storey and non-multi-storey buildings or structures, the dismantling and cutting of steel structures, the demolition of reinforced concrete, the demolition of semi-permanent buildings, and the demolition of buildings containing hazardous materials; controlled demolition for the purpose of material reuse. This group does not cover site preparation for oil and gas mining, see group 43120.

This group covers the dismantling of industrial machinery, equipment, and systems, both hardware and software, whether in whole or in part, on a large or small scale.
This group does not cover:
- the installation, mounting, or assembly/integration of industrial equipment and systems, see group 33201;
- the demolition of civil engineering structures, see category F.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pembuatan: This group covers the manufacture of everyday footwear from leather and imitation leather, rubber, textiles, plastic, and wood, such as daily shoes, casual shoes, sandal shoes, clogs and slippers, including the manufacture of parts of such footwear, such as uppers, insoles, outsoles, toe puffs, mid-stiffeners, heel counters, linings, and accessories made of leather, imitation leather, rubber, plastic, or wood.

This group covers the manufacture of other footwear not included in 15201 to 15203, for example shoes made from banana-stem sheaths (gedebok) and water hyacinth, including the manufacture of gaiters and similar articles. This group does not cover the manufacture of orthopaedic shoes (see 32502).

This group covers the manufacture of game implements or accessories governed by rules of play, such as playing cards (dominoes, playing-card decks, and the like); marbles; jacks (bekel); board games and similar games (such as Chinese checkers and snakes and ladders), including electronic board games; chess sets and their accessories; coin-operated games or arcade games; special tables for gambling games and the like; equipment for fun fairs, table games, and parlour games; billiard tables, casino tables, bowling tables, and their accessories; as well as puzzles and educational toys.

This group covers the manufacture of metal cutlery such as spoons, forks, ladles, table knives, butter knives, sugar tongs, chopsticks, straws, and similar implements used in the kitchen and at the dining table.
This group does not cover dinnerware, flatware, and cookware, see subgroup 2599.

This group covers the manufacture of kitchenware and tableware whose main material is wood, bamboo, and rattan, such as graters, spatulas, scoops, rice paddles, pestles, mortars, cutting boards, grinding stones (cobek), grinding pestles (ulekan), spoons, forks, chopsticks, glasses, plates, bowls, trays, rice boxes, winnowing trays (tampah), steamers, baskets, coasters, toothpicks, and the like.

This group covers the manufacture of kitchenware, both aluminium and non-aluminium metal, such as tableware, plates, shallow plates, bowls, teapots, pots, woks, kettles, cooking pots, steaming pots, cooking kettles, tiered lunch containers (rantang), basins, trays, jars, and the like, including other non-electric utensils used at the table or in the kitchen, other small hand-operated kitchen utensils and their accessories, and metal scouring tools.

This group covers the manufacture of manual measuring, inspection, and testing instruments, whether or not related to scientific investigation and of a mechanical nature, such as gauges, thermometers, barometers, compasses, precision balances, mechanical therapy apparatus, tape measures, water and gas meters, and surveying instruments, including the accessories of such equipment.

This group covers the manufacture of electrical measuring, inspection, testing, detection, and monitoring instruments, whether or not related to scientific investigation, such as electric current meters, electrical sensors, electrical measuring instrument devices or modules, monitoring and control devices with communication capabilities (Internet of Things), including the accessories of such equipment.

This group covers the manufacture of other household items, both aluminium and non-aluminium metal, such as drying racks and ladders, including the manufacture of bathtubs, (dish)washing sinks, washbasins, and similar equipment.

This group covers the manufacture or assembly of civil and military aircraft and their equipment, aircraft for passengers or cargo designed to operate only with the physical presence of a pilot to perform the aircraft's primary function, such as jet-engined aircraft, propeller aircraft, helicopters, balloons, and gliders. This group also covers the manufacture of aircraft for sport or other purposes, gliders and hang gliders, dirigibles/steerable balloons and hot-air balloons, aircraft parts and accessories, such as major assemblies such as the fuselage, wings, doors, control surfaces, landing gear, fuel tanks, nacelles, and others; propellers, helicopter rotor blades, and propulsion rotors; various motors and engines used in aircraft; and turbojet and turbopropeller parts for aircraft, ground flight trainers, including the inspection, rebuilding, and conversion of aircraft or aircraft engines, as well as the manufacture of aircraft seats.
This group covers the manufacture of liquid biofuels from biomass feedstock, such as biodiesel, bioethanol, and aviation biofuel. The manufacture of solid biofuels is included in subgroup 1629.

This group covers the manufacture of raw materials for pesticides, such as butyl phenyl methyl carbamate (BPMC), methyl isopropyl carbamate (MIPC), diazinon, carbofuran, glyphosate, monocrotophos, arsenic trioxide, and copper sulphate.

This group covers the manufacture of builders' carpentry of wood used mainly for construction, such as beams, rafters, and roof trusses planed on all four sides; support posts made of finger-jointed wood with adhesive or joined with metal; doors, windows, shutters, and their frames (kusen), whether or not containing metal components such as hinges and locks; stairs and handrails; wooden beads, wood mouldings, and shingles; parquet flooring blocks and strips assembled into panels made of solid wood or engineered wood; and decorative wall boards and nameboards.

This group covers the manufacture of basic chemicals producing industrial gases, such as hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, and dry ice; the manufacture of basic chemicals producing noble gases, such as helium, neon, and argon.
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of radon gas, see group 20114;
- the manufacture of ammonia gas, see group 20121.

This group covers the manufacture of tyres and inner tubes whose main material is natural rubber or synthetic rubber, for all types of motor vehicles, bicycles, other transport vehicles, and equipment that uses tyres.

This group covers the manufacture of rubber articles for supporting health needs, such as contraceptive sheaths (condoms), teats and compress devices, medical rubber gloves, and urinary/Foley catheters.

This group covers the manufacture of plastic articles for construction, such as plastic doors, windows, frames, window shutters, blinds, and skirting boards; plastic tanks and water reservoirs; plastic floor, wall, and ceiling coverings in rolls or sheets; as well as plastic sanitary ware, such as plastic curtains, showers, washbasins, lavatory pans, and flushing cisterns.

This group covers the manufacture of finished textile articles with filling material (kapok, dacron, animal hair, or similar materials), such as sleeping pillows and bolsters, seat pads and chair backs that are not a primary part of furniture, eiderdown quilts, cushions/throw pillows, sleeping bags, bed covers, quilts, and pouffes. This group also covers the manufacture of the textile parts of electric pillows, as well as the manufacture of pillows and bolsters resembling dolls and/or using toy characters.

This group covers the manufacture of other rubber articles, such as the manufacture of articles from used tyres and various rubber waste, including, among others, rubber gloves other than for medical use; rubber articles for clothing (if only joined together, not sewn), such as combs, hair clips, hair rollers, and the like made of hard rubber; textile fabric impregnated, coated, or laminated with rubber, with rubber as the principal material; rubber caps and bathing suits; rubber raincoats and diving suits; and rubber sex articles.
This group covers the manufacture of explosive articles, such as gunpowder, dynamite, detonators, fireworks, firecrackers, mercury fulminate, and rocket propellants.

This group covers the manufacture of plastic sheet articles, such as plastic sheets of various kinds, for example polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), and polyvinyl chloride (PVC), imitation leather, formica, and plastic glass, including plastic plates, plastic sheets, plastic blocks, film, foil, and plastic strips (whether or not adhesive).

This group covers the manufacture of technical/industrial plastic goods and equipment, such as machine parts, parts and fittings of drive motors, transmissions, bodies, frames, suspension, steering, axles, bottles, pipes, and plastic cabinets for technical/industrial purposes, including conveyor belts.

This group covers the manufacture of rubber goods for household use, such as rubber carpets, rubber hoses, tubes, water pipes or hoses, rubber thread and cord, knitted or woven thread and rubber-coated fabric, rubber roller-blind frame covers, inflatable rubber mattresses, inflatable balloons, sponge/foam rubber, rubber brushes, and rubber waterbed mattresses. This group also covers the manufacture of doormats, well-bucket ropes, and flower pots made of rubber.

This group covers the manufacture of goods made of wood, cork, rattan, and other bamboo not previously classified. Wood goods include, for example, weaving looms, shoe lasts and trees, coat hangers, toothpicks, slate pencils, dowels, abacuses (counting devices), rulers and blackboards; it also includes the manufacture of wooden work tools such as trowels, mallets, wood-plane bodies, tool handles, pallets, washboards, and the like. Cork goods include, for example, cork sheet, stoppers, discs, rings, liners, and floats.

This group covers the manufacture of goods made of leather or other materials for animal use, such as collars, harnesses, saddles, muzzles, whips, animal shoes, animal bags, and animal clothing made of leather or other materials.

This group covers the manufacture of goods made of leather and composition leather for purposes not covered in groups 15121 through 15122, such as seat upholstery and chiseled-and-painted (tatah sungging) handicrafts (ornaments, shadow puppets, and lampshades). This group also covers the manufacture of goods made of leather and composition leather for machinery use, such as V-belts and gaskets.

This group covers the manufacture of goods made of cordage, such as fishing nets, ship ropes, and lifting slings or nets, whether made of natural-fiber rope, synthetic-fiber rope, or mixed-fiber rope. The manufacture of shoelaces, stove wicks, lamp wicks, and the like is covered in group 13999.

This group covers the manufacture of handicraft goods from plant and animal materials, such as handicrafts from coconut palm, shell, coir, roots, hide, ivory, horn, bone, feathers, hair, preserved animals, taxidermy (stuffing animal skins with cotton and so on so they appear like live animals), flower arrangements, wreaths and flower baskets; artificial flowers, fruits, and leaves and painted goods, including the manufacture of handicraft goods from fish skin and shells, whether from mother-of-pearl shell such as Pinctada maxima, mabe shell (half-round pearl), or other shells.

This group covers the manufacture of jewellery articles whose principal material is precious metal (gold, platinum, and silver) and which are worn on the body, on human clothing, and/or on pets, such as rings, necklaces, bracelets, earrings, brooches, belts, and buttons, including their parts and accessories.
This group does not cover the manufacture of imitation jewellery, see group 32120.

This group covers the manufacture of plastic household furnishings and utensils, such as mats, carpets, buckets, and vases, including plastic household goods supporting health (such as toothbrushes and baby bottles). This group also covers the manufacture of plastic tableware, kitchenware, and toiletry articles, as well as durable floor coverings such as vinyl and linoleum.

This group covers the manufacture of goods not classified elsewhere, such as nameplates, all kinds of umbrellas, smoking pipes, electronic cigarettes (vapes), badges, trophies, medals, stamps, walking sticks, lampshades, candles, brooms, palm-fiber brushes, cigar and betel boxes, smoking pipes, combs, perfume sprayers, vacuum flasks and vacuum vessels for personal or household use, natural non-animal leather (e.g. plant-based leather from certain fungi), and others not covered in other groups, including the dummies used by tailors to fit clothes, and coffins.
The manufacture of lamp wicks is included in group 13942.
This group covers the manufacture of sewing thread, from either fiber or yarn raw material, including the texturizing, twisting, folding, cabling, and covering/dipping of sewing thread.

This group covers the manufacture of various types of chocolate, such as compound chocolate, couverture chocolate, imitation chocolate, white chocolate, as well as the manufacture of chocolate confectionery, chocolate-based spreads, and fillings. This group also covers the manufacture of chocolate beverages in both powder and liquid form.
This group covers the manufacture of various types of buttons, such as hook buttons and snap buttons, as well as the manufacture of zippers and other supporting components.
This group covers the manufacture of various types of lighters made of metal or plastic, whether operated mechanically, electrically, or by other mechanisms.

This group covers the manufacture of various electrical accumulators and their components, such as 6 V or 12 V batteries rated at 200 A or less, battery plates, separators, containers, covers or casings, poles, and battery clamps (tooth type).

This group covers the manufacture of various laboratory, electrical, and technical apparatus, as well as porcelain fittings, such as mortars and pestles, filter plates, chemical tubes, jars/crocks, dishes, fuse holders, insulators, low-voltage insulators, and high-voltage insulators, including ferrite and ceramic magnets, and ceramic products for laboratory, chemical, and industrial use.

This group covers the manufacture of various writing and drawing instruments including their accessories, such as black pencils, colored pencils, fountain pens, ballpoint pens, pen holders, stencil pens, compasses, drawing brushes, slates, drawing boards, technical drawing pens (rapidographs), stencils, dry-transfer lettering (Letraset), and crayons.

This group covers the manufacture of various granite goods for:
- household and display use, such as table tops, ornaments, and statues made of granite;
- building-material use, such as tiles and bathtubs made of granite; and
- furniture use, such as tables and chairs made of granite.

This group covers the activities of making various kinds of goods from marble stone for:
- household and display purposes, such as table tops, ornaments, and statues made of marble;
- building material purposes, such as tiles and bathtubs made of marble; as well as
- furniture purposes, such as tables and chairs made of marble.

This group covers the manufacture of various goods from stone other than marble and granite for furniture, household, decorative, and building-material purposes, such as tables, mortars, grinding stones (cobek), grinding slabs (batu pipisan), whetstones, stone slabs, crushed stone, stone dust, and mosaic cubes, including also the manufacture of stone monuments and stone ornaments other than from marble and granite.

This group covers the manufacture of various gypsum goods, such as boards, sheets, panels, and others for construction use. This group also covers the manufacture of gypsum building-material goods made from plant substances, such as wood wool, reeds, and straw, bound together with gypsum plaster.

This group covers the manufacture of various goods made of metal wire other than cable, including wire rope, such as barbed wire, wire fencing, wire gauze, wire netting, and grills. This group also covers the manufacture of springs (other than clock springs), such as leaf springs, helical springs, torsion bar springs, and spring leaves, as well as the manufacture of chains (except power transmission chain). This group does not cover the manufacture of cables and wires for electrical transmission, see groups 27310 and 27320.

This group covers the manufacture of various goods containing asbestos for various building-material purposes, such as corrugated asbestos-fiber boards, flat asbestos-fiber boards, pressurized asbestos pipes and laminated asbestos, including for industrial use.

This group covers the manufacture of various ophthalmic goods and eyeglasses together with frames, such as vision-aid eyeglasses, sun- or light-attenuating eyeglasses/sunglasses, safety goggles (eyewear for dust protection, swimming, diving, welding), and radiation-protection eyeglasses, including the manufacture of eyeglass lenses and contact lenses.
This group covers the manufacture of various refractory bricks, refractory mortar and refractory cement, refractory concrete, and similar composites, such as alumina, silica, and basic types.

This group covers the manufacture of various batteries for electric vehicles and electric bicycles, including the manufacture of battery energy storage systems (BESS) for electric vehicles.
This group also covers the manufacture of electric-vehicle batteries using in-house produced cathodes.

This group covers the manufacture of various bricks, such as pressed bricks, hollow bricks, decorative bricks, non-pressed bricks, and perforated bricks, including the manufacture of red cement and clay gravel.

This group covers the manufacture of various batteries (cells), such as primary electric cells and batteries, alkaline batteries, mercury batteries, as well as the manufacture of batteries and their derivative cells, including the manufacture of cells using manganese dioxide, mercury dioxide, or silver oxide; as well as the manufacture of lead-acid batteries, nickel-cadmium (NiCad) batteries, nickel-metal hydride (NiMH) batteries, lithium batteries, dry-cell batteries, and wet-cell batteries (including batteries for mobile phones and laptops).
This group also covers the manufacture of battery energy storage systems (BESS) for portable devices (mobile phones, tablets, and the like), such as power banks; as well as the manufacture of batteries using in-house produced cathodes.
This group covers the manufacture of various clay or ceramic roof tiles, such as pressed tiles, plain tiles, interlocking (frog) tiles, and glazed tiles.

This group covers the manufacture of various flat glass, such as clear colorless flat glass, clear colored flat glass, opaque colored flat glass, stained glass, engraved glass, and mirror glass. This group also covers the forming and processing of flat glass.
This group covers the manufacture of various safety glass, such as tempered safety glass, laminated safety glass, insulating safety glass, and other safety glass.
This group covers the manufacture of various glass not included in groups 23111 and 23112, such as tubes, rods, glass bars, or glass pipes, as well as the forming and processing of flat glass.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of cinematographic cameras and projectors, whether or not fitted with sound recording and reproduction apparatus. This group also covers the manufacture of cinematographic accessories, such as camera frames, camera casings, and film holders.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of photographic cameras, such as ordinary photo cameras, instant-print cameras, microfilm cameras, digital cameras, photo cameras fitted with a mini projector, cameras specially designed for underwater use, still-picture cameras, aerial survey cameras, comparison cameras for forensic or criminological purposes, and other photographic cameras. This group also covers the manufacture of photographic equipment, such as photographic light meters, photographic flash apparatus, and flashbulbs other than discharge tubes.
This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of lime from limestone, such as quicklime, building lime, and lime putty, including slaked lime and hydraulic lime.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of crackers, chips, peyek (savoury fritters) and the like, such as chips and peyek made from various legumes, prawn crackers, fish crackers, and starch crackers (eggplant crackers), as well as the manufacture of various cracker-type foods, such as assorted emping, kecimpring, karak, gendar, opak, lung crackers, snail crackers, skin/rind crackers, anchovy peyek, and prawn peyek.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of gas and discharge lamps, such as neon lamps, helium lamps, argon lamps, sodium lamps, and mercury lamps, including electric lamps for insect traps.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of incandescent lamps for lighting, such as bulbs excluding their fittings and accessories, photographic lighting (flash bulbs), and stage lighting or spotlights, including ultraviolet lamps, infrared lamps, flashlights, and lighting for medical instruments.
This group does not cover the manufacture of lighting equipment for bicycles and motor vehicles, see group 27403.
This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of lamps whose main material is metal, such as beacon lamps, pressure lamps, and hanging lamps, including their components.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of starch by extraction processes not yet covered in groups 10621 to 10623, such as potato starch, yam-bean (bengkuang) starch, Javanese turmeric (temulawak) starch, arrowroot starch, mango-seed starch, and modified starch. This group also covers the manufacture of inulin and gluten.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of laboratory and medical glassware, including clinical laboratory ware generally used for diagnostic purposes such as test tubes for biological samples (blood, urine, and saliva), as well as non-clinical laboratory and medical ware such as serum/infusion bottles, ampoules, test tubes, measuring tubes, microscope slides, cuvettes, and desiccators.
This group does not cover laboratory glassware resistant to very high temperatures, such as distillation flasks, see group 23919.
This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of porcelain sanitary fixtures, such as toilets, bidets, washbasins, urinals, sinks, and bathtubs.
This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of clay or ceramic sanitary fixtures, such as toilets, bidets, washbasins, urinals, sinks, and bathtubs.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of glass household ware, such as cups, drinking glasses, plates, bowls, teapots, jars, ashtrays, and baby bottles, including the manufacture of glass decorative articles, such as glass figurines or statuettes, vases, crystal lamps, pressure-lamp chimneys, and wall-lamp chimneys. This group also covers the manufacture of various kinds of containers or packaging of glass and crystal, such as bottles and jars, including hollow glassware.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of porcelain household ware, such as plates, saucers, cups, bowls, teapots, pitchers, spoons, ashtrays, toilet articles, as well as jars and similar products used for the transport or packaging of goods, including the manufacture of porcelain decorative articles, such as figurines or statuettes and other ornamental ceramic products, flower holders, cigarette boxes, and urns.
