This group does not cover the manufacture of various kinds of porcelain sanitary fixtures, see group 23934.
This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of typewriter/drawing ribbons, such as typewriter ribbons, computer printer ribbons, and other writing-machine ribbons.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of other metal products not elsewhere classified, such as hairpins, safety pins, staples, paper clips; needles (other than sewing-machine needles), such as sewing needles, knitting needles, and embroidery needles; buckle frames; metal chains; bells; picture frames (mouldings); metal nameplates, and various small metal articles, including the manufacture of propellers, ship chains, ship anchors, bells, fixed railway-track fixtures, stranded metal cable with similar wrapping, non-insulated metal cable or insulated metal cable not usable as an electrical conductor, washers (closing rings), and similar non-threaded articles, screw-machine products, foil bags, permanent metal magnets, metal vacuum bottles or flasks, metal signs (non-electric), metal badges and metal military insignia, hair curlers and metal combs, as well as umbrella frames and handles. This group does not cover the manufacture of sewing-machine needles, see group 28261.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of clay or ceramic products for household ware, decorative/ornamental articles, and the like, such as plates, cups, bowls, pitchers, teapots, cooking pots, large earthenware jars, statuettes, flower vases, betel containers, cigarette boxes, money boxes, technical ceramic products (such as insulators, insulating fittings, and permanent magnets), as well as jars and similar products used for the transport or packaging of goods.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of other clay or ceramic and porcelain products not used as building materials and not yet covered in groups 23931 to 23935, including ceramic furniture and other ceramic products not elsewhere classified.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of other glass products not yet covered in groups 23121 to 23122, such as prayer beads, rosaries, glass beads, enamelled glassware and aquariums, glass fibre (fibreglass), including products of glass wool and glass non-wovens, clock or watch glasses, optical glass and optical elements not optically worked, glassware used in imitation jewellery, insulating glass and glass insulating fittings, as well as other glass or crystal products, including the manufacture of glass building materials, such as bricks, tiles, roof tiles, paving blocks, and partition panels.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of other non-metallic mineral products not elsewhere classified, such as kaolin powder, calcined kaolin, gypsum powder, and talc powder, as well as the drying and grinding of clay into clay powder, including the manufacture of lighter flints; friction materials and unmounted articles based on mineral substances or cellulose; insulating materials of mineral origin, such as slag wool, rock wool, and other types of wool; exfoliated vermiculite, expanded clay, and similar heat-insulating materials, sound-absorbing materials; articles of various mineral substances, such as mica and articles of mica, articles of peat as fuel material; artificial corundum; carbon and carbon fibre (except fabrics of carbon fibre), graphite and graphite products, such as anode raw material in paste or powder form; as well as graphite fibre and its derivative products (except electrodes and electrical equipment).
This group does not cover the refining of non-metallic mineral products, see group 23993.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of refractory products, other than refractory bricks, including heat-insulating ceramic products of siliceous fossil meal; refractory tiles and blocks; chemical tubes or distillation flasks, crucibles for melting metal, filters, tubes, pipes, and the like; refractory intermediate products of mined or quarried non-metallic minerals, such as gravel, stone, or clay, and refractory articles containing magnesite, dolomite, or chromite.
This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of prepared animal feed, both for pets and for livestock.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of cement (hydraulic cement and charcoal or iron clinker), such as portland cement, natural cement, aluminous cement, slag cement, superphosphate cement, and other types of cement.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of rope, whether made of natural fibre, synthetic fibre, or blended fibre, such as hemp rope, jute rope, sisal (agave) rope, raffia rope, and nylon rope.

This group covers the manufacture of iron and steel in basic forms, such as iron ore pellets, sponge iron, pig iron, and the manufacture of iron and steel in crude steel forms such as steel ingots, steel billets, steel blooms, and steel slabs, derived from mining products and from other sources. This group also covers the manufacture of iron and steel alloys, including the operation of blast furnaces, steel converters, rolling and finishing mills; the production of pig iron in basic forms such as blocks; the production of ferro-alloys; the production of direct-reduced iron products from iron ore and other hollow iron products; the production of iron refined by electrolysis and other chemical processes; the production of iron granules and iron powder; the production of steel ingots or other basic forms; the re-melting of iron or steel ingot scrap; and the production of semi-finished steel derived from mining products and from other sources.
This group covers the manufacture of biostimulants, such as seaweed-based biostimulants, including the manufacture of plant growth promoters.

This group covers the manufacture of briquettes from petroleum, coal, peat, or lignite, whether at the mining site or away from the mining site, including the manufacture of briquettes using coal, petroleum, peat, or lignite purchased from third parties.

This group covers the manufacture of natural or artificial abrasive powder or grain, on a base of textile, paper, or other material, cut, joined, unframed, or otherwise made, including the manufacture of abrasive products, such as coated abrasives; bonded abrasives (grinding wheels); and natural or artificial abrasive stones used as scrapers, sharpeners, cutters, grinders, and/or polishers.

This group covers the manufacture of pulp from wood or other fibre and/or waste paper. The activity covers the manufacture of bleached, semi-bleached, or unbleached pulp, whether by mechanical, chemical (dissolving or non-dissolving), or semi-chemical processes; the manufacture of pulp from cotton linters; de-inking; and the manufacture of pulp from waste paper.
This group covers the manufacture of imitation fur made by knitting.

This group covers the manufacture of cooking seasonings, whether already compounded or not, and whether in powder or other forms, such as gulai seasoning, curry seasoning, pepper powder, ginger powder, cumin powder, nutmeg powder, chilli powder, and cinnamon powder. This group also covers the manufacture of flavour enhancers, whether natural or chemically synthetic, such as monosodium glutamate (MSG) and vanilla powder, as well as the manufacture of sauces and spices such as mayonnaise, mustard flour, prepared mustard, tomato ketchup, oyster sauce, and salad dressing; and salt substitutes used as seasoning in food products. This group also covers the manufacture of petis (shrimp/fish paste) and edible vinegar. This group does not cover the manufacture of fermented shrimp paste (terasi); see group 10295.
This group covers the manufacture of cigarette flavourings, such as cigarette/tobacco sauce and cigarette capsules.

This group covers the manufacture of electronic-cigarette liquids, both with and without nicotine content, whether for closed systems (e.g. disposable pods, cartridges) or for refillable open systems; formulating, blending, and packaging e-cigarette liquids from their raw materials (nicotine, flavouring substances, propylene glycol, vegetable glycerine, and other additives).

This group covers the manufacture of synthetic resins and plastic raw materials (virgin plastic pellets/resin), such as alkyd, polyester, amino, polyamide, epoxy, silicone, polyurethane, polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polystyrene, polyvinyl chloride, cellulose acetate, cellulose nitrate, and biopolymers, including alginic acid. The further processing of purchased synthetic resins and plastic materials to produce articles from such raw materials, such as plastic articles and film and film sheeting not yet sensitised to light, is included in group 26800.
This group covers the manufacture of putty, surfacing filler (plamir), non-refractory fillers, or similar surface-coating materials.

This group covers the manufacture of dodol, made primarily from rice flour or glutinous rice flour, coconut milk, and sugar, with or without other added ingredients, cooked until the desired texture is achieved.
The manufacture of lempok is included in group 10792.

This group covers the manufacture of furniture from wood and wood panels (such as plywood and wood particle board) for household and office use, such as tables, chairs, stools, beds, wardrobes, shelves, cabinets, room dividers and the like. A piece of furniture is considered to be made of wood if its frame is made of wood or, if it has no frame, if its most predominant component is wood.

This group covers the manufacture of generators and their components or parts, such as alternating-current (AC) generators, direct-current (DC) generators, generator sets, stators, rotors, commutators, and rotary converters, including power generators (except battery-charging alternators for internal combustion engines), motor-generator sets (except turbine-generator sets), and generator sets with prime movers.
This group covers the manufacture of plaster (gypsum plaster), formed from calcined gypsum or calcium sulphate, including calcined dolomite.

This group covers the manufacture of glucose and similar sugars other than from rice and maize, such as fructose, maltose, and sucrose, including glucose syrup and the like.
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of sugar from sugar cane or beet, see group 10721;
- the manufacture of lactose/milk sugar, see group 10509.

This group covers the manufacture of pure palm/coconut sugar (gula merah), whether in moulded, powdered/granulated, or liquid form, using sap (nira) as raw material, whether the sap is derived from sugar cane or from palm trees (sugar palm, coconut, and the like).
This group covers the manufacture of crystalline (granulated) sugar made primarily from sugar cane, beet, or other materials.
This group covers the manufacture of various articles made of lime as the principal constituent, such as writing chalk, drawing chalk, and putty.
This group covers the manufacture of tyre cord fabric from high-tenacity synthetic yarn, such as nylon tyre cord fabric and polyester tyre cord fabric.

This group covers the manufacture of narrow fabrics, generally not more than 30 cm wide, such as ribbon fabric, lace, bolduc, label fabric, hook-and-loop fastener/touch fastener, textile adhesive tape, and webbing. This group does not cover the manufacture of narrow fabrics produced by slitting fabric into smaller sizes and/or rewinding into smaller rolls.

This group covers the manufacture of textile fabrics (woven, knitted, non-woven) impregnated, coated, covered, or laminated with plastic or rubber, or with gum/substances having starch-like properties, such as fabrics for tracing cloth, fabrics for painting canvas, fabrics for buckram, fabrics for tarpaulin, fabrics for sails, fabrics for tents, fabrics for blinds, fabrics for umbrellas, and interlining fabrics.

This group covers the manufacture of knitted fabrics, both weft-knit and warp-knit, such as terry fabric for towels, ihram cloth, sheer curtain fabric (vitrage), tricot fabric, and knitted fabrics for window furnishings or the like.
This group does not cover the manufacture of sheer curtains and window furnishings made of lace, tulle, and other net fabrics, see subgroup 1399.

This group covers the manufacture of fabrics produced without weaving or knitting processes, such as felt, felting fabric, and laken (felted cloth). Non-woven fabrics may be made from various types of fibre, whether virgin or recycled, formed into a web/sheet and then consolidated by various techniques including mechanical techniques (needle punch, hydroentanglement, and stitch bonding), thermal techniques (thermo bonding), polymerisation/spunlaid techniques (spunbonded and meltblown), and chemical techniques (chemical bonding).
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of floor coverings from needle-loom felt, see group 13930;
- the manufacture of coated non-woven fabrics, see group 13992.

This group covers the manufacture of synthetic rubber, such as styrene butadiene rubber (SBR), polychloroprene (neoprene), acrylonitrile butadiene rubber (nitrile rubber), silicone rubber (polysiloxane), and isoprene rubber.

This group covers the manufacture of bagor sacks (flour/sugar sacks of unbleached cotton) and other sacks made of woven or knitted fabric, except the manufacture of paper sacks (see group 17022) and plastic sacks made from plastic sheeting (see group 22202).
This group covers the manufacture of textile sacks made of jute.

This group covers the manufacture of firewood and wood pellets made from sawdust or substitute materials such as pressed coffee grounds or pressed soybeans. This group also covers the manufacture of solid fuels from biomass and pellets from coconut coir.

This group covers the manufacture of soy sauce (kecap) from soybeans/other legumes, including the manufacture of taoco (fermented soybean paste), whether from fresh soybeans/other legumes or from the residue of soy sauce production. This group does not cover the manufacture of fish sauce, see group 10215.

This group covers the manufacture of packaging from plastic and bioplastic, such as plastic bags or pouches, plastic sacks, cosmetic packaging, film packaging, pharmaceutical packaging, food packaging, and other plastic packaging (containers, bottles, boxes, cases, racks, etc.). This group does not cover the manufacture of bagor sacks from woven plastic, see group 13924.
This group covers the manufacture of other confectionery not made from chocolate, such as caramels, cachous, nougat, fondant, marzipan, chewing gum, cough drops, and pastilles.
This group covers the manufacture of banderoles (revenue/excise bands), bank securities/bank notes, cheque paper, security paper, watermark paper, revenue stamps, postage stamps, and the like.

This group covers the manufacture of construction paper (insulating paper, condenser paper, roofing board, building board, etc.), wrapping and packing paper (kraftliner, corrugating medium/medium liner, ribbed kraft paper/umbrella paper, kraft paper, machine-glazed paper/MG paper, and machine-finished paper/MF paper), and board (postcard cardboard, londen paper, three-ply board, multi-ply board, bristol board, straw board, chip board, duplex board, ivory/boxboard, art board, and art paper).
This group covers the manufacture of newsprint and other printing paper or writing paper.

This group covers the manufacture of paper for household sanitary paper products and cellulose wadding articles, as well as articles of cellulose wadding, such as cleansing tissues, facial tissue, kitchen tissue, lens tissue, paper handkerchiefs, paper towels, paper serviettes, toilet tissue, baby diapers, sanitary napkins (sanitary towels, pantyliners, tampons, breast pads, and insert pads), adult diapers, pet diapers, underpads — including those made of textile materials — and serviettes for cups, plates, and trays; and the manufacture of cellulose wadding and articles of cellulose wadding, such as towels/wipes, cigarette paper, plug wrap paper, and tipping paper.

This group covers the manufacture of rubber compounds and rubber articles for infrastructure purposes, such as compounds for rubberized asphalt, activated natural rubber powder (SKAT), dock fenders, seismic bearings, bridge bearings, rubber dams, rubber road bumps, rail pads, rail guards, canal blocking, and traffic cones.

This group covers the manufacture of components/spare parts for prime mover engines (groups 28111 and 28112), such as engine blocks, pistons, piston rings, carburettors, cylinder heads, and the like for internal combustion engines, diesel engines, and so forth (except for motor vehicles), as well as inlet and exhaust valves of internal combustion engines.

This group covers the construction of offshore and floating structures, including their equipment and fittings, such as the construction of platforms, floating or submersible structures for drilling activities; the construction of floating structures, such as floating docks, lifeboats and floating cranes, floating bridges, pontoons, coffer-dams, floating landing structures, living quarters, jackets, platforms and mooring buoys, buoys, floating tanks, lighters, barges, crane vessels, and inflatable rafts not for recreation, including the manufacture of hovercraft, except recreational hovercraft.
This group covers the manufacture of copra from coconuts that are sun-dried or otherwise dried for use in the production of coconut oil.
This group covers the manufacture of cosmetics for animals, including perfumes, shampoos, soaps, powders, creams or lotions, and others.

This group covers the manufacture of cosmetics for humans, such as hair care products (shampoos, hair curling and straightening preparations, and others); nail care or manicure and pedicure products; skin care products (sun protection creams or lotions and creams or lotions for tanning the skin after sunbathing); personal hygiene products (cosmetic soaps, bath soaps, antiseptic bath soaps, external intimate hygiene products, deodorants, bath salts, and others); shaving products; decorative cosmetics such as face make-up, eye make-up, fragrances or perfumes, nail make-up, and hair styling, including hair dyes; toothpaste and oral hygiene products, including cosmetic tooth-whitening products; and contact lens solutions.

This group covers the manufacture of composition leather made from scraps/shavings of animal hides that are bonded back together. The manufacture of imitation leather made principally from textiles is classified in group 13992. The manufacture of imitation leather made principally from rubber is classified in subgroup 2219; and the manufacture of imitation leather made principally from plastic is classified in subgroup 2229.
This group covers the manufacture of lacquers and various kinds of varnishes, such as composite organic solvents and thinners and paint or varnish removers, including mastics.
This group covers the manufacture of LED lamps, whether as separate LED lamps or assembled into lamps for specific purposes, such as LED lamps used in flashlights, vehicles, or general lighting.

This group covers the manufacture of various plaited articles whose principal material is derived from plants other than rattan and bamboo, for example pandan, mendong (sedge), banana fronds, corn husks, purun (rush), ketak (a climbing fern), water hyacinth, abaca fibre, other natural fibres, coconut leaves, grasses, and the like. Examples of such plaited articles include mats, doormats, bags, and handicrafts.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of woven goods whose main material is rattan or bamboo, such as mats, webbing, lampit (woven rattan mats), hand fans, woven bamboo partitions/walls (bilik/gedek), and woven bag products such as ladies' bags and laptop bags.
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of sandals/shoes with soles of various materials and through various processes, see subclass 1520;
- the manufacture of hats and headgear from weaving of various materials, see subclass 1413.

This group covers the activities of making various kinds of handicraft and carved goods from wood, such as reliefs, masks, statues, wayang puppets, flower vases, picture frames, lampshades, souvenirs, ashtrays, tissue boxes, jewellery boxes, wall decoration products, and nameplates.
This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of paints, such as primer, metal paint, wood paint, wall paint, marine paint, epoxy paint, and enamel.

This group covers the activities of making various kinds of moist cakes (kue basah), namely a type of cake that is relatively perishable, such as wajik, lemper, kue lapis, lumpia, and martabak, including the making of tape and lempok.

This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of toys, such as dolls made of wood, cloth, rubber, and the like, including doll clothing and accessories; toy weapons; toy sets; character figures/action figures; toy animals; toy musical instruments; scale models (replicas) and similar recreational models, electric model trains, construction toys; wheeled toys designed to be ridden (toy vehicles) including bicycles and tricycles made of plastic; and drones for recreational purposes.
This group does not cover the manufacture of children's bicycles, see group 30921.

This group covers the manufacture of various electric office and accounting machines, such as electric calculating machines, electric typewriters, electric stencil machines and the like, calculators, postage meters, mail-handling machines (envelope stuffing, sealing and addressing machines, opening, sorting, scanning), stenography machines, analogue photocopiers, binding equipment (e.g. plastic or coil binders), coin-counting machines, coin sorters, and coin wrappers, pencil sharpeners, staplers, voting machines, paper hole-punching machines. This group also covers the manufacture of various electronic office and accounting machines, such as electronic calculating machines and cash registers.
This group does not cover
- the manufacture of subassemblies and electronic components of computing machines, including the manufacture of their components and spare parts, see group 26199;
- the maintenance and repair of machines in this group, see group 33121.

This group covers the manufacture of various electronic office and accounting machines, such as electronic calculating machines, digital photocopiers, and cash registers.
This group does not cover the manufacture of subassemblies and electronic components of computing machines, see group 26199.

This group covers the manufacture of various manual office and accounting machines, such as manual calculating machines, manual typewriters, manual stencil machines, pencil sharpeners, abacuses, postage meters, mail-handling machines (envelope stuffing, sealing and addressing machines, opening, sorting, scanning), stenography machines, binding equipment (plastic or coil binders), coin-counting machines, coin sorters, and coin wrappers, staplers, voting machines, tape dispensers, and paper hole-punching machines and the like, including the manufacture of their components and spare parts.
This group does not cover the maintenance and repair of machines in this group, see group 33121.

This group covers the manufacture of various other office supplies, such as toner cartridges, writing boards such as white boards and marker boards with writing and drawing surfaces, and dictating machines.
This group covers the manufacture of various kinds of inks, such as writing ink and special-purpose inks.

This group covers the manufacture of baby food, dietary food, and food for medical purposes, including infant formula, follow-on milk and other follow-on foods, baby food and food containing homogenized ingredients, growth formula, complementary foods for breast milk, snacks for children, beverages for pregnant and breastfeeding mothers, and food for sufferers of certain diseases.

This group covers the manufacture of cereal foods, including all kinds of ready-to-eat, instant, and hot cereal products, such as rolled cereal, granola cereal, instant oatmeal, corn flakes, puffed grain, and muesli, including cereal products made from soybeans and cereal products made from cereal flour using the extrusion process.

This group covers the manufacture of malt from barley, rye, or other cereals. This group does not cover the manufacture of malt-based alcoholic beverages (see group 11030) and the manufacture of malt extract and malt syrup (see subgroup 1079).
This group covers the manufacture of margarine from edible vegetable oils.

This group covers the manufacture of textile machinery, such as fibre preparation processing machines, spinning machines, weaving preparation machines, weaving looms, textile printing machines, knitting machines, fabric inspection machines, finishing machines, garment-making machines, and ancillary equipment or attachments for textile machines, such as dobbies, jacquards, automatic stop-motion machines, shuttle-changing machines, as well as spindles and spindle flyers.
This group covers the manufacture of alcoholic beverages from malt, such as beer, ale, porter, and stout, including the manufacture of low-alcohol or non-alcoholic beer.

This group covers the manufacture of other beverages not included in groups 11051 to 11053 and that are usually not industrially packaged, such as palm sap (nira), sugarcane juice, coconut water, and sekoteng powder.

This group covers the manufacture of essential oils, such as ginger oil, cinnamon oil, coriander oil, clove oil, cardamom oil, nutmeg oil, jasmine oil, ylang-ylang oil, vetiver oil, citronella oil, lemongrass oil, patchouli oil, sandalwood oil, agarwood oil, cajuput oil, peppermint oil, spice oils, and oils derived from gums, bark, roots, leaves, fruits, seeds, and flowers not included in any other group.
This group covers the manufacture of oil from rice and corn.
This group covers the manufacture of cooking oil and edible oil from materials other than coconut oil and palm oil, such as sesame oil, rice bran oil, lard cooking oil, and poultry cooking oil.
This group covers the manufacture of oil-based lubricating oils, oils, and greases.

This group covers the manufacture of oils made from high-fat fish, such as lemuru (Bali sardinella), or from fish organs such as shark liver. The processing of fish oil/other aquatic-organism oils used as pharmaceutical or cosmetic ingredients is included in subgroups 2101 and 2102.

This group covers the manufacture of non-refractory mortar or ready-mixed concrete, such as dry-mixed mortar, ready-mixed concrete, dry-mixed concrete, finishing plaster, white skim coat, and grey skim coat.

This group covers the manufacture of electric motors and their components or parts, such as alternating-current (AC) motors, direct-current (DC) motors, dynamo armatures, stators, rotors, brushes, and commutators, except internal-combustion engines used to start motors.

This group covers the manufacture of prime-mover engines other than internal-combustion engines, such as steam engines, turbines and their parts, steam turbines and other similar turbines, hydraulic turbines, water wheels and their regulators, wind turbines and gas/air turbines, and mill drives, except turbojets or turbo-propellers for aircraft; boiler-turbine sets, generator-turbine sets, and windmills.
This group covers the manufacture of processed foods from seaweed, such as agar-agar, carrageenan, and nori sheets.

This group covers the manufacture of hosiery made by knitting or crocheting, such as socks, tights, stockings, and pantyhose. This group also covers the manufacture of medical stockings and other medical hosiery, as well as the manufacture of soleless footwear from knitted or crocheted materials.
This group covers the manufacture of nails, nuts, bolts, and similar threaded articles made of iron, steel, copper, aluminium, and other metals, including the manufacture of rivets and thumbtacks.
This group covers the manufacture of wood particles and the like, such as wood wool, wood flour, and woodchips.
This group covers the manufacture of rice starch and corn starch (maize starch), including modified rice and corn starch.
This group covers the manufacture of starch from various types of palm plants, such as sago/pearl starch and sugar-palm starch, including modified palm starch.
This group covers the manufacture of starch from cassava, such as tapioca flour and modified cassava starch.
This group covers the manufacture of sweeteners from rice and corn, such as fructose, glucose, maltose, sucrose, and dextrose.

This group covers the manufacture of irradiation apparatus and tubes based on the use of X-ray, alpha-ray, beta, gamma, or other ionising radiation, used for industrial purposes, medical diagnosis, medical therapy, research, and science. This group also covers the manufacture of ionising-radiation source equipment for non-destructive testing, gauging, well logging, irradiation (irradiators), goods scanning, and analysis, including ionising-radiation generating equipment related to radiation safety and image quality, such as control panels and screens (image receptors).
This group does not cover X-ray film viewers, see group 26602.

This group covers the manufacture of photographic equipment and optical instruments other than eyeglasses, including their parts not elsewhere classified, used for science and printing, such as monocular telescopes, astronomical telescopes, elbow telescopes, periscopes, optics, spectroscopes, and spectrographs, including optical microscopes, binocular telescopes, optical mirrors, optical magnifying-glass equipment, optical precision equipment for mechanical purposes, optical comparators, optical weapon-sighting equipment, optical positioning equipment, as well as optical measuring and inspection equipment and instruments (e.g. fire-control equipment, rangefinders). This group also covers the manufacture of motion-picture and slide projectors, overhead transparency projectors, laser equipment, unrecorded audio and video magnetic tape, and unrecorded optical discs.

This group covers the manufacture of medical and dental equipment as well as other supplies not covered in groups 32501 to 32503, such as sterile/surgical cloth and thread and tissue paper, personal protective masks (e.g. FFP2, FFP3), surgical masks, surgical drapes; surgical gowns, head coverings, and wound dressings for healthcare services, including bone cement and dental fillings (except denture adhesives, see group 20234), dental wax, and other dental plaster preparations, and bone-reconstruction cement.

This group covers the manufacture of lighting fixtures mounted on ceilings or walls such as chandeliers, table lamps or floor-standing lamps, decorative light strings, electric fireplace logs, lanterns (fuelled by carbide, electricity, gas, gasoline, and kerosene), street-lighting equipment (except traffic signals), and solar-powered lighting equipment, including electric-lamp components such as starters, filaments, and reflectors. This group also covers the manufacture of lamps using or containing radioactive substances.
This group does not cover the manufacture of ballasts, which is covered in group 27113.

This group covers the manufacture of general-purpose metal fittings not included in groups 25931 to 25933, such as locks, padlocks, door locks, hinges, latches, and similar fittings for buildings, furniture, and others.

This group covers the manufacture of safety protective equipment, such as protective clothing and fire-resistant clothing, linesman's safety belts and other belts for work purposes, life buoys, hard plastic hats (construction helmets) and other plastic safety gear (sports helmets and all kinds of similar helmets), fire-protective clothing, bulletproof vests, radiation-protection equipment (aprons, gloves), metal protective headgear and other personal protective equipment made of metal, ear and nose plugs (e.g. for swimming and nose protection) and gas masks, and PPE including face shields.

This group covers the manufacture of adhesives/glues for industrial or household use derived from plants, animals, or plastics, such as starch, bone glue, cellulose esters and ethers, phenol formaldehyde, urea formaldehyde, melamine formaldehyde, and epoxy adhesives.

This group covers the manufacture of carpentry hand tools, such as pliers and screwdrivers; agricultural hand tools, such as hoes, shovels, sickles, palm-harvesting sickles (egrek), palm-harvesting chisels (dodos), and axes; accessories for hand tools, whether power-driven or not, such as drill bits, hammers, and grinding blades. This group also covers the manufacture of pressing tools, mould boxes and moulds (except ingot moulds), seaming tools, and blacksmithing tools, such as forging tools and anvils.
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of ingot moulds, see group 28230.

This group covers the manufacture of clothing accessories from leather or imitation leather by cutting and sewing into ready-to-wear items, such as hats, gloves, belts, headbands, and hairnets, including the manufacture of headgear from fur and parts of the products mentioned above.

This group covers the manufacture of clothing accessories from textile/fabric (woven, knitted, or non-woven) by cutting and sewing into ready-to-wear items, such as hats, caps, headbands, ties, sarongs, gloves, prayer veils (mukena), shawls, headscarves, belts, scarves, hairbands, tuxedo bow ties, and hairnets, including the manufacture of soleless footwear, such as slippers and parts of the products mentioned above. This group also covers the manufacture of woven hats and the manufacture of clothing accessories from patchwork and embroidery.

This group covers the manufacture of plastic pipes and hoses, such as plastic pipes and hoses, including plastic tubing and pipe fittings. These articles may be made of plastics such as polyvinyl chloride (PVC), polyethylene (PE), or polypropylene (PP).

This group covers the manufacture of products from petroleum waste materials for reuse, for example used lubricating oil processed into fuel or lubricating oil. The manufacture of products from petroleum waste materials other than lubricating oil is classified in group 19209.

This group covers the manufacture of clay or ceramic products for building-material purposes other than bricks and roof tiles, such as drainage conduits, tiles, ventilation blocks, and well rings, including non-refractory ceramic stoves or wall tiles, mosaic cubes and the like, non-refractory ceramic paving or tiles, roofing tiles, chimneys, pipes, ceramic conduits and the like, and floor blocks made of fired clay.
This group does not cover the manufacture of sanitary fixtures from clay or porcelain, see groups 23934 and 23935.

This group covers the manufacture of basic chemical products in the form of dyes and pigments, such as red lead, chrome yellow, zinc yellow, barium sulphate, aluminium powder pigments, ochre, titanium-based pigments, including their cyclic intermediates such as phenol intermediates and their derivatives, as well as textile dyes and dyes for food and medicines.
This group does not cover the manufacture of dye and pigment preparations with special formulations, see subgroup 2022.

This group covers the manufacture of radioactive basic chemical products, for example uranium, radium, thorium, and radon, including the enrichment of uranium and thorium ores and the manufacture of radioisotopes from radioactive substances.

This group covers the manufacture of other products derived from petroleum refining, such as asphalt/tar, rubber-modified asphalt, bitumen and waxes (which may be used for road surfacing, roofing, wood, paper and the like), as well as petroleum coke, including the manufacture of products for the petrochemical industry and various products such as white spirit, petroleum jelly (vaseline), and paraffin wax. This group also covers the manufacture of products from petroleum waste materials other than lubricating oils, such as sludge oil.
This group covers the manufacture of structural steel metal products for heavy construction, such as for bridges, hangar buildings, high-voltage electricity towers, and floodgates.

This group covers the manufacture of non-aluminium structural metal products, such as iron fences, grilles, doors, windows, ventilation louvres, stairs, and other light construction products.
This group does not cover the manufacture of structural steel metal products for heavy construction, such as for bridges, high-voltage electricity towers, floodgates, and the like, which are included in group 25113; while the manufacture of steam boilers, pressure vessels, and the like is included in group 25130.

This group covers the manufacture of structural metal products of aluminium, such as window frames, door frames, aluminium grilles, aluminium awnings, rolling doors, aluminium blinds, and other light construction products.

This group covers the manufacture of other structural metal products for construction not covered in groups 25111 to 25113, including the manufacture of non-steel structural metal products for heavy construction.

This group covers the manufacture of food products from coconut, such as thick and thin coconut milk, coconut milk powder, coconut soy sauce (kecap kelapa), nata de coco, desiccated coconut, coconut cream, and coconut flour.

This group covers the manufacture of other prepared food products not classified elsewhere; soups and broths; honey and artificial caramel; perishable foods such as sandwiches and uncooked pizza; sausage casings of collagen, cellulose, animal intestines, and others; probiotics; yeast; extracts and juices of meat, fish, crustaceans, and molluscs; egg products, for example salted eggs, and egg albumin; artificial concentrates, for example essences; protein food products such as soy protein, texturized vegetable protein, and hydrolysed vegetable protein (HVP); food additives derived from plants, animals, or microorganisms, such as pectin; artificial sweeteners, such as stevia; and other food products not covered in any group, such as grass jelly (cincau).

This group covers the manufacture of products through purification, smelting, direct reduction or other metallurgical processes, and other chemical processes from non-metallic minerals or their derivatives, yielding products with different physical and chemical properties, whether in the form of lumps, powder, granules, ingots, pellets, rods, wire, discs, or other forms. Examples of products from this activity are metallurgical-grade silicon (silicon metal), polysilicon, and silicon ingots.
This group covers the manufacture of dental adhesive products.

This group covers the manufacture of other tobacco products, such as cigars, kretek cigars, klembak menyan cigarettes, klobot cigarettes, and kawung cigarettes. This group also covers the manufacture of fine cut tobacco, pipe tobacco, snuff, homogenised or reconstituted tobacco, molasses tobacco, and chewing tobacco, including nicotine pouches.

This group covers the manufacture of fertilizers containing micronutrients, such as zinc, iron, copper, manganese, boron, and molybdenum; and the manufacture of single fertilizers containing beneficial nutrients, such as cobalt, silicon, sodium, iodine, titanium, and selenium.

This group covers the manufacture of kretek cigarettes containing shredded tobacco, shredded dried tobacco leaf, shredded cloves, and added flavouring ingredients, producing a distinctively aromatic blend that is rolled manually by hand using various wrapping materials (ambri, cigarette paper, or tipping). This activity covers the manufacture of hand-rolled kretek cigarettes and filtered hand-rolled kretek cigarettes.
This group covers the manufacture of cigarettes that do not contain a clove component.

This group covers the manufacture of cream soap and dishwashing soap; the manufacture of detergents and other household cleaning agents; paper, wadding, textiles, and the like coated with soap or detergent, such as wet wipes; crude glycerol; surface-active preparations, such as washing powders, whether solid or liquid, and detergents, dishwashing preparations, and fabric softeners; cleaning and polishing products, such as room fresheners and deodorisers, artificial and prepared waxes, polishes and creams for leather goods, polishes and creams for wood, glass and metal polishes, scouring pastes and powders, including paper, wadding, and others coated with scouring pastes and powders; household antiseptic and disinfectant products. This group does not cover the manufacture of bath soap, see group 20232.

This group covers the manufacture of plant-based milks from various types of plants, for example soy milk, oat milk, and almond, cashew, or other nut milks, as well as the manufacture of plant-based creamers and plant-based fat emulsions derived from coconut or oil palm used as ingredients in food or beverages. This group also covers the manufacture of cheese substitutes.

This group covers the manufacture of pigment and dye preparations, colourants and opacifiers, glazing enamels and glazes and similar preparations, printing inks, artists' paints, and other coating materials.

This group covers the manufacture of all kinds of paper/paperboard packaging and boxes used for wrapping/packing, including the manufacture of boxes for cigarettes and other goods, for example packaging and boxes of corrugated paper and paperboard, folding paperboard packaging and boxes, packaging and boxes of solid board, other packaging and boxes of paper and paperboard, paper sacks and bags, and office file boxes and similar articles.

This group covers the manufacture of footwear specifically for field-technical/industrial use, including the manufacture of parts of such footwear, whether of leather, imitation leather, rubber, textile, or plastic, such as chemical-resistant footwear, heat-resistant footwear, and safety footwear.

This group covers the manufacture of footwear specifically designed for sports use, of leather and imitation leather, rubber, plastic, and textile, such as football boots, basketball shoes, tennis shoes, athletic shoes, gymnastics shoes, jogging shoes, running shoes, hiking shoes, and ballet shoes, including the manufacture of parts of such footwear. This group does not cover the manufacture of ski boots (see group 32300).

This group covers the manufacture of synthetic or artificial filament fibres or strips in the form of tow, based on polyamide, polyester, polypropylene, acrylic, rayon, cellulose acetate, and the like, for further processing.

This group covers the manufacture of synthetic or artificial staple fibres based on polyamide, polyester, rayon, acrylic, cellulose acetate, and the like (except glass fibre and optical fibre) for further processing. Staple fibres are fibres in short lengths.

This group covers the manufacture of kretek cigarettes containing shredded tobacco, shredded dried tobacco leaf, shredded cloves, and other added flavouring ingredients, producing a distinctively aromatic blend, rolled automatically by machine using various wrapping materials (ambri, cigarette paper, or tipping). This group covers the manufacture of machine-rolled kretek cigarettes and filtered machine-rolled kretek cigarettes.

This group covers the manufacture of tubes, pipes, and pipe fittings of iron and steel, including the manufacture of seamless steel tubes, pipes, and hollow profiles produced by hot rolling, hot drawing or hot extruding, cold rolling or cold drawing; the manufacture of welded steel tubes and pipes produced by welding and hot or cold forming, as a further process from cold rolling or cold drawing; and the manufacture of steel pipe fittings, such as flat flanges and flanges with forged collar, butt-welded fittings, threaded fittings, and socket-welded fittings.
This group covers the manufacture of tubes, pipes, and pipe fittings of non-ferrous metals.
This group covers the manufacture of tofu from soybeans. The manufacture of tofu whose raw material is not soybeans (for example peanuts or other legumes) is included in group 10309.

This group covers the manufacture of suitcases, handbags, backpacks, and the like, of leather, composition leather, or other materials using the same technology as that used for leather, including bags for carrying animals/pet carriers. This group also covers the manufacture of non-metallic watch straps and the manufacture of leather shoelaces as well as other articles such as wallets, vanity cases, weapon holsters, and spectacle cases.
This group does not cover the manufacture of baskets, containers, and bags of woven materials (bamboo, rattan, straw, paper straw, plastic, and the like), see groups 16291 and 16292.

This group covers the manufacture of textiles not covered in any group, such as the manufacture of rubber thread, metallic yarn, shoelaces, ornamental trimmings (such as braids, tassels, pompons, and others), and badges.

This group covers the manufacture of tempeh from soybeans. The manufacture of tempeh whose raw material is not soybeans (for example peanuts or other legumes), such as tempe bongkrek, is included in group 10309.
This group covers the manufacture of rice flour and corn flour, including corn grits.

This group covers the manufacture of flour mixes and prepared flour doughs for bread, cakes, biscuits, and pancakes, including batter flours, for example flour for coating the surface of fish or chicken meat, seasoned flour, fritter (bakwan) flour, meatball flour, premixes for cereal-based desserts, as well as egg-free starches and custard powders.

This group covers the production of flour from various tubers, rhizomes, and vegetables through milling, such as flour from cassava (dried cassava/gaplek), sweet potato, taro, arrowroot, ginger, java turmeric (temulawak), turmeric, cardamom, and vegetables.

This group covers the manufacture of transformers, current converters, and their components or parts, such as distribution transformers, power transformers, special transformers, alternating-current (AC) to direct-current (DC) converters, radiators, and commutators, including electrical distribution transformers, arc-welding transformers, fluorescent or lighting ballasts, substation transformers for electric power distribution, as well as regulators for the transmission and distribution of electrical voltage.

This group covers the manufacture of non-electric furnaces and similar equipment for heating, roasting, and melting iron ore, metals, and the like; firing furnaces; central heating boilers; boilers for processing (industrial boilers); boilers for power generation (utility boilers); scrubbers; and solar water heaters, including the manufacture of coal combustion chambers in steam locomotives (mechanical stokers), grates, mechanical grates, and mechanical ash dischargers.

This group covers the manufacture of furnaces, ovens, and other heating equipment that require electric current for operation, for example electric induction equipment for industry and laboratories, including incinerators, firing furnaces, household refrigeration and ventilation equipment, and electric furnaces for household use.
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of heat-control equipment for food, beverages, and tobacco, including non-electric ovens for bread-making, see group 28250;
- the manufacture of heat-control equipment for pulp, paper, and other industrial materials, see groups 28292 and 28299.
This group covers the production of fragrances or perfumes specially blended to order based on the customer's chosen scent, such as the production of refill perfumes.
This group covers the manufacture of wigs (false hair), false beards, false eyelashes, and other similar products.

This group covers the manufacture, processing, and repackaging of finished-form (preparation) medicines for animals, for example in the form of powders, tablets, capsules, ointments, solutions, suspensions, and aerosols, including the manufacture of surgical suture products, medical diagnostic devices, the production of radioisotopes for radiopharmaceuticals, biotechnology pharmaceuticals, and medical dressings, as well as bandages and the like specifically intended for animals.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemelihar: This group covers the rearing, grow-out, and harvesting of non-protected freshwater aquatic plants, including ornamental plants and microalgae, such as Anubias spp., java moss, and java fern, including the hatchery of freshwater aquatic plants. This group also covers the cultivation of freshwater aquatic plants aimed at the natural absorption and storage of carbon, as well as the sale of carbon credits or emission-reduction certificates resulting from the cultivation activity. These activities may be carried out on land, in waters, and in other artificial facilities that use freshwater as the cultivation medium.

This group covers the rearing, grow-out, and harvesting of non-protected marine aquatic plants, such as seaweed of various species (e.g. Kappaphycus spp., Eucheuma spp., Sargassum spp., and Ulva spp.) and microalgae, including the hatchery of marine aquatic plants. This group also covers the cultivation of marine aquatic plants aimed at the natural absorption and storage of carbon, as well as the sale of carbon credits or emission-reduction certificates resulting from the cultivation activity. These activities may be carried out in the sea, river estuaries, lagoons, other tidal-influenced areas, and other artificial facilities that use seawater as the cultivation medium.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemeringk: This group covers the rating of debt securities, sukuk, asset-backed securities, or other rateable securities as well as parties as entities (company rating), including mutual funds and real estate investment trusts in the form of collective investment contracts. This rating is carried out to provide information to investors on a party's ability to meet its payment obligations in full and on time, expressed through a predetermined rating system.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemerinta: This group covers government activities in the development of the Islamic, Protestant, Catholic, Hindu, Buddhist, and Confucian religions, with the aim of strengthening devotion to the One Almighty God and achieving harmony among religious communities, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of religious affairs.

This group covers government activities in the development of culture/the arts/recreation/sports, such as museums, galleries, libraries, historical sites/objects, cultural heritage, various regional arts, and the organization of recreation and sports, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of youth and sports and of government institutions in the field of culture and the arts.

This group covers government activities in the development of health, with the responsibility to provide guidance and advice and to make decisions in the field of health services, the procurement of medicines, public health, and disease prevention, including the development of clean water supply, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of health.

This group covers government activities in the development of social services other than health, education, religion, and culture not yet included in groups 84121 to 84126, for example government institutions in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.

This group covers government activities in the development of education, with the responsibility to provide guidance and advice and to make decisions in the field of education, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of education, whether primary, secondary, or higher education.

This group covers government activities in the administration and development of social security, social assistance, and social rehabilitation, for example the activities of government institutions in the social field.

This group covers government activities in the development of housing facilities and infrastructure that meet residential standards, such as cleanliness and aesthetics, with the aim of creating a healthy and prosperous society, for example the activities of government institutions in the field of public housing.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemintala: This group covers the spinning of fibers into yarn, except sewing thread, from various raw materials, whether new or recycled materials, including texturizing, twisting, folding, cabling, and covering/dipping of synthetic and artificial yarns. This group also covers the manufacture of paper yarn.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemisahan: This group covers the separation of the solid fraction (stearin) and the liquid fraction (olein) from crude palm oil into crude palm olein and crude palm stearin, or from crude palm kernel oil into crude palm kernel olein and crude palm kernel stearin, which still require further processing.

This group covers the separation of the solid fraction (stearin) and the liquid fraction (olein) from refined palm kernel oil into refined bleached deodorized palm kernel olein and refined bleached deodorized palm kernel stearin.

This group covers the separation of the solid fraction (stearin) and the liquid fraction (olein) from refined palm oil into refined bleached deodorized palm olein and refined bleached deodorized palm stearin.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemotonga: This group covers the cutting, grinding, and polishing of gemstones and the like, such as jewellery diamonds, jewellery brilliants, agate/precious stones, and imitation diamonds. This group also covers activities to enhance or alter the colour of gemstones through irradiation processes.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemunguta: This group covers the gathering of forest wood and residues produced from the felling of forest trees, for example shrubs, tree stumps, wood chips, and other forestry waste for energy. This group also covers the traditional production of charcoal associated with forestry activities.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemupukan: This group covers the fertilization of agricultural land on a fee or contract basis.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pemurnian: This group covers the refining and processing of petroleum to produce fuels such as aviation gasoline (avgas), aviation turbine fuel (avtur), gasoline, kerosene, gas oil, diesel oil, fuel oil or petrol, and solvents, including liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) derived from petroleum refining.

This group covers the refining of crude palm oil into refined bleached deodorized palm oil, or of palm kernel oil into refined bleached deodorized palm kernel oil, which still requires further processing.

This group covers the refining, smelting, and alloying and casting of non-ferrous metals in primary forms (ingots, billets, slabs, rods, pellets, blocks, sheets, pig metal, powder, and granules) such as brass ingots, aluminium ingots, zinc ingots, copper ingots, tin ingots, brass billets, aluminium billets, brass slabs, aluminium slabs, brass rods, aluminium rods, brass pellets, aluminium pellets, cathodes, and bearing metal (anti-friction metal), as well as rare earth metals and rare earth metal alloys (the 15 lanthanide elements plus the elements scandium and yttrium).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penagihan: This group covers the collection of claim payments and the remittance of collected payments to clients, such as bill or debt collection services.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penampung: This group covers the impounding and abstraction of water from surface water, groundwater, seawater, and the like, as well as its treatment into drinking water and the distribution of drinking water through piped and non-piped networks, such as tanker trucks (provided that such tanker trucks remain under a single administrative management of the drinking water company), for sale to consumers or customers.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penanaman: This group covers the planting of agricultural commodity seeds on a fee or contract basis.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penangkar: This group covers the captive propagation of wild plants, including vegetative reproduction through stem cuttings, slips, and seedlings for the continued breeding of the plants.

This group covers the captive breeding, rearing, and propagation of wild animals of the mammal, reptile (other than crocodiles and alligators), bird, insect, and other species for conservation purposes.
This group does not cover the captive breeding of crocodiles and alligators, see group 032.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pencampur: This group covers the blending of petroleum refinery products with biofuels, such as blending alcohol with petroleum (e.g. gasohol) and blending diesel with FAME (biodiesel).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pencarian: This group covers news-gathering activities carried out by individuals as source material for information, self-published through print or digital media.

This group covers the exploration and drilling for geothermal energy, including at sites within forest areas, and other activities related to the exploitation of geothermal energy up to the point of its use.
This group also covers the separation of associated minerals derived from geothermal energy exploitation activities.
This group does not cover the conversion of geothermal energy into electric power, see division 35.

This group covers the exploration, drilling, extraction, separation, and storage of natural gas, comprising native hydrogen gas and other natural gases, carried out as a single chain of activities. This group also covers coalbed methane (CBM) mining activities.
This group does not cover
- the manufacture of industrial gases, see group 20112;
- the manufacture of synthetic hydrogen, such as by electrolysis and steam methane reformer, see group 35201.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pencatata: This group covers the recording and communication of job-vacancy information to jobseekers and the provision of jobseekers' data and competency information to employers. These activities may be carried out online (through job portals).

This group covers the recording of job vacancies and the referral or placement of workers into a job, where the placed workers are not employees of the placement agency, other than those already classified under groups 78101 through 78105, such as casting-agency activities (selection of theatre performers and the like) and talent-search activities.
This group covers the recording of securities ownership and the distribution of rights related to securities and/or securities issuers, based on contracts with issuers.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penciptaa: This group covers the creation of musical compositions, whether by songwriters, composers, or music arrangers, including work carried out on behalf of others.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pencucian: This group covers car washing and car detailing activities, such as washing and polishing, and the fitting of spare parts and accessories that are not part of a processing/manufacturing operation.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pendaftar: This group covers the registration, screening, and placement of workers for activities across various business sectors within the country. In this group, the placed workers are not employees of the placement agency. This group also covers the provision of executive personnel to third parties. This group does not cover the provision of workers for household activities where the household is the domestic employer, such as the placement of domestic assistants and private drivers, see group 78102.
This group covers the registration, screening, placement, and protection of workers for ship crews, both merchant vessels and fishing vessels, domestically and abroad.

This group covers the registration, screening, placement, and protection of workers for household activities where the household is the domestic employer, such as the placement of domestic assistants, infant caregivers, non-medical elderly carers, private drivers, and various other household positions. In this group, the placed workers are not employees of the placement agency. This group does not cover the placement of infant nurses and childminders whose workers are employees of the placement agency, see group 78200.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pendedean: This group covers the nursery rearing, husbandry, grow-out, breeding or hatchery production, and harvesting of non-protected freshwater ornamental fish. These activities may be carried out on land, in waters, and in other artificial facilities using brackish water as the culture medium.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pendedera: This group covers the nursery rearing, grow-out, breeding or hatchery production, and harvesting of finfish and other non-protected brackish-water organisms to a certain age, form, and size for consumption or as inputs for grow-out aquaculture. Examples of cultured brackish-water organisms include milkfish, pangasius (catfish), saline tilapia, barramundi, mud crab, tiger prawn, and whiteleg shrimp (vaname). These activities may be carried out on land, in waters, and in other artificial facilities using brackish water as the culture medium.

This group covers the nursery rearing, husbandry, grow-out, breeding or hatchery production, and harvesting of finfish and other non-protected freshwater organisms to a certain age, form, and size for consumption or as inputs for grow-out aquaculture. Examples of cultured freshwater organisms include common carp, tilapia, pangasius (catfish), gourami, snakehead, giant snakehead, mozambique tilapia, java barb, catfish (lele), and frogs. Culture activities may be carried out in inland public freshwaters such as lakes, reservoirs, rivers, other standing waters, and in artificial facilities using freshwater as the culture medium.

This group covers the nursery rearing, husbandry, grow-out, breeding or hatchery production, and harvesting of finfish and other non-protected marine organisms to a certain age, form, and size for consumption or as inputs for grow-out aquaculture. Examples of cultured marine organisms include grouper, barramundi, cobia, silver pompano, trevally, lobster, mud crab, swimming crab, shellfish, oysters, squid, sea urchin, sea cucumber, jellyfish, turtles, sea turtles, sea lions, and seals. Culture activities may be carried out at sea, in river estuaries, lagoons, other tidally-influenced areas, and in other artificial facilities using seawater as the culture medium. This group does not cover the culture of marine ornamental fish (see group 03212).

This group covers the nursery rearing, husbandry, grow-out, breeding or hatchery production, and harvesting of non-protected marine ornamental fish, such as seahorses, clownfish, pyjama angelfish, and blue devil. These activities may be carried out at sea, in river estuaries, lagoons, artificial facilities, or other locations using seawater as the culture medium.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pendidika: This group covers out-of-school education organised by the government, generally in the form of courses/training to add to or support skills/competencies, such as courses for administrative staff, courses for senior administrative staff, upgrading and competency development for teachers and education personnel, technical training centres, beauty courses (body treatment, bridal make-up), home economics (sewing, cooking, and nutrition education), health (first-aid, massage, acupuncture education), education related to nuclear-energy topics, and other courses, as well as business learning groups for adults.

This group covers handicraft and industrial education organised by the private sector. Activities included are educational or course services in weaving and handicrafts, embroidery, gift-wrapping, skills or home industry, batik-making, sewing, furniture-making, MPP, MPWA, woodworking, screen-printing, catering/cooking, dressmaking, textile weaving, wood carving, and the like.

This group covers other education organised by the private sector not yet covered under groups 85591 through 85598. This includes competency development for teachers and education personnel as well as course services for professional exam review, speed-reading instruction, lifeguard training, survival training, and public-speaking training, agribusiness, animation and cinema, announcing, broadcasting, cricket farming, cargo, entertainment and modelling, law, business law, tax law, journalism/reporting, seamanship, communication, master of ceremony (MC), notarial studies, tourism and hospitality, shipping (ship crew), legal advisory, broadcasting (announcers), fisheries, agriculture, animal husbandry, public relations, public speaking, show business, tours and travel, pollution control in waters and ports, the handling and transport of hazardous goods, the transport and handling of solid bulk cargo, and the like. This group also covers out-of-school education organised by the private sector that participates in providing education related to nuclear-energy topics.

This group covers management and banking education organised by the private sector. Activities included are educational or course services in business administration, office administration, health administration, administration, commercial administration, accounting, business accounting, banking accounting, office accounting, tax accounting, corporate accounting, insurance, export-import, customs and excise, entrepreneurship, management, administrative management, business management, informatics management, health management, financial management, financial and tax management, tourism management, training management, marketing/trade management, banking management, office management, corporate management, property, applied management, typing, marketing, fashion marketing, security, banking and capital markets, office work, taxation, polibisnis (multi-disciplinary business studies), home-care assistance, childcare assistance, domestic assistance, sales management, secretarial studies, urban planning, commercial trading, and the like.

This group covers engineering education organised by the private sector. Activities included are educational or course services in design, graphic design, interior design, electronics, engineering, electrical installation, construction, welding, automotive mechanics for cars and motorcycles, mapping, petroleum, building design/layout, research, engineering, industrial engineering, marine engineering, mechanical engineering, civil engineering, heavy-equipment technician, mobile-phone technician, computer technician, telecommunications, and the like.

This group covers educational activities in the form of courses aimed at improving skills/expertise in the field of languages, organized by private providers. The activities included in this group are courses in Arabic, Dutch, Indonesian, English, Italian, Javanese, Japanese, German, Korean, Mandarin, French, Russian, Sakura, Spanish and other languages. Also included are TOEFL, TOEIC and IELTS courses, and translation courses.

This group covers course-type education aimed at adding skills/expertise in the health field, organised by the private sector. Educational or course activities included in this group are beauty therapy, modern/traditional acupuncture, nursing assistant, baby sitter/infant carer, echocardiography, pharmacy, traditional herbal medicine (jamu), medical representative, medical-equipment training, traditional medicine, health nursing, first aid, reflexology, reflexology therapy, traditional Chinese medicine (shinse), spa, health support personnel, autism child therapy, zone therapy, TKK, TKR, medical ultrasonography, and the like.

This group covers educational activities in the form of courses aimed at enhancing skills/expertise in the field of computers and information and communication technology, organized by the private sector.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penetasan: This group covers egg-hatching activities on a fee or contract basis.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengacara:
This group covers the activities of lawyers/legal advisors, legal aid institutions, and other legal services, in respect of advisory assistance and representation in civil cases, criminal cases, administrative-law disputes, labor disputes, legal audit, and other activities, also including legal mediation activities and the activities of appointed legal guardians, without providing residential care/custody.
This group does not cover the activities of judicial executory bodies, see group 84233.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengajuan: This group covers the activities of filing and processing applications and other related activities in the field of intellectual property, encompassing patents, copyrights, trademarks, geographical indications, industrial designs, integrated circuit layout designs, trade secrets, and others.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengangku: This group covers the specialised transport of the sick, such as by aircraft and ambulance, under specific circumstances, to cities or provinces within the country.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengaweta: This group covers the preservation of fruit, nuts, fruit peel, and other parts of plants by sweetening and drying processes, whether packaged or not, such as candied nutmeg and dried candied mango.

This group covers the preservation of fruits and vegetables by drying, whether packaged or not, yielding products such as raisins (grapes), dried shallots, dried garlic, dried chillies, dried bamboo shoots, potato flour, dried mashed potato, and dried mushrooms. This group also covers the production of fruit and vegetable crisps, for example potato chips and potato snacks; the production of freeze-dried fruits; and the drying of tubers, such as the drying of cassava and porang (elephant-foot yam).

This group covers the preservation of fruits and vegetables by pulping, whether packaged or not, yielding products such as mango jam, marmalade (orange jam), mulberry jelly, fruit and vegetable purées, legume pastes, and ground chilli.

This group covers the preservation of fruits and vegetables by freezing, yielding both ready-to-consume products and input products for subsequent production activities, such as frozen mangoes, frozen strawberries, and frozen potatoes. This group also covers the freezing of tubers, for example the freezing of cassava and porang (Amorphophallus muelleri).

This group covers the preservation of fruits and vegetables by salting, whether packaged or not, yielding products such as pickled ambarella and pickled carrot. This group does not cover the preservation of fruits and vegetables in sugar (see group 10733).

This group covers the preservation of finfish by freezing, yielding products such as frozen milkfish, frozen tuna, frozen skipjack tuna, and frozen snapper. The freezing referred to may be carried out on whole fish or on cut fish, for example in the form of fillet, loin, saku, steak, chunk, and brown meat. This group does not cover the service of chilling fish with ice for the purpose of maintaining the freshness of the fish, see group 03300.
This group covers the preservation of wood by drying, chemical treatment, and the impregnation of wood with preservatives or other substances.

This group covers the preservation of crustaceans, molluscs, echinoderms, and other aquatic biota by freezing, yielding products such as frozen shrimp, frozen frog legs, frozen cephalopods (squid/cuttlefish/octopus), frozen crab/swimming crab, and frozen shellfish. This activity does not cover the service of chilling crustaceans, molluscs, and other aquatic biota with ice for the purpose of maintaining their freshness, see group 03300.

This group covers the preservation of hides and skins, whether by drying, salting, or pickling, such as hides of large animals (cattle, buffalo), skins of small animals (sheep, goats), reptile skins (crocodile, snake, monitor lizard), fish skins (stingray, shark, snapper, eel), and the skins of other animals.
This group covers the preservation of rattan, bamboo, and the like.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengecata: This group covers the interior and exterior painting of buildings as part of the completion of residential and non-residential buildings as well as civil-engineering works. This group does not cover the painting of building roofs.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengelant: This group covers bleaching, dyeing, finishing, and other finishing of fibres, yarn, and sewing thread.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengelola: This group covers the management of hunting activities in an area containing potential game animals, whether in the form of a hunting garden, hunting park, or hunting ground intended for recreation or sport, including the provision of hunting facilities and infrastructure, such as Lingga Isaq Hunting Park (Aceh), Gunung Masigit Kareumbi Hunting Park (West Java), Komara Hunting Park (South Sulawesi), and Moyo Hunting Park.

This group covers the management and utilisation/use of forest areas by the government that function to protect ecosystems, water systems, and against erosion, and to maintain soil fertility, such as Bukit Daun Protected Forest in Bengkulu.

This group covers the management of tourist attractions that make use of agricultural areas and activities, comprising the cultivation of food crops and horticulture, plantation crops, fisheries, and livestock, as the primary tourist object. Activities in this group aim to provide an agriculture-based tourism experience that may be recreational, educational, or participatory in nature.
This group covers production, collection, conservation, product processing, cultivation, and agricultural education activities, as well as the presentation of the cultural values of the local farming community, carried out in support of the tourism function. Such activities may be supplemented by the provision of supporting facilities, such as food and beverage services, visitor interaction areas, and facilities for the sale of agricultural products, such as fruit gardens, garden tours, as well as coffeeneries and wineries.
This group does not cover agricultural activities carried out for the purpose of producing agricultural commodities as the main business without development of a tourism function, see section 01.

This group covers forest management, comprising planting, replanting, and the conservation of forests and woodland. This group also covers forest management aimed at the natural absorption and storage of carbon (carbon sequestration) carried out in natural forests, semi-natural forests, or planted forests, as well as the sale of carbon credits or emission-reduction certificates resulting from forest management activities.
This group does not cover the inventory/recording of carbon sequestration from forests carried out by third parties, see category N.

This group covers the management of nature conservation areas for the provision of facilities in the utilisation block and the business of providing nature-tourism services aimed at tourism and nature recreation, such as Pulau Weh Nature Tourism Park (Aceh), Tangkuban Perahu Nature Tourism Park (West Java), Teluk Lasolo Nature Tourism Park (Southeast Sulawesi), Pananjung Pangandaran Nature Tourism Park (West Java), and Batu Putih Nature Tourism Park (North Sulawesi).

This group covers the management of nature conservation areas that possess native ecosystems, managed by zoning to operate the business of providing nature-tourism facilities in the utilisation zone, aimed at enhancing the use of unique natural phenomena and natural beauty, such as Gunung Gede Pangrango National Park (West Java), Gunung Leuser National Park (Aceh), Kelimutu National Park (East Nusa Tenggara), Komodo National Park (East Nusa Tenggara), Gunung Palung National Park (West Kalimantan), and Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park (East Java).

This group covers the management of timber within forests, from planting through to felling, with output in the form of roundwood. This activity may be carried out in natural forests, semi-natural forests, or planted forests.
This group covers the management of securities portfolios, collective investment, and/or other investment portfolios on behalf of a group of clients or individual clients based on sharia principles.
This group covers the management of securities portfolios, collective investments, and/or other investment portfolios on behalf of a group of clients or individual clients on a conventional basis.
This group covers risk management based on sharia principles for risks faced by sharia insurance companies, sharia guarantee companies, or other sharia reinsurance companies.

This group covers the management of the People's Housing Savings scheme (Tapera), carried out through the activities of mobilising Tapera funds, growing Tapera funds, and/or utilising Tapera funds. The said management of Tapera funds may be carried out conventionally or based on sharia principles.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengemasa: This group covers packaging on a fee or contract basis for materials and products of agriculture, plantation, forestry, and fisheries, whether using an automated or manual process. This group covers the bottling of liquids, the packaging of solids, labelling, stamping, and product sterilisation related to packing, and other packing-related activities for materials and products of agriculture, plantation, forestry, and fisheries.

This group covers packaging on a fee or contract basis, whether using an automated or manual process, for processed food and beverage materials and products. This group covers the bottling of liquids, including beverages and foods, the packaging of solids (blister packaging, wrapping with aluminium foil, etc.), labelling, stamping, the sterilisation of products related to packing, and other packing-related activities for processed food and beverage materials and products.

This group covers packaging on a fee or contract basis, whether using an automated or manual process, for textiles and textile products. This group covers packaging, secure wrapping, labelling, stamping, product sterilisation, and other packing-related activities for textiles and textile products.

This group covers packaging on a fee or contract basis, whether using an automated or manual process, for chemical materials and products. This group covers the bottling of liquids, the packaging of solids (blister packaging, wrapping with aluminium foil, etc.), secure packaging for chemical materials and products, labelling, stamping, product sterilisation, and other packing-related activities for chemical materials and products.

This group covers packaging on a fee or contract basis, whether using an automated or manual process, for pharmaceutical or medicinal materials and products. This group covers the bottling of liquid pharmaceutical materials and products, the packaging of solid pharmaceutical materials and products (blister packaging, wrapping with aluminium foil, etc.), secure packaging for medicines and medicinal materials, labelling, stamping, product sterilisation, and other packing-related activities for pharmaceutical materials and products.
