This group covers packaging activities such as the bottling of liquids, the packaging of solids, labelling, stamping, and product sterilisation on a fee or contract basis, whether using an automated or manual process, for products other than those in groups 82921 to 82925. This group also covers the packaging of parcels or gift hampers and gift wrapping.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengemban: This group covers the activities of developing, purchasing, selling, leasing, and operating specific areas for the trade of goods or services, such as malls, plazas, rest areas, and multi-purpose food courts.

This group covers the breeding of fish and marine aquatic biota protected under the appendices of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES) and/or restricted under the applicable laws and regulations, such as the Napoleon wrasse, seahorse, Banggai cardinalfish, and Clarion angelfish.

This group covers the breeding of fish and brackish-water aquatic biota protected under the appendices of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES) and/or under the applicable laws and regulations, such as the saltwater crocodile, Mahakam river dolphin, and dugong.

This group covers the breeding of fish and freshwater aquatic biota protected under the appendices of the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES) and/or under the applicable laws and regulations, such as the freshwater stingray, belida (featherback), cave loach (wader goa), selusur maninjau (Homaloptera gymnogaster), super red arowana, jardini arowana, zebra pleco, and motoro stingray.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengendal: This group covers the control of pests, diseases, and weeds on plants on a fee or contract basis.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengering: This group covers the drying of tobacco leaves by curing or by other means, including also the shredding of tobacco leaves.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengerjaa: This group covers the working of pearls and the manufacture of jewellery from pearls or of jewellery in which pearls are the principal material.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penggalia: This group covers the quarrying of pumice (a light-coloured type of rock containing froth formed of glass-walled bubbles, also commonly referred to as silicate volcanic glass rock), including its cleaning.

This group covers the quarrying of ornamental stone and building stone, such as marble, andesite (boulder stone, base course), tuff (paras), obsidian and granite, including the breaking, separating and cleaning thereof.
This group covers the quarrying of limestone, including the breaking, crushing, screening and grinding thereof.

This group covers the quarrying of other stone, sand and clay not classified under groups 08101 to 08108, such as the quarrying of diorite, basalt and breccia, as well as the dredging of marine sediment deposits, including the breaking, crushing, separating, screening and grinding thereof.
This group covers the quarrying of feldspar and calcite, as well as slate, including the breaking, crushing, screening and grinding thereof.
This group covers the quarrying of gypsum, including the cleaning and grinding thereof.
This group covers the quarrying of quartz/quartz sand/silica sand, including the breaking, crushing, screening and grinding thereof.

This group covers the extraction of soil and clay. The forming, crushing and milling of soil and clay are included in this group. The products obtained from the extraction of soil and clay include kaolin (china clay), ball clay (firing clay), fuller's earth, shale and fill soil.
This group covers the quarrying of trass (volcanic rock that has undergone chemical alteration due to weathering and groundwater conditions), including its cleaning.
This group covers the extraction, cleaning and separating of gravel. The products obtained from gravel extraction include sandstone, hard rock fragments and gravelly sand.

This group covers the extraction, cleaning and separating of sand. The products obtained from sand extraction include concrete sand, masonry sand (containing a small amount of soil), fill sand (containing a large amount of soil) and others.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penggilin: This group covers steel rolling, whether hot rolling or cold rolling, producing rolled products such as steel wire rod, round bar, flat bar, reinforcing steel, sections (H-beam, I-beam and the like), steel strip, steel rail, steel plate, hot-rolled sheet and cold-rolled sheet, whether or not coated with metal or other non-metal materials, including the rolling of steel scrap. This group also covers the manufacture of hot-rolled steel bars or coiled sections, the manufacture of hot-rolled open-section steel, the manufacture of steel bars and solid sections produced by cold drawing, grinding and turning, the manufacture of open-section steel produced by progressive cold forming on roll-forming machines or by folding on press machines or by rolling of flat steel, the manufacture of steel wire, whether single wire or strand, produced by cold drawing, tempering and stressing, the manufacture of steel sheet piling or welded open-section steel, as well as the manufacture of railway track materials of steel (rails not laid in place).
This group covers the milling of wheat and other cereals, such as sorghum, rye and oats, into flour and pellets.
This group covers the milling of wheat to produce wheat flour.

This group covers the rolling of non-ferrous metals, whether hot rolling or cold rolling, such as copper plate, aluminium plate, copper sheet, aluminium sheet, silver strip, zinc strip, aluminium strip, magnesium sheet, tin foil and platinum strip. This group also covers the drawing, tempering and stressing processes to produce metal wire, whether single wire or strand, and whether or not functioning as an electrical conductor.
This group does not cover the manufacture of tubes, pipes and pipe fittings of non-ferrous metal, see group 24205.
This group covers the milling of paddy into rice, including the polishing of rice.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penghimpu: This group covers the pooling and management of funds from individuals or groups of individuals to be invested in futures contracts, including parties acting as managing agents of futures fund centres.

This group covers the collection of savings from members and the disbursement of loans (credit) to members carried out on the basis of agreed profit-sharing or reasonable interest, for the economic welfare of its members, for example primary savings and loan cooperatives, secondary savings and loan cooperatives, and savings and loan business units of cooperatives, operated conventionally.

This group covers the collection of savings from members and the disbursement of loans (credit) to members carried out by cooperatives on the basis of sharia principles for the economic welfare of its members, for example primary savings and loan cooperatives, secondary savings and loan cooperatives, and savings and loan business units of cooperatives operated on the basis of sharia principles.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penghitun: This group covers the counting, measuring, weighing, and recording of cargo, on behalf of the cargo owner and/or the carrier, including independent tally activities at ports.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengolaha: This group covers the processing of raw water into bottled drinking water that is packaged and ready for direct consumption; whether or not containing minerals; with or without the addition of gas, such as oxygen or carbon dioxide; with or without the addition of minerals.

This group covers the processing of active ingredients into pest-control agents (pesticides) in ready-to-use form, such as insecticides, fungicides, rodenticides, herbicides, nematicides, molluscicides and acaricides, including also the manufacture of disinfectants for agricultural and other uses.
This group covers the processing of chemical substances into plant growth regulators, such as Atonik, Ethrel, Cepha, Dekamon, Mixtalol, Hidrasil and Sitozim.

This group covers the processing of animal materials other than fish into inedible crude animal oils and fats, such as tallow and oils from marine mammals. The manufacture of edible crude animal oils and fats is included in class 1012.

This group covers the processing of vegetable materials into crude oils, such as olive oil, soybean oil, peanut oil, sunflower seed oil, cottonseed oil, castor oil, mustard oil and linseed oil, which still require further processing and are usually used as inputs in other activities.
This group covers the processing of cocoa beans into cocoa powder, cocoa butter, cocoa fat, cocoa oil, cocoa paste, cocoa cake and other cocoa products.
This group covers the processing of oil palm kernels into crude palm kernel oil (CPKO), which still requires further processing and is usually used as an input in other activities.
This group covers the processing of oil palm fruit flesh into crude palm oil (CPO), which still requires further processing and is usually used as an input in other activities.

This group covers the processing and preservation of fruits and vegetables through airtight packaging or canning accompanied by a retort or pasteurisation process, producing products such as canned pineapple, canned rambutan, canned beans, canned mushrooms and canned carrots. The canning referred to encompasses not only packaging but constitutes a preservation process.

This group covers the processing and preservation of fruits and vegetables into fruit and vegetable juices, producing products such as fruit and vegetable juices, fruit juice powder, fruit juice concentrate, vegetable juice concentrate, and fruit and vegetable nectars. This group also covers the processing of fruit and vegetable juices into their derivative products.
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of artificial concentrates, see group 10799;
- the manufacture of fruit-flavoured beverages, see group 11053.

This group covers the processing and preservation of minced-fish-based or surimi-based products into further processed products, such as fish balls, nuggets, otak-otak, kamaboko, sausages, pempek, siomai, dim sum, chikuwa, and imitation crab sticks.

This group covers the processing and preservation of finfish through a fermentation process, such as fermentation for peda fish and dried bonito (ikan kayu), as well as the manufacture of fish sauce and fish-based shrimp paste (terasi ikan).
This group covers the processing and preservation of finfish through a process of mincing/grinding fish flesh to produce minced fish meat or surimi.

This group covers the processing and preservation of finfish through the pindang (salt-boiling) process, which yields products such as pindang milkfish/paso, pindang tuna, pindang cue, pindang naya, pindang lemuru/sardinella, pindang scad, and pindang skipjack.

This group covers the processing and preservation of finfish through a smoking or grilling process, which yields products such as smoked milkfish, smoked halfbeak/roa fish, smoked fufu/asar fish, smoked catfish, and smoked pangasius (ikan patin).

This group covers the processing and preservation of finfish through a salting or drying process, which yields products such as salted sardinella, salted anchovies, and unsalted dried fish. This group also covers the processing and preservation of salmon roe, caviar, and caviar substitutes.

This group covers the processing and preservation of fish through airtight packaging or canning accompanied by a retort or pasteurization process, which yields products such as canned sardines, canned sardinella, canned mackerel, and canned tuna. The operation of fish-processing vessels engaged solely in the processing and preservation of canned fish (without carrying out fishing activities) is included in this group.

This group covers the processing and preservation of crustaceans, mollusks, echinoderms, and other aquatic organisms through airtight packaging or canning accompanied by a retort or pasteurization process, which yields products such as canned shrimp, canned shellfish, canned squid or cuttlefish, and canned crab or swimming crab. The operation of processing vessels engaged solely in the processing and preservation of canned aquatic organisms (without carrying out fishing activities) is included in this group.

This group covers the processing and preservation of crustaceans, mollusks, echinoderms, and other aquatic organisms through a process of mincing/grinding the flesh, which yields products such as minced squid, minced shrimp, shrimp balls, squid balls, crab balls, and shrimp dragon claws (kaki naga udang).

This group covers the processing and preservation of crustaceans, mollusks, echinoderms, and other aquatic organisms through a salting or drying process, which yields products such as salted shrimp, salted squid, dried shrimp (ebi), salted jellyfish, salted cuttlefish, dried sea cucumber, and dried cuttlefish.

This group covers the processing and preservation of crustaceans, mollusks, echinoderms, and other aquatic organisms by methods other than those covered under groups 10291 through 10298, such as the manufacture of shrimp meal, shellfish meal, and frog meal. This group also covers the processing and preservation of other aquatic organisms by radiation (using an irradiator).

This group covers the processing and preservation of crustaceans, mollusks, echinoderms, and other aquatic organisms through a fermentation process, which yields products such as shrimp paste (terasi udang).
This group covers the processing and preservation of crustaceans, mollusks, echinoderms, and other aquatic organisms through the pindang (salt-boiling) process.

This group covers the processing and preservation of crustaceans, mollusks, echinoderms, and other aquatic organisms through a smoking or grilling process, which yields products such as smoked/grilled cuttlefish and smoked/grilled sea cucumber.

This group covers the processing of tea leaves into dried tea packaged in bags, sachets, capsules, or other packaging, including its derivative products, except ready-to-drink tea beverages; it also includes the blending of tea with natural ingredients such as mate, spices, herbs, and dried flowers. This group also covers the extraction of tea leaves, such as liquid or powdered tea-extract concentrate.

This group covers the processing of salt into food-grade industrial salt used in the manufacture of various foods and beverages. This group does not cover the manufacture of iodized table salt, see group 10772.
This group covers the processing of salt into iodized table salt.

This group covers the processing of sugar into syrup, such as sugar syrup as well as maple syrup and maple sugar. The manufacture of syrup that is integrated with a sugar mill and cannot be separated on its own is included in group 10721 or 10722.
This group covers the activity of processing herbal infusions, such as mint, vervain, and chamomile, including the manufacture of non-tea herbal brews and refreshing beverages.
This group covers the processing of wet maize into dried shelled maize.
This group covers the processing of kapok.
This group covers the processing of natural rubber that yields other semi-finished rubber products, such as concentrated latex and liquid rubber (depolymerized rubber).
This group covers the processing of rubber by smoking, which yields products such as ribbed smoked sheet (RSS) rubber, including smoked rubber sheets.

This group covers the processing of rubber by milling to produce rubber in sheet form, such as smooth rubber sheet and crepe rubber.
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of smoked rubber sheets, see group 22121;
- the manufacture of rubber sheets to which additives have been added, see group 22192.
This group covers the processing of rubber that yields crumb rubber.

This group covers the processing of wood for the manufacture of prefabricated buildings, such as mobile homes and caravans, together with their components in which the predominant material is wood. This group also covers the manufacture of wooden partitions (excluding free-standing room dividers/furniture). The manufacture of free-standing wooden partitions is classified under group 31011.
This group covers the processing of coconut into crude oil, including the production of copra pellets obtained as a by-product of coconut oil manufacture.
This group covers the working of agricultural land on a fee or contract basis for the purpose of preparing for planting, whether on paddy fields or non-paddy land.

This group covers the further processing of essential oils falling under group 20294 into various downstream essential-oil products serving as raw materials for the production of flavours and fragrances, including for the production of various chemicals based on downstream essential-oil processing, and including the manufacture of fuel bio-additives from essential oils, such as blends of essential oils and natural aromatic substances, odoriferous preparation products from essential oils for flavour and fragrance use, essential-oil-based bio-additives, and oleoresins obtained by extraction.
This group covers the further processing of crude coconut oil, for example refining, bleaching, and deodorizing to remove undesirable odors, into coconut cooking oil.

This group covers further processing activities — such as refining, bleaching, and deodorization (removal of undesirable odors) — of crude palm oil (CPO) into ready-to-consume palm cooking oil, including the processing of red palm oil and/or the addition of certain substances to cooking oil to enhance quality/added value.

This group covers the processing of various extracts and crude drugs (simplicia), galenic preparations, additives, or other materials — whether medicinally active or inactive, whether altered or unaltered — used in the processing of natural medicines, even though not all such materials remain present in the bulk product.

This group covers the processing of various extracts and crude drugs (simplicia), galenic preparations, additives, or other materials — whether medicinally active or inactive, whether altered or unaltered — used in the processing of natural medicines for animals.

This group covers the processing of various natural-medicine products for animals, the ingredients of which derive, among other sources, from plants, animal materials, mineral materials, galenic preparations, or mixtures thereof, in the form of powders, shredded materials, pills, dodol/jenang (taffy-like confections), pastilles, tablets, capsules, liquids, solutions, emulsions and suspensions, ointments, creams and gels, and suppositories.

This group covers the processing of various natural-medicine products whose ingredients use natural resources in raw form or not yet subjected to further processing — from plants, animals, microorganisms, minerals, or mixtures thereof — in preparations such as powders, instant powders, shredded materials, pills, dodol/jenang (taffy-like confections), pilis and tapel (traditional topical pastes), pastilles, tablets, capsules, liquids, solutions, emulsions and suspensions, effervescents, films, strips, chewable gummies, ointments, lotions, creams and gels, aerosols for external use, plasters, and suppositories; and the manufacture of jamu (herbal tonic) beverages and non-pharmaceutical health/food supplements.
This group covers the processing of petroleum into base lubricating oil, which is subsequently processed into lubricating oil before the addition of certain additives.

This group covers the processing of other dairy products, such as butter, yoghurt, cheese and curd, whey, casein or lactose (sweet milk), fermented milk, whey, and milk kefir. This group also covers the ripening and aging of cheese.
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of ice cream whose main ingredient is milk, see group 10503;
- the manufacture of fruit kefir and water kefir, see subgroup 1102.
This group covers the processing of rattan into semi-finished materials, such as polished rattan, rattan core, and rattan skin.
This group covers the processing of seaweed, for example the drying of seaweed into dried seaweed. This group does not cover the manufacture of agar-agar, see group 10798.
This group covers the processing of coconut husk into raw materials, such as coconut coir fiber (cocofiber), coconut coir dust (cocopeat), and rubberized curl coir (RCC).
This group covers the processing of milk powder, condensed milk/condensed creamer, and evaporated milk, whether sweetened or unsweetened, and the processing of milk or cream into solid form.

This group covers the processing of fresh liquid milk, pasteurized milk, sterilized milk, homogenized milk, and ultra-high temperature (UHT) milk, and the production of cream from fresh liquid milk, pasteurized milk, sterilized milk, and homogenized milk in liquid or semi-liquid form.

This group covers the processing and/or refining of asphaltic rock, such as Buton asphalt, and products derived from asphaltic rock or similar materials. This group does not cover products from petroleum refining, such as asphalt or tar, bitumen, and wax, see group 19100 or group 19209.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengopera: This group covers the operation of wastewater treatment facilities and the treatment of wastewater through sewer channels. This group also covers the cleaning of sewers and their drainage channels.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengumpul: This group covers the collection and transport of wastewater from sources such as households or industrial units, through channels of the sewage network, wastewater collectors, and other transport facilities (waste/sewage transport vehicles). This group also covers the emptying and cleaning of cesspits, septic tanks, and pits of waste, and the collection of wastewater from chemical toilets (portable toilets, aircraft toilets, train toilets).

This group covers the collection, distribution, management, and oversight of non-Islamic social funds, such as charity funds, dana punia and dana paramita (Hindu/Buddhist offering funds), tithes, and collections.
This group covers the collection, distribution, and management of social funds not administered by Islamic institutions, such as corporate social responsibility (CSR) and corporate donations.

This group covers the collection, distribution, and management of social funds, including zakat, infak, sedekah, wakaf, and other religious social funds (DSKL), whether administered by Islamic institutions or otherwise.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pengurusa:
This group covers the activities of arranging and organising cultural performances and entertainment specifically in the field of the arts, both performing arts and visual arts, such as film festivals as well as musical or music and dance festivals.
This group also covers
- the technical planning, provision, arrangement and operation of audiovisual equipment and special effects related to the organisation of live arts events;
- the activities of producers or impresarios of live arts events, with or without facilities.

This group covers the handling, organization, and management of live sporting events, ranging from technical planning and provision to the setup and operation of audiovisual equipment and special effects at multi-event sporting weeks (multi-event) and sporting championships (single-event). The sports-promoter services in this group are specific to the field of sports, including e-sport promoter services.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penilaian: This group covers the valuation of securities prices for the purpose of establishing fair market price.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penitipan: This group covers custody and management activities under a trust agreement for the benefit of a beneficiary, on a fee or contract basis.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penjamina: This group covers securities underwriting and other activities related to the corporate actions of companies that will undertake or have undertaken a public offering, such as advisory services for the issuance of securities, mergers, consolidations, takeovers, and/or restructuring.

This group covers the guaranteeing of financial protection for customer funds deposited at banks and for policy claims arising from insurance products. This guarantee is funded through periodic contributions paid by such financial institutions.

This group covers re-guarantee activities conducted wholly on sharia principles, comprising the provision of guarantees over the fulfillment of the financial obligations of sharia guarantee companies.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penunjang: This group covers other auxiliary financial activities not elsewhere classified, such as financial consultants, mortgage advisers and brokers, mortgage consultants, and other investment consultants, for example robo-advisor services.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyamaka: This group covers the tanning of hides that have undergone pre-tanning, tanned with synthetic agents (such as chromium) or vegetable agents into tanned leather, such as wet blue, wet white, crust, sole leather, vache raam, box leather, suede leather, glacé leather and decorative leather, fur leather, laminated leather, patent leather, jacket leather, glove leather, and chamois leather.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyampai: This group covers the dissemination of information, sourcing of personnel, registration, selection, placement, and protection of Indonesian migrant workers employed by employers abroad across various business fields. In this group, the placed workers do not have the status of employees of the labor-placement company. This group also covers the supply of overseas executive personnel.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyedia: This group covers the activities of providers of professional tourism consultancy services, including the delivery of views, recommendations, and/or studies relating to feasibility studies, planning, organizing, directing, coordinating, supervising, reporting, budgeting, and/or other management functions in the field of tourism.

This group covers the activities of providing marketing consultancy, including the delivery of views, advice, and/or studies relating to the development of marketing strategies, analysing marketing strategies, building and developing brands, providing services and increasing sales value, and other management functions in the field of marketing.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyediaa:
This group covers the supply of raw water for industrial purposes, power generation, and the like, including that carried out within forest areas. This group also covers the management of irrigation networks.
This group does not cover:
- the provision of irrigation services such as spraying for agricultural purposes;
- the use of raw water as a cultivation medium by fish farmers carried out as a single continuous set of activities.

This group covers the activities of providing accommodation, typically on a daily or weekly basis, for short-term stays, meeting the requirements of a two-star hotel, and using part or all of a building.
This group covers the provision of accommodation furnished with furniture in the living room and suites. Various additional services may be provided, such as daily cleaning and bed-making, food and beverage services, laundry services, as well as conference and convention facilities. Activities in this group are generally characterized by the provision of customer service directly on the premises.

This group covers the provision of accommodation, typically on a daily or weekly basis, for short-term stays, meeting the requirements of a four-star hotel, and using part or all of a building.
This group covers the provision of accommodation furnished with furniture in guest rooms and suites. Various additional services may be provided, such as daily cleaning and bed-making, food and beverage services, laundry services, and conference and convention facilities. Activities in this group are generally characterised by the provision of on-site, in-person customer service.

This group covers the activity of providing accommodation usually on a daily or weekly basis, for stays of a short duration, meeting the requirements of a five-star hotel, and using part or all of a building.
This group covers the provision of accommodation furnished with furniture in the living room and suites. Various additional services may be provided, such as daily cleaning and bed-making, food and beverage services, laundry services, as well as conference and convention facilities. Activities in this group are generally characterized by the provision of on-site customer service in person.

This group covers accommodation provision activities that are usually on a daily or weekly basis, for short-stay periods, meeting the requirements for a one-star hotel, and using part or all of a building.
This group covers the provision of accommodation furnished with furniture in the living room and suites. Various additional services may be provided, such as daily cleaning and bed-making, food and beverage services, laundry services, as well as conference and convention facilities. Activities in this group are generally characterised by the provision of customer service directly on the premises.

This group covers the provision of accommodation, normally on a daily or weekly basis, for short stays, meeting the requirements of a three-star hotel and using part or all of a building.
This group covers the provision of accommodation furnished in guest rooms and suites. Various additional services may be provided, such as daily cleaning and bed-making, food and beverage services, laundry services, and conference and convention facilities. Activities in this group are generally characterised by the provision of on-site, direct customer service.
This group covers the activity of providing accommodation usually on a daily or weekly basis, managed commercially using part or all of a building that meets the requirements of a non-star hotel.

This group covers the activities of providing lending facilities in the form of funds and/or securities to brokers to support securities transactions, for example margin transactions, short selling, and repos.

This group covers activities of providing information on tourist attractions, whether natural, man-made, or cultural, such as the provision of data, news, features, photos, videos, and visit-activity reports from influencers, buzzers, and endorsers, as well as research findings on tourist attractions. This group also covers activities of disseminating information about tourist attractions through print, electronic, or other communication media, whether online or offline.

This group covers the provision of information on tourism objects and facilities, tourism services, transport, and other information needed by tourists. The dissemination of information about tourism businesses or other information needed by tourists may be carried out through print media, electronic media, or other communication media, including information on booking services, accommodation, food, flights, land transport, and sea transport.

This group covers the provision of tax consultancy services, such as the preparation of business or individual income tax returns; also included in this group is the provision of accounting consultancy services and representation (other than legal representation) on behalf of clients before tax officials or tax courts.

This group covers the activity of providing interior-design/indoor-space-design consultancy services, namely planning/designing the interior or indoor space of a building or structure based on human activity and the function of the space, and to achieve a resulting ambience/atmosphere by taking into account the elements of: security, health, safety, comfort, support for persons with disabilities, and aesthetics. In the field of interior design, besides planning services, this activity also covers survey services, feasibility-study services, drafting services, artist-impression design services, supervision services for the interior of a building/structure, price-estimation/QS services, and project-management services within the construction of interior-design planning, including interior design for buildings as well as other civil structures.
This group does not cover
- architectural activities, see group 71101.

This group covers the provision of tax consulting services, such as preparing business or individual income tax returns. It also includes the provision of advisory and representation services (other than legal representation) on behalf of clients before tax officials.

This group covers the activities of providing financial accounting bookkeeping services, payroll accounting bookkeeping and other services, the preparation and analysis of financial statements, the preparation or auditing of financial statements, as well as the review of statements and certification of their accuracy.

This group covers the provision of bookkeeping and accounting services, the preparation and analysis of financial statements, the preparation or examination/audit of financial statements, and the verification of statements and certification of their accuracy.

This group covers the supply of workers to a client's business for a specified period, whether to temporarily replace or to supplement the client's workforce. Under such an employment arrangement, the temporary employment agency or human-resource provider is the employer of the individual workers employed. However, the client is responsible for the supervision of the temporary personnel. Activities classified here do not provide direct supervision for workers placed with the employer.
Units classified in this group represent the legal employer of the employees in matters relating to payroll, taxes, and other fiscal and human-resource matters, but are not directly responsible for the supervision of the employees. Units classified in this group carry out various human-resource and personnel management tasks related to these arrangements.
This group covers human-resource management services for employers. These activities are dedicated to handling human-resource and personnel management tasks. They maintain the employment records of workers in matters relating to wages, taxes, and other financial and resource matters, including worker/labor supply providers.
This group also covers the placement of baby sitters and child caregivers employed by labor providers, whereas baby sitters and child caregivers employed directly by the household employer fall under subgroup 7810.
This group does not cover debt-collection services, see subgroup 6920.

This group covers the provision of lodging in the open air using tents or caravans (trailers) that are brought by the guests themselves and serve as a place of stay for tourists.
This group covers:
- the provision of short-stay accommodation at campgrounds, such as recreational campgrounds and campgrounds for fishing and hunting;
- the provision of areas and facilities for caravan stopovers.
This subclass also covers the provision of accommodation by:
- shelters or plain bivouac facilities.
This subclass does not cover:
- intermediation service activities for accommodation, see subclass 5540.
This group covers the provision, management, and operation of offerings of securities by an issuer directly to investors through an open electronic-system network.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyeleng: This group covers the operation and management of investor protection funds established to protect investors from the loss of investor assets.

This group covers the operation and provision or use of systems for carrying out financial transactions in the money market and the foreign exchange market. Transaction-facility operators include providers of electronic trading platforms, systematic internalisers, exchange operators, and other transaction-facility operators.

This group covers the operation and provision of systems and/or facilities for the trading of commodities under futures contracts, Sharia derivative contracts, and/or other derivative contracts, including the operation of futures exchanges, whether physical or electronic.

This group covers the operation and provision of systems and/or facilities to facilitate activities related to the trading of digital financial assets, including crypto assets, and/or the provision of digital financial asset trading reports.

This group covers the operation and provision of systems and/or facilities to bring together the supply (buy and sell) of securities (including carbon units) from various parties for the purpose of trading securities among them, including trading through an exchange or through an alternative trading system.

This group covers the operation of payment system infrastructure related to the clearing and settlement of fund-transfer transactions in the context of payment transactions.
This group also covers:
- the operation of the principal and switching functions in the context of payment transactions;
- other activities related to the operation of payment system infrastructure, such as the administration of the identities of parties involved in the settlement of payment transactions.
This group covers the provision of reinsurance services against the risks faced by insurance companies, guarantee companies, or other reinsurance companies.

This group covers the conduct of activities that support the provision of payment services and/or payment system infrastructure in processing payment transactions, for example card printing, payment personalisation, the provision of data centres and/or disaster recovery centres, the provision of terminals, the provision of security features for payment instruments and/or payment transactions, the provision of contactless transaction support technology, and the provision of routing of data supporting the processing of payment transactions.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyelesa: This group covers other building completion activities, such as the installation and dismantling of exhibition stands; the installation of built-in kitchens, staircases, shop fittings, and furniture; the installation of garden equipment; and the installation of decorative exterior mouldings, cornices, and façades.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyempro: This group covers aerial spraying and pollination using specialised aircraft under specific conditions.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyempur:
This group covers wet-finishing activities on fabrics and textile articles, including ready-made garments, such as bleaching, dyeing, printing, sanforising, mercerising, jeans bleaching, including waterproofing, coating, rubberising, and impregnation of finished textile articles.
This group excludes the coating, rubberising, and impregnation of fabrics; see group 13992.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyewaan: This group covers the rental of construction equipment or machinery and its accessories with an operator. It includes the rental of production and operational equipment for oil, gas, petrochemicals, geothermal, and communications, such as supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA), and the rental of cranes. The rental of construction machinery and its accessories without an operator is covered in group 77393.

This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of water transport equipment without an operator, such as commercial ships and boats. The rental of water transport equipment with an operator is covered in main group 50 under the corresponding group. The rental of boats for sports and recreation (such as recreational boats, canoes, sailing boats, and yachts) is covered in group 77210.

This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of air transport equipment without an operator, such as aeroplanes, hot-air balloons, and helicopters. The rental of air transport equipment with an operator is covered in main group 51 under the corresponding group.
This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of printed and published goods, such as books, magazines, comics, video games, cassettes, video discs, and recordings.

This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of industrial machinery and equipment without an operator, generally used as business capital goods, such as textile machinery, metal- and woodworking machinery, printing machinery, electric welding machines, and machine tools.

This group covers the renting and operational leasing without operators of construction and civil-engineering machinery and equipment, including their accessories, without operators, such as crane lorries, scaffolds and work platforms, excluding their erection and driving and the like. The renting of construction and civil-engineering machinery and equipment, including their accessories, with operators is classified in group 43905.

This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of mining and quarrying machinery and equipment without an operator, generally used as capital goods by enterprises, such as power-generating machinery, including prime movers or steam engines and turbines, mining and petroleum equipment, and professional radio and communications equipment.

This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of agricultural and forestry machinery and equipment without an operator, including its accessories, such as machinery and equipment produced by subclass 2821, for example agricultural tractors. The rental of agricultural and forestry machinery and equipment with an operator, including its accessories, is classified in subclasses 0161 and 0240 respectively.

This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of professional radio, television, and communications machinery and equipment, including walkie-talkies; as well as multimedia machinery and equipment for the production of creative content, including image- and sound-recording devices such as cameras, surveillance cameras (CCTV), microphones, recording media, and lighting, as well as digital media processing devices such as render farms, motion capture, and three-dimensional (3D) scanners.

This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of machinery, equipment, and other tangible goods not classified in other groups under subclass 7739, such as containers for housing or offices, pallets (container-lifting devices) and the like, including the rental of livestock and racehorses.

This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of machinery and radiation equipment used in industrial, construction, and other processes, such as the rental of baggage-scanning devices with an ionising radiation source.
This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of musical instruments, such as guitars, drums, organs, and gamelan.

This group covers the rental and operational leasing (without purchase option) of all types of personal or household goods (other than recreational and sports equipment) not elsewhere classified in groups 77291 to 77294, such as textiles, wearing apparel and footwear (for example curtains and shoes), jewellery, household furniture, pottery and glassware, kitchen utensils, and electrical appliances. This group also covers the rental of ornamental fish together with aquariums, which may be accompanied by maintenance and cleaning services.

This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of all types of flowers and ornamental plants, such as ornamental plants for event decoration and ornamental plants for office spaces.

This group covers the operational leasing (without purchase option) of all types of office machinery and equipment without an operator, such as typewriters, accounting machines, calculating machines and equipment (cash registers, electronic calculators, and others), data-processing machines, photocopiers, and office furniture, including the rental of computers and their accessories without an operator.

This group covers renting and operational leasing (without purchase option) without an operator of all types of land transport equipment that are non-motorized vehicles, such as rail-based vehicles, for example trains, electric trains, and monorail trains. This group also covers the rental of non-motorized caravans.
This group does not cover
- the rental of land transport equipment in the form of motor vehicles such as passenger cars (without driver), trucks, trailers, recreational vehicles, and motorcycles without their operator, see group 77100;
- the rental of land transport equipment with their operator, see subclasses 4922 and 4929.

This group covers the renting and operational leasing without operators of all types of goods for the purpose of staging an event, such as tents, guest chairs, wedding-dais chairs, decorations, costumes, as well as dining and serving utensils.

This group covers the renting of warehouses and self-storage facilities used for storing goods, including the provision of locker rentals with security features. The operation of warehousing for a wide variety of goods is covered in subclass 5210.

This group covers the rental of venues and facilities for the holding of meetings, incentives, conventions, and exhibitions (MICE), or for the holding of special events. The rental is carried out for a specified period covering the preparation phase, the holding of the event, and the dismantling phase. The venues in question include convention centres, exhibition centres, as well as special venues/multi-purpose venues.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan penyusuna: This group covers the compilation and provision of information, such as the credit and/or employment history of individuals, to financial institutions, retailers, and other parties that require an assessment of the creditworthiness of those individuals or businesses. This group also covers the activities of alternative credit information management and credit rating institutions.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan perbaikan: This group covers the retreading of used tyres into like-new tyres so that they can be reused for motor vehicles, bicycles, other transport vehicles, and equipment that uses tyres.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan perbankan: This group covers banking activities conducted on Sharia principles, comprising the collection of funds from the public in the form of deposits or similar instruments and channelling them to the public in the form of financing and/or other instruments based on Sharia principles, as well as providing services within the payment system. This group also covers the collection of funds in the form of demand deposits or other instruments used as margin, compensation funds, and guarantee funds based on Sharia principles.

This group covers conventional banking activities, comprising the collection of funds from the public in the form of deposits or similar instruments and channelling them to the public in the form of credit and/or other instruments, as well as providing services within the payment system. This group also covers the collection of funds in the form of demand deposits or other instruments used as margin, compensation funds, and guarantee funds on a conventional basis.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan perdagang: This group covers the wholesale trade of various musical instruments, both traditional and modern, such as the kecapi, bamboo flute, calung, angklung, kolintang, gamelan, rebab, rebana, tifa, sasando, recorder, flute, saxophone, harmonica, trombone, guitar, mandolin, ukulele, harp, bass, gambus, violin, cello, piano, organ, drums, and tuning fork.

This group covers the wholesale trade of a wide range of goods without any particular specialisation, not operating on a self-service basis, generally involving a price-bargaining process, such as traditional wholesale/cash-and-carry operations.
This group covers the wholesale trade of a wide range of goods without any particular specialisation, at predetermined prices, where buyers select the goods themselves and pay at a checkout counter.
This group covers the wholesale trade of diskettes, removable drives/flash drives, blank audio tapes and video tapes, and blank CDs and DVDs.

This group covers the wholesale trade of various land transport equipment, whether motorised or non-motorised (other than cars, motorcycles, and the like), such as locomotives and railway carriages, including the wholesale trade of their various spare parts and accessories.
This group covers the wholesale trade of various marine transport equipment, whether motorised or non-motorised, including the wholesale trade of their various spare parts and accessories.
This group covers the wholesale trade of various air transport equipment, including the wholesale trade of their various spare parts and accessories.
This group covers the activities of the retail trade of cut flowers/florist.
This group covers the retail trade of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in cylinders for cooking.
This group covers the retail trade of pets, such as cats, dogs, snakes, rabbits, monitor lizards, and others.
This group covers the retail trade of livestock and animal breeding stock, such as cattle, goats, and poultry together with their breeding stock.

This group covers the retail trade of live fish and other aquatic organisms not intended for consumption, such as ornamental fish, pearl oysters, sponges, milkfish fry (nener), shrimp fry (benur), fish fry, and clear lobster fry (BBL). The trade of processed fishery fish products falls under group 47245.

This group covers the specialised retail trade of various fertilisers and pesticides, such as straight synthetic fertilisers (urea, ZA, TSP, DSP), compound and blended synthetic fertilisers (monoammonium phosphate, diammonium phosphate, nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium), natural fertilisers (compost, dolomite fertiliser, lime fertiliser), insecticides, fungicides, rodenticides, herbicides, nematicides, and acaricides.
This group covers the retail trade of cosmetics for animals, such as perfumes, shampoos, soaps, powders, and creams or lotions.

This group covers other retail trade not included in groups 47771 through 47774, such as gelatine, thermal insulation materials other than plastic and rubber, polishes, camphor (mothballs), and firewood.
This group covers the retail trade of kerosene.

This group covers the retail trade of livestock/poultry/fish feed and pet food, such as livestock/poultry/fish feed rations, livestock/poultry/fish feed concentrates, bone meal, blood meal, and shell meal.
This group covers the retail trade of forestry plants and seeds/seedlings and parts of forestry plants.

This group covers the retail trade of plants and plant seeds/seedlings; the retail trade of medicinal plants and ornamental plants, such as orchids, roses, jasmine, tuberose, aquatic ornamental plants, and ornamental/medicinal plant seedlings. This group does not cover the trade of forestry plant seeds, see group 47765.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan perkawina: This group covers livestock breeding services on a fee or contract basis, such as artificial insemination, embryo transfer, pregnancy diagnosis, and breeding-bull (stud-bull) management.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan persiapan: This group covers the preparation of legal documents, legal-entity documents, cooperation agreements or similar documents in connection with the formation of companies, the preparation of notarial deeds, wills, trusts and the like, and other activities.

This group covers the preparation of textile fibres, such as scutching of ramie fibre, twisting/reeling and washing of silk fibre, degreasing and carbonising of wool and dyeing of sheep wool, including the carding and combing of all types of fibres from animal hair, vegetable fibres, and man-made fibres (synthetic and artificial).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pertamban: This group covers the mining of natural asphalt, asphaltic rock, and natural solid bitumen, including the separation and casting of such minerals.
This group covers the mining of phosphate minerals, including the sorting, crushing, cleaning, and beneficiation of phosphate minerals.

This group covers the mining of other non-ferrous minerals not yet included in groups 07291 through 07296, such as ores of zinc, platinum, silicon, lithium, beryllium, magnesium, potassium, calcium, bismuth, molybdenum, mercury, tungsten, titanium, vanadium, chromite, antimony, cobalt, tantalum, cadmium, gallium, indium, yttrium, magnetite, niobium, zirconium, ilmenite, chromium, caesium, hafnium, scandium, ruthenium, selenium, tellurium, strontium, germanium, and xenotime.
This group covers the mining of nitrate minerals, including the cleaning, crushing, and other sorting of nitrate minerals.
This group covers the mining of sulphur ore, including the crushing and cleaning of sulphur minerals. Further processing of sulphur minerals is classified under group 20119.
This group covers the mining of iron ore, including the beneficiation and agglomeration of iron ore and its concentrates.
This group covers copper ore mining, comprising chalcocite as well as rock consisting of a mixture of monticellite and copper skarn.
This group covers the mining and stockpiling of bauxite ore.
This group covers the mining and quarrying of precious stones/gemstones, such as diamonds, including the separation/sorting and other cleaning of precious stones/gemstones.
This group covers the mining and preparation of manganese ore.
This group covers the mining and preparation of nickel ore.
This group covers the mining and preparation of lead ore.
This group covers the mining and preparation of tin ore.
This group covers the mining and extraction of groundwater containing iodine, including the distillation of these extracted minerals.
This group covers the mining of potassium oxide/potash in the form of salts, feldspar, leucite, and analcite/analcime, including the crushing and cleaning of these minerals.

This group covers the mining of rare-earth metals and rare-earth metal alloys (the elements lanthanum, cerium, praseodymium, neodymium, promethium, samarium, europium, gadolinium, terbium, dysprosium, holmium, erbium, thulium, ytterbium, and lutetium, plus the elements scandium and yttrium).

This group covers the mining of chemical minerals and other fertilizer minerals not yet covered in groups 08911 to 08915, for example the mining of natural barium sulfate and carbonate (barite and witherite), natural borates, natural magnesium sulfate (kieserite), the mining of natural pigments/earth colours, fluorspar, bentonite, dolomite, magnesite, pyrophyllite, alum, diatomite, and other minerals used primarily as chemical raw materials; as well as the mining of guano (fertilizer material from bird or bat droppings), including the cleaning, separation, and sorting of these minerals.
This group covers the mining of iron sand, including its sorting, separation, and cleaning.
This group covers the mining, cleaning, and separation of gold and silver ore.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pertanian: This group covers the farming of other assorted legumes, such as green beans, broad beans, long beans, peas, winged beans, lentils, lupins, garden peas, kidney beans, jack beans, pigeon peas, and cowpeas. The assorted legume farming referred to comprises land preparation, seeding, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities.

This group covers the farming or cultivation of live ornamental foliage plants and ornamental flowering plants, such as bonsai, maidenhair fern, elephant-ear, heliconia (lobster-claws), dracaena, philodendron, monstera, cordyline, foliage anthurium, ferns, aglaonema, dieffenbachia, sansevieria (snake plant), caladium (elephant ear), palms, and flowering ornamentals such as orchids, roses, adenium (desert rose), flowering anthurium, euphorbia, and ixora. This group also covers the planting of plants for ornamental purposes and grass turf for transplanting. The ornamental plant farming referred to comprises land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities.

This group covers the farming of oilseeds yielding edible oil, such as sesame seed, canola seed, safflower seed, and sunflower seed. The farming of edible-oil oilseeds referred to comprises land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities.

This group covers the farming of oilseeds yielding non-edible oil, such as cottonseed, linseed, mustard seed, niger seed, and castor seed. The farming of non-edible-oil oilseeds referred to comprises land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities.

This group covers the farming of sugar beet and sugar crops other than sugarcane, such as stevia and sweet sorghum. The farming of sugar beet and non-sugarcane sugar crops referred to comprises land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities.

This group covers the farming of grapes for direct consumption or for the production of wine, juice, vinegar, and dried fruit, such as raisins, Zante currants, and sultanas. The grape farming referred to comprises land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of grapevines to produce seed in the form of pips.
This group does not cover
- winemaking, see group 11020;
- the processing and preserving of grapes, see subgroup 1030.

This group covers the farming of pome and stone fruits, such as apricots, cherries, peaches, nectarines, pears, quinces, plums, sloes, passion fruit, kepel apple, tamarillo, and pomegranates. The farming of pome and stone fruits referred to comprises land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of pome and stone fruit trees to produce seed in the form of pips.

This group covers the farming of berries such as blueberries, currants, gooseberries, kiwifruit, raspberries, and strawberries. The berry farming referred to comprises land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of berry plants to produce seed.

This group covers the farming of other oleaginous fruits, such as olives, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of other oleaginous plants to produce seed.

This group covers the farming of annual fruits, such as watermelon, cantaloupe, melon, and snake melon (timun suri). The annual fruit farming referred to comprises land preparation, seeding, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of annual fruit crops to produce seed.

This group covers the farming of tropical and subtropical fruits, such as avocado, banana and plantain, dates, figs, papaya, pineapple, rambutan, durian, langsat, guava, water apple, longan, jackfruit, mango, mangosteen, sapodilla, starfruit, salak, soursop, and dragon fruit. The farming of tropical and subtropical fruits referred to comprises land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of tropical and subtropical fruit crops to produce seed.

This group covers the farming of chili peppers (Capsicum spp), such as large chili, bird's-eye chili, curly chili, and bell pepper. The chili farming referred to comprises land preparation, seeding, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of chili plants to produce seed.

This group covers the farming of cloves, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of clove trees to produce seed.

This group covers the horticultural cultivation of fruit vegetables, such as cucumber, eggplant, tomato, star-fruit (belimbing sayur), chayote (siam squash), pumpkin/winter squash, and ridge gourd/luffa (gambas/oyong). The cultivation of fruit vegetables referred to here covers land preparation, seeding, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated activity. This group also covers the cultivation of fruit-vegetable plants for seed production (seed in the form of kernels). This group does not cover the cultivation of chilli and capsicum/bell pepper, see group 01138.

This group covers maize farming activities, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of maize to produce seed in the form of grain. This group does not cover sweet corn farming, see group 01133.

This group covers the farming of mushrooms, such as straw mushrooms, oyster mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, wood-ear mushrooms, and truffles. The mushroom farming referred to comprises the construction of growing houses, preparation of the growing medium, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group does not cover the farming of mushroom spawn, see subgroup 0130.
This group covers the cultivation of mung beans, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single series of activities.
This group covers groundnut (peanut) farming activities, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single series of activities.

This group covers the farming of cocoa, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of cocoa trees to produce seed.

This group covers soybean farming activities, including therein land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single series of activities. This group does not cover the farming of vegetable soybean/edamame, see group 01116.

This group covers the farming of oil palm, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the planting of oil palm trees to produce seed.

This group covers coconut farming activities, including land preparation, nursery raising, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the cultivation of coconut plants to produce seed in the form of kernels.
This group covers coffee farming activities, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations.

This group covers pepper farming (Piper spp), including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the farming of Javanese long pepper/medicinal pepper.

This group covers hybrid rice farming, including land preparation, seedling raising, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations up to the production of unhusked rice (gabah). This group also covers the cultivation of hybrid rice to produce seed in the form of grains. Hybrid rice is the first generation (F1) resulting from the crossing of two or more parental lines and/or homozygous inbred lines, for example: Bernas Super, Bernas Prima, Sembada B3, Sembada 626, Sembada 989, SL 11 SHS, Bridantara 3, and PP5. The progeny of hybrid rice are not classified as hybrid rice.

This group covers inbred rice farming (other than hybrid rice), including land preparation, seedling raising, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations up to the production of unhusked rice (gabah). This group also covers the cultivation of inbred rice to produce seed in the form of grains. Inbred rice is a variety developed from a single plant through self-pollination, thereby possessing a high degree of purity or homozygosity, for example: Memberamo, Mekongga, Ciherang, IR-6, Inpari, Inpara, Inpago, Pak Tiwi, IPB 15S, as well as local rice varieties already in existence and cultivated by farmers for generations, such as Rojo Lele, Pandan Wangi, and Pusaka Bhagasasi.

This group covers nutmeg farming activities, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the cultivation of nutmeg plants to produce seed in the form of kernels.

This group covers the seed-production farming of flowering plants to produce true (generative) seed. The production of all types of vegetative planting material, including stem cuttings, shoots, and seedlings for the propagation of flowering plants, is classified under subgroup 0130.

This group covers the farming of bulb and tuber vegetables, such as potatoes, carrots, Chinese radish, bamboo shoots, garlic, onions, shallots, and leeks. The farming of bulb and tuber vegetables referred to here covers land preparation, seedling raising, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations.

This group covers the activity of cultivating vegetables whose leaves, flowers, or stems are eaten as vegetables, such as artichoke, pak choi/mustard greens, asparagus, cabbage, cauliflower, broccoli, lettuce, celery, spring onions, spinach, and water spinach. The cultivation of leafy vegetables referred to here includes land preparation, sowing, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single series of activities. Spinach and water spinach harvested with their roots are also included in this group. This group also covers the activity of planting leafy vegetable crops to produce seeds in the form of grains.

This group covers the cultivation of cereals other than rice and maize, such as wheat (wheat/oats), sorghum/millet, barley, rye, and foxtail millet. The cultivation of cereals other than rice and maize referred to here covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the cultivation of cereal crops other than rice and maize for the production of seed in the form of grain.

This group covers the farming of aromatic/essence plants, such as citronella, patchouli, mint, ylang (cananga), ylang-ylang, wintergreen, lawang (cinnamon-laurel), and agarwood, as well as the cultivation of cajuput trees to produce cajuput leaves. The farming of aromatic/essence plants referred to here covers land preparation, seedling raising, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the farming of aromatic/essence plants carried out within forest areas.

This group covers the farming of edible nut-bearing trees, such as almonds, cashews, chestnuts, walnuts, hazelnuts, and pistachios. The nut-tree farming referred to here covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations.

This group covers the farming of flowering plants that produce cut flowers and flower buds, for example orchids, carnations, gerberas, gladioli, chrysanthemums, roses, jasmine, and tuberose. The flower-plant farming referred to here covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group does not cover the farming of flowering plants that produce live flowering plants, see group 013.

This group covers the farming of non-rhizome medicinal plants (including plants used as botanical pesticide material and the like), such as cardamom, aloe vera, king-of-bitters (sambiloto), noni (mengkudu/pace), god's crown (mahkota dewa), and green lemongrass. The farming of non-rhizome medicinal plants referred to here covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the cultivation of non-rhizome medicinal plants to produce seed.

This group covers the farming of rhizome medicinal plants (including plants used as botanical pesticide material and the like), such as ginger, turmeric, java turmeric (temulawak), temu giring, black turmeric (temu ireng), fingerroot (temu kunci), aromatic ginger (kencur), galangal, bitter ginger (lempuyang), and sweet flag (dlingo). The farming of rhizome medicinal or biopharmaceutical plants referred to here covers land preparation, seedling raising, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the cultivation of rhizome medicinal plants to produce seed in the form of seeds.

This group covers the farming of fodder crops to produce forage for livestock, comprising fodder grasses and legumes, such as elephant grass, king grass, dwarf elephant grass (odot), setaria grass, alfalfa, leucaena (lamtoro), and Indigofera zollingeriana. The fodder-crop farming referred to here covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations.

This group covers the farming of latex- and gum-producing plants such as rubber and other latex/resin-producing plants, for example dammar, pine, and benzoin. The farming of rubber trees and other latex/resin-producing plants referred to here covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the farming of rubber and other latex/resin-producing plants carried out within forest areas, as well as the cultivation of rubber and other latex/resin-producing plants to produce seed.

This group covers the farming of other spice plants, such as candlenut, vanilla, cinnamon, ginseng, cinchona (quinine), fennel, areca nut, and gambir. The farming of other spices and aromatic/essence plants referred to here covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the cultivation of other spice and aromatic/essence plants to produce seed.

This group covers the farming of perennial vegetable plants, such as breadnut (kluwih/timbul), breadfruit, young jackfruit, petai (stink bean), jengkol, and melinjo (gnetum). The perennial-vegetable farming referred to here covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the cultivation of perennial vegetable plants to produce seed.

This group covers the farming of other shrub plants, such as locust beans, including land preparation, seedling raising, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations.
This group covers the farming of other annual plants not elsewhere classified, and cultivation to produce seed.

This group covers the farming of other perennial crops, such as casuarina (cemara); physic nut (jarak pagar); sugar palm (aren); calliandra; gliricidia (gamal); plants used primarily for plaiting, such as bamboo and rattan; as well as short-rotation crops that regenerate through coppicing as energy crops, such as poplar and willow. The farming of these other perennial crops includes land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single series of activities. This group also covers the farming activities of such perennial crops carried out within forest areas, as well as the planting of such crops to produce seed in the form of grains.

This group covers tobacco farming activities, including land preparation, seedling raising, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the cleaning and cutting (rajangan) of tobacco that is inseparable from its farming activities. This group also covers the cultivation of tobacco plants to produce seed.
This group does not cover the manufacture of tobacco products, see subgroup 1200.

This group covers the farming of other beverage crops, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations.

This group covers sugarcane farming activities, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group does not cover sugar beet farming, see group 01137.

This group covers tea farming activities, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations. This group also covers the cultivation of tea plants to produce seed.
This group covers cassava farming activities, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations.

This group covers the farming of other tubers such as sweet potato, taro, edible canna (ganyong), arrowroot (irut), lesser yam (gembili), elephant foot yam (iles-iles), and porang. The farming of other tubers referred to here covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single integrated series of operations.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pertenuna: This group covers textile weaving using power looms (mechanical looms), which may be carried out using a wide variety of materials, both new and recovered, such as silk, cotton, wool, plant fibres or synthetic fibres, paper fibres or glass fibres, recovered textile waste material, or new textile fibres.

This group covers textile weaving using backstrap looms (gedogan) and other non-mechanical looms; the production of ikat, songket, ulos, cual, ulap doyo, and geringsing woven fabrics using non-mechanical looms.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan peternaka: This group covers livestock farming activities engaged in the production of raw sheep's wool.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan pihak yan: This group covers the activities of parties acting as intermediaries for clients transacting in the money market and the foreign exchange market.

This group covers the activities of parties executing securities transactions on behalf of others or their clients, including securities dealer-broker intermediation activities specifically established within a particular region.
This group does not cover:
- trading in financial instruments for own account (other than carbon units), see group 64994;
- carbon unit brokerage, see group 66127.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan poduksi k: This group covers the production of roundwood from forest logging, whether used in forest-product-based industries or used in unprocessed form, such as pit-props, fence posts, and electricity or telephone poles.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan portofoli: This group covers portfolio and fund management activities on a fee or contract basis, such as the management of mutual funds other than investment funds and pension funds not elsewhere classified.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan produksi: This group covers the production and distribution of chilled water/iced water for cooling purposes and the production of ice, such as crystal ice, ice tube, and ice cube.
This group covers the production of compost from organic waste and plant ash (organic natural fertilizer).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan profesion:
This group covers professional activities in providing consultancy and technical design of plants relating to the planning, construction, dismantling, and relocation of plants, whether machinery, equipment, or other parts of a plant, encompassing economic, social, cultural, environmental, natural-resource, and other aspects.
This group does not cover
- engineering consultancy and design activities that apply the laws of physics and engineering principles in the design of machinery, materials, instruments, structures, processes, and systems, see group 71109.

This group covers other professional, scientific and technical activities not elsewhere classified, namely the diving for and salvage of cargo from sunken vessels (vessels and objects that have been submerged for >=50 years, whether holding cultural heritage status, suspected cultural heritage objects, or objects other than suspected cultural heritage/cultural heritage objects).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan regulator: This group covers the activities of a self-regulatory organization that sets rules and oversees the conduct of secure, orderly transactions in financial markets in accordance with financial-market policy on behalf of its members.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan reparasi: This group covers the repair and maintenance of communication equipment, such as the repair of wireless telecommunication devices (mobile phones, RFID, tablet computers, handheld computers, wireless modems, vehicle tracking devices); the repair of wired telecommunication devices (facsimile machines, analog telephone sets, ADSL/HDSL, PABX, modems, routers, bridges); the repair of wire-based transmission equipment (analog telephone exchanges); the repair of radio transmission devices (microwave links, studio-to-transmitter links/STL, trans-horizon links/troposcatter); the repair of two-way radios (trunking radio communication, conventional radio communication, walkie-talkies); and the repair of radio transmitting and/or receiving devices/transceivers (broadcast TV transmitter equipment, TV/smart TV sets, broadcast radio, cellular mobile network transmitter and receiver equipment, and video cameras).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan reproduks:
This group covers the reproduction, from master copies, of gramophone records, compact discs (CDs), and tapes containing music or other sound (audio) recordings, and the reproduction, from master copies, of software and data on disks and magnetic tapes. This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of blank gramophone records, blank cassette tapes, and blank computer tapes and diskettes for recording data, see group 26800
