- the production of sound recordings on gramophone records, cassette tapes, and the like, see group 59201.

This group covers the reproduction, from master copies, of recordings, compact discs (CDs), and tapes containing motion pictures or films and other video recordings. The publishing of film and video recordings is classified in groups 59131 and 59132.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan rumah pot: This group covers the activities of slaughterhouses for pigs, including wild boar, which comprise the slaughtering, skinning, cleaning, and packing of meat. This group also covers the handling of by-products, such as the production of hides and skins from slaughterhouses and fellmongery, the drying of bones, the processing of animal residues or waste, and fat rendering. The slaughtering of pigs carried out by traders is classified in groups 462 and 472.

This group covers the activities of slaughterhouses for ruminants, such as cattle, buffalo, goats, and sheep. The slaughterhouse activities referred to comprise the slaughtering, skinning, cleaning, and packing of meat, including the handling of by-products such as the production of hides and skins from slaughterhouses and fellmongery, the drying of bones, the processing of animal residues or waste, the sorting of wool, and fat rendering. The slaughtering of ruminants carried out by traders is classified in groups 462 and 472.

This group covers the activities of slaughterhouses for animals other than pigs, ruminants, and poultry, for example camels, rabbits, and whales. The slaughterhouse activities referred to comprise the slaughtering, skinning, cleaning, and packing of meat. These activities also cover the handling of by-products, such as the production of hides and skins from slaughterhouses and fellmongery, the drying of bones, the processing of animal residues or waste, and fat rendering. The slaughtering of animals carried out by traders is classified in groups 462 and 472.

This group covers the activities of poultry slaughterhouses, which comprise the slaughtering, skinning, cleaning, and packing of meat, including the handling of by-products such as the processing of poultry residues or waste, the stretching of skins, the sorting of feathers, and fat rendering. The slaughtering of poultry carried out by traders is classified in groups 462 and 472.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan rumah tan:
This group covers the activities of households in producing basic services, such as cooking, teaching or educating, caring for or looking after household members, and other services produced by the household for its own needs.
In practice, where such a household is also engaged in producing various services to meet its own needs, it is classified under the activities of households producing services for own use.

This group covers the activities of households as employers of domestic personnel (domestic workers), such as domestic assistants, cooks, cleaners, gardeners, private drivers, house guards, child carers, and personal assistants, including teachers where they are employed by the household.
This group enables domestic workers to state the activity of their employer in a census or survey, even though that employer is an individual or a household. The output of this activity is consumed by the employing household.
This group does not cover the provision of personal and household services, such as cleaning, ironing, cooking, garden care, and in-home care services for persons in need, by service providers (for-profit, non-profit, public organizations, or self-employed workers); see the applicable type of service.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan sistem pe: This group covers the activities of other banking systems based on sharia principles that differ from the general banking system, for example Sharia Rural Economy Banks (Bank Perekonomian Rakyat Syariah) operating a sharia banking system that collects funds from the public in the form of deposits and/or investments and channels them to the public in the form of financing and/or other forms based on sharia principles, but does not provide services in payment traffic (such as fund transfer or remittance services), including Sharia Rural Credit Banks (Bank Perkreditan Rakyat Syariah).

This group covers the activities of other conventional banking systems that differ from the general banking system, for example the activities of Conventional Rural Economy Banks (Bank Perekonomian Rakyat Konvensional) operating a banking system that collects funds from the public in the form of deposits such as time deposits, savings, and/or other equivalent forms, and channels them to the public in the form of credit, but does not provide services in payment traffic (such as fund transfer services).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan taman hib:
This group covers the activities of amusement parks and theme parks characterised by the operation of a variety of attractions on a permanent, location-based basis, such as mechanical rides, carousels, games, shooting galleries, shows, themed exhibitions, and picnic grounds, provided under the economic and operational direction of a central operator. These parks are typically located within a structurally bounded area, and customers must pay an admission fee.
This group also covers:
- water park activities.
This group does not cover:
- the operation of gambling and lottery games, see subclass 9200;
- the operation of rides, games, and mechanical shows by independent providers, for example at fairgrounds, folk festivals, and Christmas markets, see 9329.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan taman lau: This group covers the activities of marine parks consisting of protected marine areas that may be used as recreation areas or solely as areas to preserve particular habitats and ensure a sustainable ecosystem for the organisms in those areas, such as Pahawang Marine Park (Lampung), Raja Ampat Marine Park (West Papua), and Gili Matra Marine Park (West Nusa Tenggara).
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan usaha jas: This group covers the business activities of consultancy and/or intermediation services in the placement of reinsurance or sharia reinsurance and the handling of claim settlement, acting for and on behalf of insurance companies, sharia insurance companies, guarantee companies, sharia guarantee companies, reinsurance companies, or sharia reinsurance companies that carry out the placement of reinsurance or sharia reinsurance.

This group covers the business activities of consultancy and/or intermediation services in the placement of insurance or sharia insurance cover and the handling of claim settlement, acting for and on behalf of the policyholder, the insured, or the participant.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan usaha pel: This group covers fishing port service business activities, namely fish loading and unloading services and the like.
This group covers fishing port service business activities, such as the operation of fishing port and quay facilities and/or berthing and mooring services for fishing vessels.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan usaha pen: This group covers the business activities of claims assessment and/or consultancy services on insured objects. The activities of an insurance loss adjuster are carried out when a claim arises.
This group covers the business of operating toll roads or toll bridges, including vehicle traffic services via toll roads and bridges.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan vermak pa: This group covers garment alteration activities serving the general public for commercial purposes.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan yang berk: This group covers activities related to the distribution of rupiah currency, the storage of rupiah currency in vaults, the processing of rupiah currency and/or the loading, retrieval, and/or monitoring of rupiah currency sufficiency in Automated Teller Machines (ATM), Cash Deposit Machines (CDM), Cash Recycling Machines (CRM) and/or other cash rupiah transaction machines. This group may also undertake cooperation for the carriage of foreign banknotes into and out of Indonesia's customs area, and the provision and maintenance of Automated Teller Machines (ATM), Cash Deposit Machines (CDM), Cash Recycling Machines (CRM) and/or other cash rupiah transaction machines.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan yang bert: This group covers the activities of acting for and on behalf of an insurance company or sharia insurance company and meeting the requirements to represent the insurance company or sharia insurance company in marketing insurance products or sharia insurance products.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan yang memf: This group covers activities that facilitate the trading of digitally represented financial assets, such as crypto, namely the activities of transacting on a digital financial asset exchange on behalf of another party or customer.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan yang seca:
This group covers activities directly related to water supply, such as the rental and lending of water distribution networks, billing, and other supporting activities. The activities in this group include water distribution carried out by individuals, such as vendors selling water by shoulder-pole/cart/tanker truck.
This group does not cover water-meter reading carried out by third parties, see subclass 8299.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan yang terk:
This group covers activities related to the functions of regulation, supervision, examination, and investigation of financial services activities in the insurance, guarantee, and pension fund sectors.
This group does not cover the activities of financial supervisory authorities relating to financial services other than insurance and pension funds (see group 66116).
This group covers activities related to the management, maintenance, and utilization of other nature reserve areas not yet covered in groups 91421 through 91426.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegiatan, pengerin:
This group covers the activities of drying, roasting, grinding, and extraction of coffee into roasted coffee, ground coffee, instant coffee, decaffeinated coffee, coffee extracts and essences, as well as other coffee products, including coffee substitutes.
This group does not cover the grinding of ground coffee at the premises of a coffee retailer, see group 47222.
Kelompok ini mencakup kegitan yang menye: This group covers activities that provide premises and service facilities for alternative therapy/traditional Indonesian massage, healing activities, hypnotists, and practitioners in the field of reflexology massage, shiatsu massage, tuina qigong massage, and Thai massage that are comfortable, safe, and beneficial. These activities uphold professional ethics and may be complemented by the provision of food and beverages.
Kelompok ini mencakup ketentuan bantuan:
This group covers the provision of advisory assistance, guidance, and operational support for business and other organizational and management issues, such as strategic and organizational planning; decisions relating to finance; planning objectives and policies, human-resources practices and policies; production-scheduling planning and control. The provision of these business services may cover advisory assistance, guidance, and operational support for various management functions, management consulting by agronomists and agricultural economists in the field of agriculture and the like, the design of accounting methods and procedures, cost-accounting programs, budget-control procedures, the provision of advice and assistance to businesses and public services in planning, organizing, efficiency, and control, management information, occupational health and safety consulting, e.g. risk identification and documentation, and others.
This group also covers
- infrastructure investment study services;
- port security management consulting services.
Kelompok ini mencakup konversi energi li:
This group covers the conversion of electrical energy into a storable form of energy, the storage of electrical energy, and the reconversion of that energy back into electrical energy, such as the operation of pumped-storage facilities, compressed-air storage facilities, or battery storage facilities.
This group also covers:
- the operation of public electric-vehicle battery-swapping stations (SPBKLU).
Kelompok ini mencakup meliputi aktivitas: This group covers the provision of residential care combining assisted living, medical care, nursing care, and rehabilitation provided by the government. These facilities have a core permanent staff of registered or licensed practical nurses together with other staff, providing nursing care combined with personal care. Medical or nursing care services typically include the administration of medication, performing medical diagnoses, and treating wounds, and are usually provided without the supervision of a medical doctor on duty at the facility.
Kelompok ini mencakup operasional transp:
This group covers the operation of freight transport by motor vehicles capable of carrying more than one type of goods, such as:
- freight transport by truck, pickup, open-bed, and closed-bed (box).
This group does not cover:
- freight transport by motor vehicles specifically carrying a single type of goods, see group 49232.
Kelompok ini mencakup pelayanan kesehata: This group covers health services that prioritize promotive and preventive care through traditional health services performed by traditional healers using skill-based and/or herbal methods, such as massage/kneading for health, reflexology, acupressure, Indonesian herbal remedies, hypnotherapy, bone-setting, dry cupping/cup therapy, sinshe, as well as energy therapy provided at wellness centers, hereinafter referred to as type-2 traditional health clinics.
Kelompok ini mencakup pemasangan, pemeli: This group covers the installation, maintenance, and repair of railway signalling and telecommunication systems, such as electric signals along the tracks.
Kelompok ini mencakup pemberian jasa man:
This group covers the provision of management services for various types of accommodation by a third party that is responsible for the overall business and operational performance, including direct involvement in daily operations and managerial decision-making. This party acts on behalf of the property owner and receives remuneration in the form of a management fee.
This group does not cover
- the direct ownership and operation of hotels and similar accommodation, see group 55101;
- the provision of general management consultancy services without direct operational management, see group 70201.
Kelompok ini mencakup pemberian pelayana: This group covers the provision of health services by health workers other than physicians and dentists, such as the activities of nursing personnel, midwifery personnel, pharmaceutical personnel, public health personnel, environmental health personnel, nutrition personnel, physical therapy personnel, medical technician personnel, biomedical engineering personnel, traditional health personnel, clinical psychology personnel, and physiotherapy personnel, and other health personnel. It also includes traditional health service activities carried out by traditional health personnel (nakestrad) and/or other personnel possessing traditional health competence at traditional health service facilities, including Griya Sehat, hereinafter referred to as the Type 1 Traditional Health Clinic.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuangan limbah: This group covers the disposal of non-hazardous waste or refuse through incineration or other methods, to produce outputs such as electricity or steam, renewable fuel oil, bioenergy, ash, or other energy.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan alat mus:
This group covers the manufacture of non-traditional musical instruments played by plucking, bowing, blowing, or striking, such as guitars, basses, trumpets, saxophones, clarinets, harmonicas, violins, cellos, double basses, drums, xylophones, metallophones, pianos, organs, melodicas, accordions, and tuning forks.
This group also covers the manufacture of musical instruments whose sound is produced or amplified electronically, such as digital pianos and synthesizers.
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of microphones, loudspeakers, headphones, and similar components, see group 26420;
- toy musical instruments, see group 32402.

This group covers the manufacture of traditional musical instruments rooted in Indonesia's cultural history or customs, played by plucking, bowing, blowing, or striking, such as the angklung, calung, kecapi, bamboo flute, kolintang, gong, traditional trumpet, gambang, rebab, and tifa, including the manufacture of whistles, call horns (a type of trumpet), and other sound-signalling instruments played by blowing.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan alat-ala: This group covers the manufacture of office equipment made of metal, such as safes and filing cabinets, excluding metal furniture. This group also covers the manufacture of strongboxes, armoured doors, and the like.
This group covers the manufacture of communication transmission equipment, such as telephone and facsimile apparatus, including answering machines and others.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan atau per: This group covers the manufacture or assembly of various manned surface and underwater vessels, whether military or civilian, designed to operate only with the physical presence of crew on board to perform the vessel's primary functions (navigation, propulsion, and safety), such as passenger ships, ferries, cargo ships, tankers, tugboats, commercial sailing vessels, warships, research vessels, fishing vessels, and vessels for fish processing and fishery-product preservation that can only be operated with the physical presence of crew on board.

This group covers the manufacture or assembly of unmanned surface vehicles (USV) and unmanned underwater vehicles designed to be operated by remote control by a crew, e.g., remotely operated underwater vehicles (ROV), automated control based on artificial intelligence, or hybrid control (able to be crewed when required), such as USVs and unmanned underwater vehicles for bathymetric surveys, monitoring and mapping, underwater infrastructure inspection, marine research, underwater archaeological surveys, salvage operations, and military operations.

This group covers the manufacture or assembly of spacecraft for passengers or cargo, space launch vehicles, satellite-launch rockets, satellites, planetary exploration vehicles, orbital stations, and space shuttles.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan barang b: This group covers the manufacture of valuable articles other than jewellery whose primary material is precious metal and which are not worn on the human body, on clothing, and/or on pets, such as tableware and drinkware, flat dishes, hollowware, toilet articles, household ornamental articles, office or desk articles, trophies, medals, and novelties or articles related to religion, including their parts and accessories.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan barang j: This group covers the manufacture of household made-up textile articles, such as blankets, travelling rugs, bed linen, table linen, pillowcases, curtains, towels, chair-seat covers, prayer mats/floor coverings made by joining and/or sewing together several materials with textile as the primary material; hand-woven decorative wall hangings (tapestry); laundry bags, bag covers, shoe covers made of textile, baby carriers; electric blankets; mosquito nets, whether or not containing insecticide; cleaning cloths, dishcloths. Prayer mats/floor coverings made of carpet/rugs are included in group 13930.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan berbagai: This group covers the manufacture of various other measuring, testing, navigation, and control equipment, including instruments used in industrial processes, such as instruments for measuring heat, pressure, viscosity, and the properties of goods.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan dan peng: This group covers the manufacture and processing of medical devices related to medical diagnosis and other products within subclass 2011. This group covers the manufacture of contraceptive products for external use; the manufacture of medical diagnostic devices such as pregnancy tests and blood-glucose tests; the manufacture of medical cotton, cosmetic cotton, cotton buds, bandages, medical gauze, plasters; the manufacture of nasal wash, personal lubricant. This group does not cover the manufacture of cotton-bud sticks, see group 17099.

This group covers the manufacture and processing of medicinal substances and auxiliary substances for animals, derived from chemical materials, natural materials, animals, and plants, including those derived from biological products, such as medicinal substances like antisera and other blood fractions, vaccines and homeopathic preparations, active pharmaceutical substances for pharmacological materials in the manufacture of medicines, such as antibiotics, vitamins, salicylic and o-acetylsalicylic acid, blood processing, chemically pure sugars, pharmaceutical salts, gland processing, and gland extraction.

This group covers the manufacture and processing of medicinal substances and auxiliary substances for humans, derived from chemical materials, natural materials, animals, and plants, including those derived from biological products, such as medicinal substances like antisera and other blood fractions, vaccines and homeopathic preparations, active pharmaceutical substances (antibiotics, vitamins, salicylic and o-acetylsalicylic acid, and others) for pharmacological materials in the medicines industry, blood processing, chemically pure sugars, pharmaceutical salts, gland processing, and the production of gland extracts.
This group does not cover the manufacture of monosodium glutamate (MSG), see group 10779.

This group covers the manufacture and processing of medicines, health/dietary supplements, and quasi-drugs in finished dosage form for humans, for example in the form of tablets, capsules, ointments, powders, solutions, parenteral solutions and suspensions, hormonal contraceptive medicines; the production of radiopharmaceuticals; and the production of biotechnology pharmaceuticals.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan dan pera: This group covers the manufacture and assembly of various bicycles and pedicabs, such as bicycles without motors, bicycles equipped with electric motors, and other bicycles, including tricycles (delivery), tandems, and children's bicycles whether two-wheeled or three-wheeled, including the manufacture of prams, mobility vehicles or wheelchairs for persons with disabilities whether motorized or not, and electrically assisted bicycles (i.e., bicycles with an auxiliary motor to provide movement). This group also covers multipurpose non-motorized bicycles.

This group covers the complete manufacture and assembly of various two- and three-wheeled motor vehicles, such as motorcycles, mopeds, scooters, bemos, side-cars, skateboards, and the like, using reciprocating or rotary internal-combustion spark-ignition piston engines, or electric motors for propulsion. This group also covers the manufacture and remanufacture of multipurpose two- and three-wheeled motor vehicles.
This group covers the manufacture and assembly of televisions, such as television receivers and combinations, television monitors, and displays such as videotrons.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan furnitur: This group covers the manufacture of furniture whose primary material is rattan and bamboo, such as tables, chairs, stools, beds, cabinets, shelves, and room partitions.
This group covers the manufacture of household and office furniture whose primary material is metal, such as tables, chairs, shelves, beds, cabinets, and room partitions.
This group covers the manufacture of furniture whose primary material is plastic, such as tables, chairs, shelves, stools, room partitions, cabinets, and beds.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan kain cro: This group covers the manufacture of crocheted fabric worked manually with a crochet hook to produce a series of loops forming a plain fabric or a particular pattern. Crocheted fabric is made using a technique in which each stitch is completed before the next stitch is begun, unlike knitting, which keeps many stitches open simultaneously.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan kartu ce: This group covers the manufacture of smart cards, such as chip design planning (design house), smart-card circuit layout planning, chip foundry production, chip module packaging, the production of firmware and software directly related to smart cards, as well as chip packaging. Smart cards may take the form of various products, such as SIM cards and near field communication (NFC) cards, using 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G and similar technologies, banking cards, access cards, micro- and macro-payment cards, credit cards, and all cards that employ data and/or communication security.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan kayu lam: This group covers the manufacture of laminated wood such as barecore, blockboard, and lamin board.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan kertas m: This group covers the manufacture of magnetic paper, creped (crepe) paper or crinkled paper, the manufacture of laminates and foil where laminated with paper or paperboard, the manufacture of cellulose wadding and webs of cellulose fibres, the manufacture of hand-made paper, and the manufacture of carbon paper or stencil paper in rolls or large sheets.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan komponen:
This group covers the manufacture of other electronic components and boards not elsewhere classified, such as transistors and similar semiconductor devices, integrated circuits, printed circuits, inductors, resistors, capacitors, and various other electronic components, including the manufacture of microprocessors, microcontrollers, inductors of the electronic-component type (e.g. chokes, coils, and transformers), electronic crystals and crystal assemblies, solenoids, switches and transducers for electronic applications, interface cards (e.g. sound cards, video cards, controllers, network cards, and modems), display components (e.g. plasma, polymer, and LCD), light emitting diodes (LED), integrated circuits (IC) (whether analog, digital, or hybrid), and diodes.
This group also covers the manufacture of chips, wafers, dice, and programmable logic controllers (PLC).

This group covers the manufacture of components and spare parts for two- and three-wheeled motor vehicles, such as internal combustion engines, suspensions, brakes, gearboxes, road wheels, mufflers, exhaust pipes, mirror housings, body covers, and mudguards, including inverters for two- and three-wheeled motor vehicles.
This group also covers the finishing of plastic spare parts and components for two- and three-wheeled motor vehicles, such as coating with metal or other coating substances and painting.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan logam ur: This group covers the manufacture of uranium metal and related compounds from pitchblende or other ores; the manufacture of uranium alloys, dispersions (including cermets), ceramic products, and mixtures containing natural uranium or its compounds; the smelting and refining of uranium metal from uranium ore or other uranium-bearing ores. This group includes the enrichment of uranium and thorium as a single sequence of activities to produce nuclear fuel.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan mesin ja:
This group covers the manufacture of sewing machines, sewing-machine heads, sewing-machine needles (whether for household or commercial use), including the manufacture of overlock machines, embroidery machines, overcasting machines, and machines for laundering and dry cleaning (washing machines with or without water, drying machines, ironing machines and others).
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of washing machines, drying machines and the like for household use, see group 27510;
- the manufacture of sewing needles not attached to sewing machines, see group 25999.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan mesin pa: This group covers the manufacture of paper-mill machinery, such as machines for processing pulp, paper and paperboard, e.g. pulp-making machines, paper-making machines and machines for making or finishing paperboard, machines for drying wood, pulp, and paper, and machines for making articles of paper or paperboard, such as paper-cutting machines, envelope makers, as well as paper bags and the like.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan mesin pe: This group covers the manufacture of packaging, bottling, and canning machinery that functions to fill, cap, seal, wrap and label bottles, cans and boxes, including machines for drying and cleaning beverage bottles, machines for aerating beverages and the like.

This group covers the manufacture of refrigerating and freezing equipment (cold storage) for commercial purposes and the assembly of its main components, such as display cases, vending cases (dispensing cases), air-conditioning (AC) machines, including for motor vehicles, fans and exhaust hoods for industrial and laboratory use including the manufacture of their components and accessories, machines for liquefying air or gas, and equipment for refrigerating biological products (vaccines and blood).
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan mesin pr: This group covers the manufacture of leather-product machinery, such as machines for preparing, tanning, or working hides and skins and machines for making or repairing footwear or other products from hides, skins, and furskins.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan mesin um: This group covers the manufacture of other general-purpose machinery, such as fire sprinklers, machines for filtering and purifying liquids and gases, liquid-distillation units, equipment for projecting, dispersing or spraying liquids or powders, such as spray guns, fire extinguishers, sandblasting machines, steam cleaning machines and others, distillation or rectification machines for oil refineries, the chemical industry, the beverage industry, heat exchangers and others, gas generators, other rolling machines and their cylinders (except for metal and glass) including calendering machines (pressing machines), centrifugal machines (except cream separators and clothes dryers), packing and rope machines for insulation and the like made from a combination of materials or layers of the same material, automatic vending machines, attic ventilation fans (gable/wall fans, roof ventilators and others), tape measures and similar hand tools, precision machinists' instruments (non-optical) and non-electric brazing and soldering equipment, including the manufacture of their components and equipment.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan mesin-me: This group covers the manufacture of printing machinery, such as simple presses, cylinder presses, and rotary presses, including printing-support machinery and bookbinding machinery, such as book-sewing machines, spiral-binding machines, and page-numbering machines.

This group covers the manufacture of weighing machines (other than for laboratory use), such as scales for shop, office and household use such as baby scales, body scales, weighing devices integrated with calculators, station scales, scales for continuous weighing, weighbridges and other scales, whether mobile or not, including the manufacture of their components and accessories.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan panel ka: This group covers the manufacture of other wood panels, such as fibreboard, e.g. low density fibreboard (LDF), medium density fibreboard (MDF), and high density fibreboard (HDF); particle board; oriented strand board (OSB); chip board; and honeycomb board.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan pemurnia: This group covers the refining, smelting, and the alloying and casting of precious metals in primary form (ingots, billets, slabs, bars, pellets, blocks, sheets, pigs, alloys and powder), such as silver ingots, gold ingots, and platinum pellets.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan perabot: This group covers the manufacture of furniture for surgical, medical, dental and veterinary use, whether mechanically or electrically operated, such as operating tables, IV poles, hospital beds, professional massage chairs, and chairs for dental examination and treatment.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan peralata: This group covers the manufacture of electromedical and electrotherapeutic equipment and apparatus, such as electrocardiograph (ECG) equipment, eye-testing equipment (including reflectors, endoscopes, and others), ozone therapy equipment, oxygen therapy equipment, scanners for medical diagnostics, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) equipment, ultrasonography (USG) equipment, electromedical endoscopy equipment, medical laser equipment, hearing aids, respiratory aids and therapy devices, pacemakers, electric medical massage devices, X-ray film viewers, and electromedical ventilators. This group also covers the manufacture of electromedical and electrotherapeutic equipment or devices equipped with internet of things (IoT) features.

This group covers the manufacture of equipment and apparatus for health examination, surgery, dentistry and veterinary medicine, such as dental drills, eye-testing equipment, hypodermic needles, sterilization equipment, massage equipment, artificial-respiration apparatus, orthopaedic and prosthetic appliances (crutches, surgical belts and trusses, as well as corsets and orthopaedic shoes), medical thermometers, dental-laboratory furnaces, laboratory ultrasonic cleaning machines, laboratory-type centrifuges, plates that remain permanently inside the body, e.g. to replace part or all of a bone, syringes, hypodermic needles, catheters, cannulae and the like, dental equipment, artificial teeth and the like made in dental laboratories, artificial eyes of glass and other artificial body parts, such as glass eyes, artificial skulls and artificial internal body parts, orthopaedic shoes made to measure as orthopaedic footwear and special soles for correcting orthopaedic conditions, and electromechanical equipment for skin treatment. This group also covers the manufacture of various equipment and apparatus in the form of surgical instruments, such as scissors, forceps, and pliers.

This group covers the manufacture of lighting equipment for motorised transport vehicles, automobiles, aircraft, ships, and other means of transport (brake lights, turn-signal lights (indicator lights), interior lights, and so on), including the manufacture of their components and accessories.

This group covers the manufacture of wireless communication transmission equipment, such as pagers, cordless telephones, cellular telephones, cellular tablets, as well as mobile communication equipment.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan perkakas:
This group covers the manufacture of hand tools, whether with electric or non-electric motors, driven by air pressure or water pressure, such as circular and reciprocating saws, chain saws, drills and hammer drills, hand-operated sandblasters, nailers (pneumatic), buffers, routers, grinders, staplers, nail guns, planers, shears and pincers, wrenches, and powder-actuated nailers.
This group does not cover:
- the manufacture of brazing and soldering equipment and interchangeable spare parts for pneumatic tools and power tools, see subgroup 2593;
- the manufacture of hand-held electric soldering and welding machines and their equipment, see subgroup 2790.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan serutan: This group covers the manufacture of veneer sheets by rotary peeling, slicing, and similar methods.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan suku cad: This group covers the manufacture of bicycle parts, components, and accessories such as frames, forks, rims and spokes, hubs, brakes, saddles, pedals, crank gears, and derailleurs, including accessories for baby strollers, wheelchairs for persons with disabilities, and pedicabs, such as saddles, pedals, rims, brakes, spokes, wheels, and tyre valves. The manufacture of bicycle tyres (outer and inner) is classified in groups 22111 and 22112.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan tabung g: This group covers the manufacture of television picture tubes, television camera tubes, amplifier tubes and valves, and receivers, including electron tubes, electronic connectors, printer cables, monitor cables, USB cables, connectors, and the like, electronic valves, and lamp tubes.
Kelompok ini mencakup pembuatan, perakit: This group covers the manufacture, assembly, rebuilding, or modification of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) designed to be operated by remote control by a pilot, by automatic control based on artificial intelligence, or by mixed control (optionally piloted when required), such as UAVs for agriculture, topographic survey, search and rescue, cargo delivery, reconnaissance and surveillance, combat support, mine clearance, and air defence. This group does not cover the manufacture of UAVs for recreational purposes, see subgroup 3240.
Kelompok ini mencakup pencetakan koran,: This group covers the printing of newspapers, magazines, and other periodicals such as tabloids, magazines, journals, pamphlets, books and brochures, sheet music, maps, atlases, posters, advertising catalogues, prospectuses and other printed advertising, diaries, calendars, business letters and other commercial printed matter, personal stationery, and other printed matter produced by letterpress, offset, photogravure, flexographic, and similar printing presses, duplicating machines, computer printers, and embossing presses including high-speed presses; printing on labels or identification tags (lithography, gravure printing, flexographic printing, and so on); printing, with or without an intermediate medium, onto textiles, plastics, glass, metal, wood, and ceramics; laser engraving on textiles; reprinting via computer, stencil machines, and the like; document photocopying services not forming part of an office support services offering. Such printed matter is usually copyright-protected. This group also covers the printing of signs, beer coasters, and photographs; and advertising printing activities. The manufacture of labels from paper or paperboard is classified in group 17099.
Kelompok ini mencakup pencetakan prangko: This group covers the printing of postage stamps, fiscal stamps, documents, cheques, and other security paper, revenue stamps, banknotes, blank cheques, giro forms, share certificates, bonds and stock certificates, passports, and airline tickets.
Kelompok ini mencakup pencetakan tiga di: This group covers three-dimensional (3D) printing for various purposes, from polymers, plastics, clay, metal ores, and other materials.
Kelompok ini mencakup pendederan, pemeli: This group covers the nursing, rearing, grow-out, breeding or hatchery production, and harvesting of non-protected freshwater ornamental fish, such as discus, botia, goldfish, koi carp, arowana, black ghost, betta, silver dollar, polypterus (palmas), rainbow fish, tetra, diamond tetra, barb fish, molly, platy, and angelfish. This activity may be carried out on land, in waters, and in other artificial facilities using freshwater as the cultivation medium.
Kelompok ini mencakup pendidikan bagi an: This group covers education for children aged 4 to 6 years with a focus on integrating Islamic values into preparatory learning for the primary education level, including the introduction of religious practices, prayer memorisation, and understanding of the Qur'an, such as early childhood education (PAUD) Al-Qur'an, raudhatul athfal (RA), and bustanul athfal (BA).

This group covers education for children from birth to 6 years of age, with priority from birth to 4 years of age, organised either by the government or by the community, such as childcare centres and childcare centres established in cooperation with foreign educational institutions.

This group covers education for children aged 2 to 6 years, with priority for ages 3 and 4 years, managed either by the government or by the community, such as playgroups and playgroups established in cooperation with foreign educational institutions.

This group covers education for children aged 4 to 6 years, with priority for ages 5 and 6 years, emphasising the holistic development of the child's potential while still providing religious education of a general nature and not focused in depth on any one particular religion, organised by the government, such as state kindergartens and state special-needs kindergartens.

This group covers education for children aged 4–6 years, with priority for ages 5 and 6 years, emphasising the comprehensive development of the child's potential while still providing religious education of a general nature and not in depth on any one particular religion, and organised by the private sector, such as private kindergartens, kindergartens established in cooperation with foreign educational institutions, and private special-needs kindergartens.
Kelompok ini mencakup pendidikan bagi pe: This group covers education for learners aged 13 to 15 years and related equivalency education oriented towards Protestant, Catholic, Hindu, Buddhist, or Confucian religious studies, including the study of scriptures; rules of worship; classical religious languages; and the history of civilisation and religious figures, while still including the study of general knowledge and skills, such as Christian theological junior high schools, Catholic religious junior high schools, madyama widyalaya, madyama widya pasraman, and muda dhammasekha.

This group covers education for learners aged 13 to 15 years and related equivalency education oriented towards Islamic studies, including the study of the Qur'an, hadith, fiqh, Islamic history, and Arabic, while still including the study of general knowledge and skills, such as madrasah tsanawiyah (MTs), muadalah wustha education, formal diniyah wustha education, pesantren education in the form of classical-text (kitab kuning) study at the wustha level, and equivalency education at salafiyah Islamic boarding schools at the wustha level.

This group covers education for learners aged 13 to 15 years and related equivalency education organised by the government, oriented towards the study of general knowledge and skills, such as state junior high schools, state special-needs junior high schools, and state Package B.

This group covers education for learners aged 13-15 years and the related equivalency education provided privately, oriented toward the learning of general knowledge and skills, such as private junior secondary schools, junior secondary schools established in cooperation with foreign educational institutions, private special-needs junior secondary schools, and private Paket B.

This group covers education for learners aged 16 to 18 years and related equivalency education oriented towards Protestant, Catholic, Hindu, Buddhist, or Confucian religious studies, including the study of scriptures; rules of worship; classical religious languages; and the history of civilisation and religious figures, while still including the study of general knowledge and skills, such as Christian theological senior high schools, Catholic religious senior high schools, utama widyalaya, utama widya pasraman, and utama dhammasekha.

This group covers education for learners aged 16 to 18 years and related equivalency education oriented towards Islamic studies, including the study of the Qur'an, hadith, fiqh, Islamic history, and Arabic, while still including the study of general knowledge and skills, such as madrasah aliyah (MA), muadalah ulya education, formal diniyah ulya education, pesantren education in the form of classical-text (kitab kuning) study at the ulya level, and equivalency education at salafiyah Islamic boarding schools at the ulya level.

This group covers education for learners aged 16 to 18 years and related equivalency education oriented towards the development of vocational knowledge and skills integrated with Protestant, Catholic, Hindu, Buddhist, or Confucian religious values and teachings, including the study of scriptures; rules of worship; classical religious languages; and the history of civilisation and religious figures.

This group covers education for learners aged 16 to 18 years and related equivalency education organised by the government, oriented towards the study of general knowledge and skills, such as state senior high schools, state special-needs senior high schools, and state Package C.

This group covers education for learners aged 16-18 years and related equivalency education provided privately, oriented toward the learning of general science and skills, such as private senior secondary schools, primary schools established in cooperation with foreign educational institutions, private special-needs senior secondary schools, and private Package C programmes.

This group covers education for learners aged 7 to 12 years and related equivalency education oriented towards Protestant, Catholic, Hindu, Buddhist, or Confucian religious studies, including the study of scriptures; rules of worship; classical religious languages; and the history of civilisation and religious figures, while still including the study of general knowledge and skills, such as Christian theological primary schools, Catholic religious primary schools, adi widyalaya, adi widya pasraman, and mula dhammasekha.

This group covers education for learners aged 7 to 12 years and related equivalency education oriented towards Islamic studies, including the study of the Qur'an, hadith, fiqh, Islamic history, and Arabic, while still including the study of general knowledge and skills, such as madrasah ibtidaiyah (MI), muadalah ula education, formal diniyah ula education, pesantren education in the form of classical-text (kitab kuning) study at the ula level, and equivalency education at salafiyah Islamic boarding schools at the ula level.

This group covers education for learners aged 7 to 12 years and related equivalency education organised by the government, oriented towards the study of general knowledge and skills, such as state primary schools, state special-needs primary schools, and state Package A.
Kelompok ini mencakup pendidikan bimbing: This group covers tutoring and counseling education provided by private parties. The educational or course activities included in this group are: learning tutoring, health guidance, organizational guidance, ethics and social conduct; education in business consultancy, tax consultancy, psychological consultancy and human resources development, megabrain, superbrain, powerbrain, mental arithmetic; playgroup supervisors, preschool supervisors, family guidance, education for children and the elderly, personality development, learning-method development, human resources development, enhancement of children's creativity, enhancement of educators' potential, kindergarten teacher education (PGTK), abacus, and preschool tutoring.
Kelompok ini mencakup pendidikan menenga: This group covers vocational secondary education organised by the government, oriented towards the study of knowledge and skills in various vocational fields, such as state vocational secondary schools (SMK), with study programmes such as tourism, culinary arts, management, office administration, hospitality, engineering, pharmacy, beauty and hairdressing, and agriculture (including marine affairs and fisheries), as well as state special-needs schools for learners with special needs at the secondary education level.

This group covers vocational secondary education organised by the private sector, such as private vocational secondary schools (SMK), with study programmes such as tourism, culinary arts, management, office administration, hospitality, engineering, pharmacy, beauty and hairdressing, and agriculture, vocational secondary schools established in cooperation with foreign educational institutions, and private special-needs schools for learners with special needs at the secondary education level.

This group covers vocational secondary education oriented towards the development of vocational knowledge and skills integrated with Islamic religious values and teachings, including the study of scriptures; rules of worship; classical religious languages; and the history of civilisation and religious figures, such as vocational madrasah aliyah, with study programmes such as multimedia, animation, administration, accounting, pharmacy, tourism, seafaring, mechanical engineering, culinary arts, and electrical engineering, including equivalency schools and Islamic religious special-needs schools for learners with special needs at the secondary education level.
Kelompok ini mencakup pendidikan untuk a: This group covers education for children aged 4 to 6 years with a focus on integrating Protestant, Catholic, Hindu, Buddhist, or Confucian values into preparatory learning for the primary education level, such as seminary kindergartens, pratama widyalaya, pratama widya pasraman, and nava dhammasekha.
Kelompok ini mencakup pendidikan yang di: This group covers education organised by the government at the diploma, bachelor's, master's, and doctoral levels, as well as other equivalent academic, professional, and vocational programmes, integrating general knowledge with religious values and offering specialised study programmes focused on religious disciplines, whether Islam, Protestantism, Catholicism, Hinduism, Buddhism, or Confucianism. This group covers higher education organised by the government at universities, institutes, and colleges (sekolah tinggi).

This group covers education organised by the government at the diploma, bachelor's, master's, and doctoral levels, as well as other equivalent academic, professional, and vocational programmes, integrating general knowledge with religious values and offering specialised study programmes focused on religious disciplines. This group covers higher education organised by the private sector at universities, institutes, colleges (sekolah tinggi), and ma'had aly, such as Islamic universities, theological colleges, and seminary colleges.

This group covers education provided by the government at the diploma, bachelor's, master's, and doctoral levels, as well as equivalent academic, professional, and vocational education, oriented toward the universal advancement of science, technology, the arts, and the humanities. This group covers higher education provided by the government at universities, institutes, and colleges.

This group covers privately organized education at the diploma, bachelor's, master's, and doctoral levels, as well as other academic-equivalent, professional, and vocational education, oriented toward the development of science, technology, the arts, and the humanities in a universal manner. This group covers higher education organized privately at universities, institutes, and colleges.
Kelompok ini mencakup pendidikanbagi pes: This group covers education for learners aged 7-12 years and related equivalency education provided privately, oriented towards the learning of science and general skills, such as private primary schools, primary schools established in cooperation with foreign educational institutions, private special-needs schools at the primary level, and private Package A programmes.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengangkutan darat: This group covers land transport for other passengers via urban or rural transit systems. Such transport operates on scheduled routes along normal lines, picking up and setting down passengers at fixed stops and times.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengelolaan dana p: This group covers the management of financial-institution pension funds operated based on sharia principles, comprising the operation of defined-contribution pension schemes for individuals, both employees and self-employed workers, separate from the employer-sponsored pension fund for employees of the bank or life insurance company concerned.

This group covers the management of financial-institution pension funds operated on a conventional basis, with business activities comprising the operation of defined-contribution pension schemes for individuals, both employees and self-employed workers, separate from the employer-sponsored pension fund for employees of the bank or life insurance company concerned.

This group covers the management of employer-sponsored pension funds operated based on sharia principles, established by a person or entity that employs workers, as founder, to operate a defined-benefit pension scheme or a defined-contribution pension scheme for the benefit of some or all of its employees as members, giving rise to an obligation on the employer.

This group covers the management of employer-sponsored pension funds operated on a conventional basis, established by a person or entity that employs workers, as founder, to operate a defined-benefit pension scheme or a defined-contribution pension scheme for the benefit of some or all of its employees as members, giving rise to an obligation on the employer.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengelolaan lahan: This group covers the management of a single contiguous tract of land designated as an area for the concentration of industrial activities, equipped with supporting facilities and infrastructure, developed and managed by the area manager.

This group covers the management of land by arranging and further subdividing it into specific node units or designated environments, constructing or leasing node units for the development of the required tourism facilities and infrastructure, carrying out and/or supervising the development of tourism businesses in accordance with the applicable requirements, and constructing or providing premises for business administration purposes within the area.

This group covers the management of land located in special economic zones (KEK). The management of land designated as a zone for the concentration of business activities equipped with supporting facilities and infrastructure carried out within the zone, including all activities relating to the development, management, leasing, as well as the construction or provision of zone services carried out by the development business entity and the management business entity for business actors.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengelolaan real e: This group covers the management of residential real estate on a fee or contract basis, for example supervising and coordinating the operation, maintenance, and repair of residences; preparing the design and collection of residential dues; preparing the budget and revenue-and-expenditure plan for residential management; and drawing up and enforcing residential rules and regulations.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengelolaan tempat: This group covers the management of venues and facilities, as well as exhibition activities for cultural heritage, art objects, collections, and/or replicas that serve educational, recreational, and research functions to support tourism development with attention to conservation value, with the aim of generating profit, managed by the government.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengembangan, peny: This group covers the development, leasing, and operation of office buildings, coworking spaces, and office space.
Kelompok ini mencakup penggalian asbes d: This group covers the mining of asbestos, whether in fibrous form or not, including its cleaning and separation activities.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengolahan barang: This group covers the processing of metal scrap and metal waste into secondary raw materials. The output of the recycling/recovery of metal materials consists of secondary raw materials in various forms, such as metal pieces or chips. Activities in this group include the separation and sorting of metal waste, mechanical crushing of metal waste, mechanical reduction of metal waste, dismantling, cutting and shredding of metal waste, ship breaking and dismantling of other floating structures, and others. The manufacture of new metal goods using secondary raw materials, metal scrap, and metal waste is classified in the appropriate group under category C.
This group covers the processing of plastic scrap into secondary raw materials. Activities in this group include the sorting of plastics and the processing of plastic waste into granules.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengolahan, pembua: This group covers the treatment, disposal, and storage of radioactive waste, including: the treatment and disposal of radioactive waste in transition, namely decay over the transport period, from hospitals; encapsulation, preparation, and other treatment of radioactive waste.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengoperasian kere:
This group covers the operation of railways dedicated to tourism (sightseeing) serving inter-regional journeys over relatively long distances.
This group does not cover:
- short-distance (intra-city) tourist rail transport for passengers, see group 49221;
- the operation of cable cars, gondolas, chairlifts, and other railways as part of the operation of amusement and recreation venues, see subclass 9329.

This group covers the operation of railways that are not part of long-distance (intercity) rail transport or short-distance urban (intra-city) rail transport.
This group also covers:
- the operation of cable cars, gondolas, and other railways that are not part of intercity or intra-city transport.
This group does not cover:
- short-distance (intra-city) tourist rail transport, see group 49221;
- the operation of cable cars, gondolas, chairlifts, and other railways as part of the operation of amusement and recreation venues, see subclass 9329.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengoperasian laha: This group covers the operation of landfills for the disposal of non-hazardous waste and refuse, the disposal of non-hazardous waste and refuse through heating, combustion, incineration, or other methods, with or without producing output in the form of industrial raw materials or other by-products, other than energy; and the treatment of organic waste and refuse for disposal.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengoperasian pela:
This group covers the operation of vehicle traffic services via toll roads or toll bridges.
This group does not cover:
- the construction and maintenance of toll roads or toll bridges, see category F.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengoperasian plat: This group covers the operation of digital platforms (for example, websites, mobile applications) that facilitate retail trade between sellers and buyers for the ordering of goods on the basis of a fee or commission, without supplying or taking ownership of the intermediated goods. The fee or commission may be received from either the seller or the buyer.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengoperasian temp: This group covers the operation of venues and facilities for dancing as the principal activity accompanied by music and light show attractions, with the serving of food and beverages not constituting the principal activity, such as discotheques.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengoperasian term: This group covers the operation of land terminals, such as transport parking services, scheduling of vehicle departures (public transport), and passenger boarding and alighting services.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengoperasian tran:
This group covers the operation of land transport for tourism purposes (sightseeing), such as for individual or group sightseeing trips.
This group does not cover:
- the operation of transport at tourist sites as part of the operation of a tourist destination/area, see subclass 9329.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengoperasian yang: This group covers the operation by third parties of electric power utilization installation facilities, comprising high-voltage electric power utilization installations, medium-voltage electric power utilization installations, and low-voltage electric power utilization installations.
This group covers the operation by third parties of generation facilities that produce electrical energy, electric power transmission system facilities, and electric power distribution systems.
Kelompok ini mencakup pengumpulan limbah: This group covers the collection of radioactive waste, which may include the identification, handling, packaging, and labeling of radioactive waste. This group also covers the activity of transporting radioactive waste to a waste manager.

This group covers the collection of hazardous waste and non-radioactive hazardous specific waste, namely materials that are explosive, oxidizing, flammable, toxic, irritant, carcinogenic, or corrosive, materials that can cause infection, and other substances and preparations hazardous to human health and the environment. These activities may also include the identification, handling, packaging, and labeling of hazardous waste and non-radioactive hazardous specific waste for transport purposes.
This group covers:
- the collection of hazardous waste and hazardous specific waste, such as used oil from ships or workshops, bio-hazardous biological waste, used accumulators and batteries, hazardous waste of animal origin, and expired medicines;
- the operation of waste transfer facilities for non-radioactive hazardous waste.
Kelompok ini mencakup penjahitan dan pem: This group covers made-to-order/customized tailoring and the making of clothing (not mass-produced/ready-made) serving the general public by cutting and sewing into ready-to-wear garments, such as coats, suits, ensembles, jackets, trousers, skirts, babywear, sportswear, pyjamas, nightgowns, kebaya, shirts, and dance costumes, including the making of parts of the goods in this group. Activities in this group include home-based tailors and atelier/boutique tailors. The repair of finished garments is classified in subclass 9529.
Kelompok ini mencakup penjualan eceran m: This group covers the retail sale of new motor cars, such as passenger cars and camping vehicles (for example caravans and motor homes).
This group covers the retail sale of used cars, such as passenger cars and camping vehicles (e.g. caravans and motor homes).
Kelompok ini mencakup penyediaan akomoda: This group covers the provision of short-term accommodation to the public with daily or weekly payment, carried out by an individual using a residential dwelling occupied by its owner and partly utilised for rental, giving tourists the opportunity to interact in daily life together with the owner of the dwelling.

This group covers the provision of short-term accommodation to the general public that manages and operates apartments as hotels for temporary residence, with payment calculated in accordance with applicable terms, for example hotel apartments/hotel condominiums (apartel/kondotel).

This group covers the provision of short-stay accommodation to the general public consisting of private houses specifically rented out to tourists together with their facilities and managed by the owners themselves.

This group covers the provision of short-term accommodation in the form of rooms that may be used for overnight stays shared with others (sharing room) or alone, in the context of tourism activities for the purpose of recreation, broadening knowledge/experience, and travel. This group also covers the activities of youth hostels and youth lodges.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyediaan dukunga: This group covers the provision of financial support, often combined with ancillary services, to assist entities in shipping goods to and from anywhere in the world. Included in this group is the Indonesia Export Financing Institution.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyediaan jasa be:
This group covers the provision of residential-based services and care and assistance services at the place of residence for sex workers, ex-convicts, vagrants and beggars, and victims of human trafficking. These activities may be carried out by the government or by social welfare institutions (LKS).
This group also covers social assistance activities in the form of shelter provided for a specified period; the provision of social assistance for socially disadvantaged persons, refugees, and immigrants; the activities of group rehabilitation homes for persons with social and personal problems; and other residential family support activities.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyediaan jasa pe: This group covers the provision of beverage services serving ready-to-consume drinks that are preceded by a preparation process and usually sold by means of itinerant vending, such as providers of es doger drinks, providers of es cincau drinks, and providers of jamu gendong (itinerant herbal tonic).

This group covers the provision of beverage-serving services that primarily serve ready-to-consume drinks prepared on the spot at a fixed location that can be relocated or assembled and dismantled, usually using a tent, such as coffee stalls and juice stalls.

This group covers the provision of personal care services managed by social welfare institutions for elderly persons or persons with disabilities who are unable to care for themselves and do not wish to live independently. The care facilities include rooms, meals, supervision, and assistance with daily living, such as domestic services. Nursing care services are sometimes provided to residents in a separate location.

This group covers the provision of personal care services managed by the government for elderly persons or persons with disabilities who are unable to care for themselves and do not wish to live independently. The care facilities include rooms, meals, supervision, and assistance with daily living, such as domestic services. Nursing care services are sometimes provided to residents in a separate location.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyediaan jasa so: This group covers the provision of residential-based social services and care and legal-aid services. These activities may be carried out by the government or by private parties. This group covers legal-aid and social-assistance activities provided to children in three categories (offenders, victims, and witnesses). This group also covers the activities of rehabilitation group homes for persons with social and personal problems, the activities of rehabilitation group homes for persons with criminal tendencies, and social protection shelters.

This group covers the provision of residential-based social services and child care and fostering services carried out by Child Social Welfare Institutions (LKS). This group covers the provision of temporary accommodation and round-the-clock social support given to children requiring special protection who do not need health and education services as their primary service, such as orphanages, children's dormitories, temporary shelters, and other residential-based family protection and support institutions. This group also covers residential activities in the form of social rehabilitation for persons experiencing social dysfunction, activities supporting the social reintegration process for persons experiencing social dysfunction, and child social welfare provider institutions.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyediaan pelatih: This group covers the provision of government-managed job training to enhance competencies through job training organized according to the needs of industry/users. Examples include job training in information and communication technology; the creative industry; tourism and hospitality; business and management; domestic workers; agriculture and fisheries; as well as other government job training.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyediaan tempat: This group covers the provision of venues and facilities for the martial arts of pencak silat (padepokan), karate (dojo), taekwondo (doljang), and boxing (sasana) as the principal activity.

This group covers the provision of land, water, and air sports venues and facilities, indoor or outdoor, such as the operation of swimming pools/arenas, bowling, slingshot, ice hockey, bungee jumping, and winter sports; the operation of paragliding and hang-gliding venues/arenas; as the principal activity.
This group covers the provision of sports venues and facilities for golf, badminton, volleyball, basketball, and tennis as the principal activity.

This group covers the provision of sports premises and facilities as a principal activity, and other facilities not covered under groups 93111 through 93116. This includes the provision of sport centres.

This group covers the provision of sports venues and facilities in the form of a circular or ring-shaped track, used for various motor racing competitions, horse racing, and dog racing, as the principal activity.

This group covers the provision of premises and facilities for fitness or other physical-conditioning activities as the principal activity. The operation of self-managed fitness/physical-conditioning schools/training is included in this group.

This group covers the provision of premises and facilities for enjoying the beauty of nature using a beach as the principal activity, including the rental of facilities such as bathrooms, lockers, and seating, and may also be complemented by the provision of food and beverage services as well as accommodation, for example Parangtritis Beach (D.I. Yogyakarta), Pandawa Beach (Bali), Mandeh Beach (West Sumatra).

This group covers the provision of places and facilities for the sports of football, hockey, cricket, baseball, jai alai, athletics (running, throwing, jumping, and others) as the main activity. The organising of self-managed sports schools/education for football, hockey, cricket, baseball, jai alai, and athletics (running, throwing, jumping, and others) is included in this group.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyediaan utamany: This group covers the provision of primarily beverages, both hot and cold, consumed on the business premises, located in part or all of a permanent building, whether or not equipped with equipment/facilities for the preparation and storage process.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyelenggaraan pa:
This group covers the operation of off-street parking, including parking buildings and parking lots located at office buildings, shopping centers, hospitals, and other off-street parking services.
This group does not cover:
- the operation of on-street parking, see group 52214.

This group covers the operation of on-street parking.
This group does not cover:
- the operation of off-street parking, see group 52215.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyelenggaraan pe: This group covers the provision of post-secondary education, both general and vocational, that does not fall within the category of tertiary education. This level covers post-secondary non-tertiary education and training programs, both general and vocational pathways. This group may also cover the provision of additional post-secondary education as preparation for higher education or post-secondary non-tertiary vocational education and training.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyelenggaraan tr: This group covers the conduct of financial transactions and other rupiah money management other than transactions in financial markets not elsewhere covered, for example the clearing and settlement of financial transactions other than for payment systems and fund transfers.
Kelompok ini mencakup penyewaan dan peng: This group covers the renting and operation of own or leased residential real estate.
Kelompok ini mencakup perdagangan besar: This group covers the wholesale of footwear, such as shoes, sandals, and slippers.

This group covers the wholesale of wooden construction materials, such as boards, joists, battens, molding strips, telephone poles, electricity poles, bearer beams, door/window frames, door/window leaves, wooden tiles, wooden roofing (shingles), plywood (triplex), interior plywood, teakwood, particle board, chipboard, veneer wood, and plywood for concrete formwork.

This group covers the wholesale of metal construction materials, such as wire rope, mosquito-screen wire, nails, nuts or bolts, hinges, bolts (latches), locks, keys, water tanks, water towers, rolling doors, and awnings.
This group covers the wholesale of porcelain construction materials, such as toilets, bidets, washbasins, urinals, sinks, bathtubs, and wall tiles.

This group covers the wholesale of other construction materials not covered in groups 46731 through 46738, such as wallpaper, plastic pipes and hoses, formica, corrugated plastic sheeting, flat asbestos cement, coated asbestos cement, and asbestos cement conduit pipes, including the wholesale of hand tools, power-driven hand tools, water heaters, and boilers.

This group covers the wholesale of construction materials made of clay, lime, cement, or glass, such as pressed roof tiles, interlocking roof tiles, pressed bricks, hollow bricks, fire bricks, floor tiles, wall tiles, concrete-block tiles, including ventilation blocks, bathtubs, toilets, ceiling boards, irrigation pipes, and concrete pipes.
This group covers the wholesale trade of other agricultural food and beverage products, such as seasoning plants and spices.
This group covers the wholesale of materials having toxic (toxicity), carcinogenic, teratogenic, mutagenic, corrosive, and irritant properties, also referred to as hazardous materials (B2).

This group covers the wholesale of used goods, scrap, metal and non-metal cuttings, and materials for recycling, including the collection, sorting, separation, and dismantling of still-usable goods—for example cars, to obtain still-usable parts—packing and repacking, storage and shipment, but without any actual transformation process, involving the purchase and sale of waste goods that still retain value.
This group covers the wholesale of goods made of paper and cardboard, such as paper bags, toilet tissue, disposable diapers, and disposable sanitary napkins.
This group covers the wholesale of printing and publishing products in various forms, such as books, magazines, and newspapers.
This group covers the wholesale trade of rice.

This group covers the wholesale of various games and toys, both traditional and modern, such as board games, dolls, card games, model kits, electronic games, and video game consoles.
This group does not cover the wholesale of physical media of video game software, see subclass 4651.

This group covers the wholesale of various basic chemical or industrial chemical materials and products other than hazardous materials, such as printer ink, essential oils, industrial gases (including hydrogen), chemical adhesives, dyes, artificial resins, methanol, paraffin, flavorings and fragrances, soda, industrial salts, acids, and sulfur.

This group covers the wholesale trade of various other goods and household supplies, such as cleaning implements; non-electric toothbrushes; electric bicycles, monowheels, hoverboards, scooters; recorded media, including audio and video recordings on cassettes, CDs and DVDs; baby supplies, such as prams, strollers, baby walkers, baby carriers, baby car seats; sports medals and trophies; tents and sleeping bags; promotional goods; imitation jewellery; household chemical products (detergents, floor cleaners, and others); and educational teaching aids.
This group covers the wholesale trade of various jewellery items, watches and clocks, and related parts, such as watch cases, watch straps, clock frames, and timekeeping movements.

This group covers the wholesale trade of various forms of pharmaceutical preparations, comprising drug substances, natural medicinal substances, cosmetics, quasi-drugs, health supplements, medicines, and herbal medicines, intended for human use.

This group covers the wholesale trade of various paints for construction materials, such as primers, metal paints, wood paints, and wall paints, including also the retail trade of enamel, putty, and surfacing filler.
This group covers the wholesale trade of various kinds of building materials, such as cement, sand, nails, and paint.

This group covers the wholesale trade of ferrous and non-ferrous metal ores and concentrates, such as nickel ores and concentrates, copper ores and concentrates, aluminium ores and concentrates, iron ores and concentrates, gold ores and concentrates together with other precious metals (silver, platinum).
This group covers the wholesale trade of fruits, such as oranges, apples, pears, and mangoes.
This group covers the wholesale trade of chicken meat and processed chicken meat, including preserved chicken meat.
This group covers the wholesale trade of meat and other processed meat, including other preserved meat.
This group covers the wholesale of beef and processed beef, including preserved beef.
This group covers the wholesale trade of sugar, chocolate, confectionery, and sweetening preparations.
This group covers the wholesale trade of textile-industry products, such as assorted textiles/fabrics, batik fabrics, and household linen (fabrics for household use).

This group covers the wholesale trade of textile-industry products, such as ropes and cordage, carpets/rugs of textile material, sacks, various knitted goods, articles of fur skin, umbrellas, parasols, tarpaulins, ship sails, parachutes.

This group covers the wholesale trade of forestry products, captive breeding, the gathering of forest products, and hunting, such as bamboo, sandalwood, dammar resin, forestry plant seedlings, the captive breeding of wildlife, and other forest products, including the procurement and distribution of seeds/seedlings, as well as the sale/purchase of seeds/seedlings to/from abroad.

This group covers the wholesale trade of processed tobacco products and cigarette flavourings; the wholesale trade of products and accessories for smoking, such as clove cigarettes, white cigarettes, electronic cigarettes (vape), matches, pipes, cigarette-rolling devices, and e-liquid.

This group covers the wholesale trade of other agricultural produce and live animals not elsewhere classified, such as agricultural residues and waste; agricultural by-products used for animal feed; and other plants and plant seedlings not mentioned above.
This group covers the wholesale trade of agricultural products from oil-bearing fruit crops, such as coconut, oil palm, and seeds of oil-bearing fruit.
This group covers the wholesale trade of agricultural products of flower plants and other ornamental plants, such as rose plants, jasmine, ornamental plant seedlings, and flower seeds.

This group covers the wholesale trade of agricultural produce of paddy and secondary crops (palawija), such as paddy, maize, unhusked rice (gabah), wheat, paddy seeds and seedlings, as well as secondary crops (palawija).
This group covers the wholesale trade of agricultural products from tobacco crops, such as unprocessed tobacco leaf and shredded tobacco.
This group covers the wholesale trade of fish and other live aquatic biota that are not for consumption, such as fish seedlings, ornamental fish, pearl oysters, and sponges.
This group covers the wholesale trade of food fish, shrimp, crab, oysters, pearls, shellfish, seaweed, sponges, and frogs; and the wholesale trade of processed fishery products.
This group covers the wholesale trade of sheet glass for construction materials, such as clear sheet glass, frosted sheet glass, tinted clear sheet glass, and engraved sheet glass.
This group covers the wholesale trade of rubber and plastic materials in primary forms.
This group covers the wholesale trade of electronic valves and tubes, semiconductor devices, microchips, integrated circuits (ICs), and printed circuit boards (PCBs).
This group covers the wholesale trade of paper and paperboard.
