This group covers the wholesale trade of computers and computer peripheral equipment, such as printers, multifunction printers (print, scan, copy, fax transmission) that are generally capable of connecting to computers and networks, interactive whiteboards, and video conferencing equipment.
This group covers the wholesale trade of coffee, tea, and cocoa.
This group covers the wholesale trade of leather and imitation leather.

This group covers the wholesale trade of other food and beverages, such as rice flour, tapioca flour, bakery premixes, caramel, processed honey, shrimp crackers, foods for special dietary uses (for infants, children, and adults), food additives, processing aids, snacks, cereals and cereal-based products whether unprocessed or processed, soybean-based beverages, ready-to-eat food, as well as the wholesale trade of pet food.

This group covers the wholesale trade of non-metallic minerals such as diamond, corundum, graphite, arsenic, quartz sand, fluorspar, cryolite, iodine, bromine, chlorine, sulphur, phosphate, halite, asbestos, talc, mica, magnesite, jarosite, ochre, fluorite, ball clay, zeolite, kaolin, feldspar, bentonite, gypsum, dolomite, calcite, chert, pyrophyllite, quartzite, zircon, wollastonite, alum, quartz stone, perlite, rock salt, clay, and limestone for cement.
This group covers the wholesale trade of radioactive minerals, such as radium, thorium, uranium, monazite, and other radioactive mineral materials.
This group covers the wholesale trade of alcoholic beverages, such as spirits, wine, malt, and beer.
This group covers the wholesale of non-alcoholic beverages, such as fruit nectars, juices, soft drinks, mineral water, and bottled water.
This group covers the wholesale trade of animal oils and fats.
This group covers the wholesale trade of vegetable oils and fats, including margarine as well as products based on vegetable fats, such as non-dairy cream.

This group covers the wholesale trade of new motor cars, including special-purpose vehicles (such as ambulances, caravans, minibuses, fire engines, and so forth), lorries, trailers, semi-trailers, goods vehicles, and various other motorised transport vehicles.

This group covers the wholesale trade of used motor cars, including special-purpose vehicles (such as ambulances, caravans, minibuses, fire engines, and so forth), lorries, trailers, semi-trailers, goods vehicles, and various other motorised transport vehicles.
This group covers wholesale trade of clothing, including sportswear; wholesale trade of clothing accessories such as gloves, ties, clasps, and socks.

This group covers the wholesale trade of kitchen and cooking utensils, such as pots and pans; the wholesale trade of consumer electronics, such as electric toothbrushes, radios, televisions, CD and DVD recorders and players, stereo equipment; the wholesale trade of porcelain and glass tableware, cutlery (spoons, knives, forks), wooden utensils, as well as wickerwork articles and cork articles.
This group covers the wholesale trade of laboratory, diagnostic, surgical, and similar equipment for animals, encompassing import, export, and distribution activities.

This group covers the wholesale trade of telecommunications equipment, such as telephone equipment, including telephones for cellular networks or other wireless networks; devices for the transmission or reception of voice, images, or other data, including communication devices over wired or wireless networks, modems, as well as radio and television broadcasting equipment.
This group covers the wholesale trade of writing and drawing supplies, such as exercise books, sketchbooks, writing instruments, and drawing instruments.
This group covers the wholesale trade of off-the-shelf software, including video games, supplied on physical media with a perpetual licence to use.
This group covers the wholesale trade of sewing supplies, such as needles, sewing thread, and zips.
This group covers the wholesale trade of bread, cakes, and other bakery products.
This group covers the wholesale trade of fertilisers and agrochemical or agricultural-chemical products.
This group covers the wholesale trade of vegetables, such as spinach, water spinach (kangkung), and cabbage.

This group covers the wholesale trade of cement, lime, sand, and stone for construction materials, such as white Portland cement, grey Portland cement, lime-pozzolan cement, Portland-pozzolan cement, quicklime, building lime, sand, gravel, coral aggregate, stone, crushed stone, slab stone, marble stone, and mosaic cubes.
This group covers the wholesale trade of new motorcycles, including mopeds.
This group covers the wholesale trade of used motorcycles, including bicycles with auxiliary motors (mopeds).
This group covers the wholesale trade of motorcycle parts and accessories.
This group covers the wholesale trade of milk and dairy products.

This group covers the wholesale trade of bags, wallets, suitcases, backpacks and similar articles, whether made of leather, imitation leather, textile, plastic, rubber or other materials; such as handbags, shopping bags, school bags, sports bags, wallets, vanity cases, sword/knife sheaths and camera cases.
This group covers the wholesale trade of eggs and processed egg products.
This group covers the wholesale trade of live animals other than fish, such as poultry, slaughter livestock and breeding stock.
This group covers the wholesale trade of radioactive substances and ionizing-radiation generators.
Kelompok ini mencakup perdagangan besar,: This group covers the wholesale trade, including importation, exportation and distribution, of various forms of pharmaceutical preparations intended for animal use, such as veterinary drug raw materials, animal cosmetics and veterinary medicines.
Kelompok ini mencakup perdagangan eceran: This group covers the retail trade of photographic equipment and supplies, such as still cameras, cinematographic cameras, cinematographic projectors, sound-recording devices, sound-reproduction devices, image projectors, overhead projectors, photographic flash units, camera frames, camera bodies, as well as image-projector accessories and film-transfer cassettes.
This group covers the retail sale of medical devices for humans, such as thermometers, blood-pressure gauges, hearing aids, orthopedic prostheses, and neck braces.

This group covers the retail trade of musical instruments, both traditional and modern, such as the kecapi, bamboo flute, calung, angklung, kolintang, gamelan set, rebab, rebana, tifa, sasando, flute, saxophone, harmonica, trombone, guitar, mandolin, ukulele, harp, bass, gambus, violin, cello, piano, organ, drum and tuning fork.

This group covers the retail trade of optical instruments and accessories, such as welding goggles, monocular telescopes, binocular telescopes, magnifying glasses, peep glasses, stereoscopes and microscopes.
This group covers the retail trade of water transport craft (motorized or non-motorized), such as boats and canoes, together with their components and accessories.

This group covers the retail trade of non-motorized land transport vehicles, such as bicycles for persons with disabilities, pedicabs (becak), bullock carts, pushcarts, horse-drawn carts (sado) and handcarts, as well as their components and accessories.

This group covers the retail trade of writing and drawing instruments, such as pencils, pens, markers, ballpoint pens, sign pens, mechanical pencils, compasses, drawing brushes, technical drawing pens (rapidographs), crayons and pastels, blackboards, drawing tables, white boards, screen-printing tools, typewriter ribbons, watercolor paints, oil paints, erasers, eraser blocks, correction fluid or tape, ink, pencil sharpeners, rulers and chalk.
This group covers the retail trade of agricultural implements, such as hoes, plows, sickles, crowbars, and non-mechanical rice threshers.

This group covers the retail trade of fuel oil, gaseous fuel, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), liquefied natural gas (LNG) or other types of fuel (for example hydrogen) at fueling facilities for land, sea and air transport (such as fuel stations (SPBU), gas stations (SPBG) and hydrogen stations (SPBH)) for motor vehicles such as cars and motorcycles, including also fuel for speedboats and generator sets. Generally, this activity is combined with the sale of lubricants, coolant products, cleaning agents and other goods for car and motorcycle needs.
This group does not cover:
- the wholesale trade of fuel, see group 46710;
- the retail trade of LPG and fuel for cooking or heating purposes, see group 47772.

This group covers the retail trade of fuel oil, gaseous fuel, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), liquefied natural gas (LNG), compressed natural gas (CNG) or other types of fuel, other than at fueling facilities for land, sea and air transport, such as fuel-oil agents and LPG agents, whether or not accompanied by the sale of lubricating oil. The retail trade of fuel for cars and motorcycles at fuel stations (SPBU) is included in group 47301.
This group covers the retail trade of used construction and sanitary materials, such as used washbasins, used toilets and used water tanks.
This group covers the retail trade of renewable-energy materials, such as solar collectors that do not generate electricity, photovoltaic panels and other materials, without installation services.
This group covers the retail trade of other used goods not yet included in groups 47741 through 47746.

This group covers the retail trade of used electrical and electronic goods, such as used radios, used tape recorders, used televisions, used washing machines, used electric irons and used hair dryers/curlers.

This group covers the retail trade of glassware and kitchen and dining utensils, such as plates, saucers, bowls, cups, teapots, spoons, forks, tiered lunch boxes (rantang), jars, baby bottles, pots, trays, buckets, thermoses, jerry cans, pitchers, earthenware jugs (kendi), cooking pots, grinding mortars (cobek), water jars (tempayan), ashtrays, pestles, pounding mortars (lumpang/lesung), coconut graters, cutting boards, washboards, ladles, baskets, winnowing trays (tampah), steamers, hand fans for cooking, food covers, satay skewers and meat grinders.

This group covers retail trade of jewellery items, whether made of precious stones, diamonds (intan), gemstones (batu aji), diamond dust and powder, precious/semi-precious stones, imitation gemstones, precious metals or non-precious metals, such as rings, necklaces, bracelets, earrings, hair-bun pins, brooch pins, brooches, belts, and buttons of precious metals (platinum, gold, and silver).
This group covers the retail trade of used personal accessories, such as used wristwatches, used wall clocks and used jewelry.
This group covers the retail trade of antiques, such as used urns, used brass bowls (bokor), used hanging lamps and used marble tables/chairs.

This group covers the retail trade of various forms of pharmaceutical preparations for human use in pharmacies, for example in the form of tablets, capsules, ointments, powders, solutions, parenteral solutions and suspensions, such as medicines for diseases of the skin, eyes, teeth, ears, respiratory tract, digestive tract, hypertension, hormonal disorders, as well as vitamins and health supplements, also including health-care articles made of rubber, among others condoms, breast pumps, baby-bottle teats, blood bags, surgical gloves, rubber pipettes, family-planning devices and rubber stoppers for pharmaceutical vials.

This group covers the retail trade of various types of necessities, predominantly food ingredients, food, beverages, or tobacco, at predetermined prices, where buyers pick out and pay for the goods themselves at the cashier (self-service). In addition, this activity may also conduct the retail trade of certain non-food goods such as household furnishings, children's toys, medicines, medical devices, and clothing, but it remains dominated by food, beverage, or tobacco goods, for example minimarkets, supermarkets, or hypermarkets.

This group covers the retail trade of various kinds of necessity goods, primarily foodstuffs/food, beverages, or tobacco, not using a self-service/minimarket/supermarket/hypermarket system. In addition, this activity may also sell some non-food goods such as clothing, household furniture, and children's toys, for example a stall (warung) or shop selling basic necessities.

This group covers retail trade in a variety of goods that are predominantly not food, beverages, or tobacco on a self-service basis, such as department stores. In general, the goods traded include, among others, clothing, furniture, jewelry, children's toys, sports equipment, and cosmetics.

This group covers the retail trade of various types of goods that are mainly non-food, non-beverage, or non-tobacco, other than on a self-service basis. In general, the goods traded include, among others, clothing, household furnishings, jewellery, children's toys, and cosmetics, integrated under a single management, for example a general-goods store.

This group covers the retail trade of various types of timepieces, such as wristwatches, pocket watches, wall clocks, alarm clocks and bells, including the retail trade of parts for watches and clocks.

This group covers the retail trade of various types of processed products of fish, shrimp and shellfish, salted or dried, in a building, such as sausages, meatballs, shredded floss (abon), as well as processed anchovy, shark, scad, grouper, shrimp, planktonic shrimp (rebon), ponyfish, snakehead, gourami, squid, surf clam (kepah), mussels (remis) and shellfish.

This group covers the retail trade of various paints and other coatings for construction materials, such as primer paint, metal paint, wood paint, wall paint, enamel, putty, filler (plamir), varnish and lacquer.

This group covers the retail trade of various kinds of eyeglasses, such as vision-aid eyeglasses, sun/light-filtering eyeglasses, contact lenses (contact lens, soft lens) and eyeglass frames. This group also covers the activities of opticians who sell eyeglasses.

This group covers the retail trade of various natural medicinal products, comprising traditional herbal medicines (jamu), standardized herbal medicines (OHT), phytopharmaceuticals and other natural medicinal products for human use, the ingredients of which are derived among others from plants, animals or minerals, for example in the form of pills, capsules, powders and liquids, as well as health supplements and quasi-drugs.
This group covers the retail trade of various traditional or natural medicines for animals.

This group covers the retail trade of souvenirs, handicrafts, and religious goods of various materials, such as statues, masks, reliefs, name carvings, wayang (puppets), frames, lampshades, picture frames, trays, bags, baskets, mats, hats/coverings, blinds, wall decorations, doormats, fans made of turtle shell, flower arrangements made of seashells, tobacco pipes made of bone, horn displays, flower vases, candle holders, trophies, medals, keychains, ashtrays, betel containers, money boxes, and flower pots, including the activities of art galleries that sell such handicrafts.
This group covers the retail trade of furniture, such as tables, chairs, cabinets, beds, bookshelves, shoe racks, sideboards, mattresses, and divan beds.

This group covers the retail trade of printing and publishing products, such as invoices, sales notes, receipts, business cards, labels, envelopes, planners, address books, greeting cards, postcards, postage stamps, revenue stamps, albums, notebooks, drawing books, lined paper, graph paper, atlases, Braille text, newspapers, magazines, bulletins, dictionaries, scientific books and picture books.
This group covers the retail trade of sheet glass for construction materials, such as clear sheet glass, frosted sheet glass, tinted transparent sheet glass and engraved sheet glass.

This group covers the retail trade of paper, paperboard and articles of paper/paperboard, such as bond (HVS) paper, flimsy copy (doorslag) paper, kraft paper, thin paper, tracing paper, colored paper, manila board, buffalo-skin board, fiberboard, wrapping paper, packaging cartons for food/beverages, paper bags, coated paper/board, letter paper (stationery), stencil sheets, carbon paper and duplicating paper.

This group covers specialized retail trade of aromatics/fresheners and essential oils, such as cananga oil, citronella oil, eucalyptus (cajuput) oil, sandalwood oil, lawang (cinnamon) oil, tengkawang (illipe) oil, gandapura (wintergreen) oil, castor oil, cardamom oil, nutmeg oil, delas oil, and vetiver oil.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of chemicals, such as caustic soda, soda ash, baking soda, ammonia, dyes, and preservatives.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of other new goods not elsewhere classified, such as the retail trade of cleaning agents, bamboo, sandalwood, dammar resin, weapons, and ammunition.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of various types of rice, such as Cianjur rice, Cisadane rice, Saigon rice, and glutinous rice.

This group covers the specialized retail trade of various types of processed meat products (beef, pork, poultry, lamb, rabbit, goat, camel, and other fresh meats), such as sausages, meatballs, and shredded meat floss (abon).

This group covers the specialized retail trade of various types of bread, dry confections and soft (moist) confections, such as sweet bread, plain bread, sponge cake, cakes, tarts, biscuits, wafers, egg-roll wafers (kue semprong), and cookies.

This group covers the specialized retail trade of fruits, such as apples, grapes, avocados, starfruit, langsat (duku), durian, guava, citrus, mango, mangosteen, pineapple, banana, papaya, rambutan, sapodilla, snake fruit (salak), and watermelon.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of fishery products, such as fresh shrimp, fresh fish, fresh squid, and seaweed.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of livestock products, such as milk, eggs, livestock meat, and poultry meat.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of forestry and hunting commodities, such as muntjac deer (kijang), canary nuts / galip nuts (kenari), and young bamboo shoots (rebung).

This group covers the specialized retail trade of industrially processed food commodities not covered in groups 47241 through 47246, such as pickled fruits and vegetables, preserved fruits and vegetables, crackers, and chips (emping/ceriping).
This group covers the specialized retail trade of coffee, granulated sugar, palm sugar, and tea.

This group covers specialized retail trade of various kinds of computers, equipment, and accessories, such as personal computers (PCs), laptops, printers, photocopiers, interactive whiteboards, and video-conferencing equipment.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of office machinery other than computers, such as typewriters, calculating machines, and cash registers.

This group covers specialized retail trade of alcoholic beverages within a building that are not consumed directly on the premises, such as spirits (whisky, genever, brandy, gin, arrack, rum, sake, palm wine), wine, and beverages containing malt (beer, ale, stout, temulawak). This activity may be conducted within a building or at other locations such as roadsides (street vendors), shop verandas (storefronts), flexible and movable fixed stalls in markets (market stalls), and other media, including via the internet.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of rice and secondary food crops (palawija), such as unhusked rice (gabah), maize, sweet potato, cassava, taro, soybean, peanut, black bean, and pea.

This group covers the specialized retail trade of audio and video equipment, such as radios, televisions, video equipment, tape recorders, amplifiers and cassette recorders, including stereo equipment, recordable media, and CD and DVD recording and playback equipment.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of software, such as various software supplied in physical form with perpetual usage rights.

This group covers the specialized retail trade of clothing accessories, such as shawls, headscarves, handkerchiefs, headbands, blangkon (Javanese headdress), peci (caps), hats, neckties, belts, veils, gloves, socks, towels, and blankets, and also includes the retail trade of buttons, zippers, and sewing thread.

This group covers the specialized retail trade of household furnishings made of textiles, such as tablecloths, bedsheets, tarpaulins, pillowcases, mosquito nets, mattress covers, pillow covers, floor cloths, and household linen, including pillows and bolsters.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of vegetables, such as shallots, garlic, potatoes, carrots, eggplant, green beans, cucumber, chayote, long beans, and red beans.

This group covers the specialised retail trade of shoes, sandals, and other footwear, whether made of leather, artificial leather, plastic, rubber, fabric, or wood, such as men's shoes, women's shoes, children's shoes, sports shoes, sandal-shoes, sandals, slippers, and orthopaedic (health) shoes.
This group covers the specialized retail trade of tofu, tempeh, tauco (fermented soybean paste), and oncom.

This group covers the specialised retail trade of bags, purses, suitcases, backpacks, and the like, whether made of leather, imitation leather, textile, plastic, rubber, or other materials, such as handbags, shopping bags, school bags, briefcases, sports bags, purses, vanity cases, sword/knife sheaths, camera cases, spectacle cases, and pencil cases, including the retail trade of umbrellas.

This group covers other retail trade not yet covered in groups 47721 to 47728, such as raw materials for pharmaceutical preparations and raw materials for traditional medicines (simplicia) for humans and animals; and other medical devices.
This group covers the retail trade of paintings, such as portraits, animal paintings, and landscape paintings, including the activities of art galleries that sell paintings.

This group covers the retail trade of agricultural machinery and equipment, such as tractors, ploughing machines, fertilizing machines, sowing machines, planting machines, dibbling machines, lawn mowers, spraying machines, peeling machines, threshing machines, rice milling units, milking machines, hand/foot sewing machines, electric sewing machines, overlock machines, embroidery machines, oversum machines, electric power generators, welding machines, coffee grinding machines, flour milling machines, sawing machines, lathes, turbines, water wheels, weaving machines, knitting machines, and printing machines, together with their components and spare parts.
This group covers the retail trade of lubricating oils and coolant products for motor vehicles.

This group covers the retail trade of veterinary pharmaceutical medicines, for example in powder, tablet, capsule, ointment, dry powder, solution, suspension, and aerosol form. This group also covers the retail trade of medicines for fish.
This group covers the retail trade of second-hand clothing, footwear, and clothing accessories, such as used shirts, used trousers, used coats, used shoes, used shawls, and used hats.

This group covers the retail trade of clothing, whether made of textiles, leather, or artificial leather, such as shirts, trousers, suits, coats, jackets, pyjamas, kebaya, blouses, skirts, daster (housedresses), singlets, brassieres/bras, gowns, petticoats, baby clothing, dance costumes, traditional dress, mukena (prayer garments), and robes. This group also covers the retail trade of general sportswear not specifically designed for a particular sport.

This group covers the retail trade of other household equipment and furnishings within subclass 4759 not elsewhere classified, such as palm-rib brooms, coir brooms, brushes, doormats, and mops/floor cloths.

This group covers the retail trade of emergency equipment, such as fire alarms, whether electric or electronic, fire extinguishers, emergency blocks, smoke extraction systems, safes, and strongboxes, without installation or maintenance services.
This group covers the retail trade of video game console equipment and video game products in physical form such as cartridges, CDs, DVDs, or other formats.

This group covers the retail trade of household electrical appliances and lighting equipment, such as washing machines, refrigerators, fans, vacuum cleaners, floor polishers, mixers, electric irons, blenders, incandescent lamps, fluorescent lamps, starters, ballasts, reflectors, cables, switches, electrical outlets, lamp fittings, and fuses.
This group covers the retail trade of tools and hardware equipment, whether hand-operated or electrically powered, such as hammers, saws, and screwdrivers.
This group covers the retail trade of sewing supplies, such as sewing thread and sewing needles.
This group covers the retail trade of motor vehicle riders' gear, such as helmets, jackets, raincoats, gloves, and masks.

This group covers the retail trade of second-hand household furnishings, such as used tables, used chairs, used cabinets, used beds, used buffets, and used eating and drinking ware. The retail trade of used cars and motorcycles is classified in groups 47812 and 47832.
This group covers the retail trade of ornamental plant supplies, such as pots and growing media.

This group covers the retail trade of pharmaceutical preparations for human use other than in pharmacies, for example in the form of tablets, capsules, ointments, solutions, parenteral solutions, and suspensions, such as medicines for diseases of the skin, eyes, teeth, ears, respiratory tract, digestive tract, hypertension, hormonal disorders, as well as vitamins and health supplements. For example, this activity may be carried out in drug stores, type B village pharmacies, and the sale of medicines in markets, including the sale of medicines by mobile vendors and via the internet.
This group covers the retail trade of new motorcycles, including motorized bicycles and mopeds.
This group covers the retail sale of used motorcycles, including motorized bicycles or mopeds.
This group covers the retail sale of motorcycle parts and accessories, whether new or used.

This group covers the retail sale of textiles, such as various fabrics made of natural, synthetic, or blended fibres, woven fabrics (cotton sarong cloth, polyester sarong cloth, silk suiting cloth, blended-fibre suiting cloth), printed fabrics (printed cotton fabric, printed polyamide fabric, waterproof fabric), batik fabrics (hand-drawn batik, stamped batik, combined hand-drawn and stamped batik), and knitted fabrics (knitted wool fabric, knitted rayon fabric, knitted wool/cotton fabric), including the retail sale of base materials for making carpets, wall-hanging tapestries, and embroidery or needlework.

This group covers the retail trade of telephones, such as mobile phones, smartphones, and telephone sets together with their accessories (anti-scratch screen protectors, cases or covers, chargers, and hands-free devices).
Kelompok ini mencakup pertambangan dan p:
This group covers other mining and quarrying not elsewhere classified, including the separation/sorting and other cleaning of such mined or quarried materials, such as the mining and quarrying of mica, leucite, jarosite, zeolite, abrasive stones, natural graphite, steatite (talc), siliceous fossil meal, ochre, and toseki.
This group also covers the extraction of various minerals and materials (such as lithium, uranium, and thorium) from brine, except table salt.
Kelompok ini mencakup pertanian buah jer: This group covers the cultivation of citrus fruit, such as pomelo, lemon, lime, sour lime, Siam tangerine, keprok tangerine, mandarin, tangerine, and clementine. The citrus fruit cultivation referred to covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the cultivation of citrus plants to produce seed in the form of pips.
Kelompok ini mencakup pertanian narkotik: This group covers the cultivation of narcotic plants and prohibited medicinal plants, including land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities.
Kelompok ini mencakup pertanian tanaman: This group covers the cultivation of fibre crops, such as cotton, jute, kenaf, flax stalks, ramie, sisal, abaca, and other textile raw materials of the genus Agave. The fibre crop cultivation referred to covers land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activities carried out as a single sequence of activities. This group also covers the cultivation of fibre crops to produce seed in the form of grain.
Kelompok ini mencakup produksi semua ben: This group covers the production of all plant seedlings other than those covered in groups 01301 and 01302 by vegetative means, including cuttings, slips, and seedlings for the continued propagation of plants or the making of plant graft stock. This group also covers the growing of plants for replanting, the growing of live plants for bulbs, tubers, and roots; cuttings, slips, and layerings; mushroom spawn and plant nurseries, except forest tree nurseries. The raising of chilli seedlings is included in this group.
Kelompok ini mencakup reparasi dan dan p: This group covers the repair and maintenance of photographic and optical equipment in group 268, where mainly used commercially, such as the repair and maintenance of binoculars, microscopes (except electron and proton microscopes), telescopes, prisms and lenses (except ophthalmic), photographic equipment, and the like.
Kelompok ini mencakup reparasi dan pemel: This group covers the repair and maintenance of other transport equipment other than motorcycles and bicycles, such as the repair and maintenance of military vehicles, horse-drawn carriages and carts, and other similar transport equipment.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of machinery and equipment produced in group 271, such as the repair and maintenance of power, distribution, and special transformers, electric motors, generators and motor-generator sets, switchgear and switchboard apparatus, relay apparatus, and industrial controls.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of special-purpose machinery covered in group 282, such as the repair and maintenance of agricultural tractors, agricultural machinery and forestry and logging machinery, metal-cutting and metal-forming machine tools and their accessories, other machine tools, metallurgical machinery, mining machinery, railway and excavating machinery including machinery for oil and gas fields, construction machinery, food and beverage processing machinery, tobacco processing machinery, textile machinery, machinery for making apparel and leather garments, and paper-making machinery.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of general-purpose machinery covered in group 281, such as the repair and maintenance of marine or railway engines, pumps, compressors and related equipment, steam or liquid power engines, valves, gears and steering equipment, furnaces for industrial processes, lifting and handling equipment, office machinery and equipment except computers and their accessories (cash registers, photocopiers, calculators, typewriters), power-driven hand tools, refrigeration and air-purification equipment, weighing scales, and vending machines.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of irradiation, electromedical, and electrotherapeutic equipment in group 267, such as the repair and maintenance of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) equipment, ultrasound medical equipment, pacemakers, hearing aids, electrocardiography equipment, electromedical endoscopy equipment, irradiation equipment, and the like.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of other electrical equipment in groups 273, 274, and 279, such as the repair and maintenance of electric lighting equipment, current-carrying and non-current-carrying wiring devices for electrical circuits, and other similar electrical equipment.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of equipment produced in group 2651, such as the repair and maintenance of aircraft engine instruments, automobile emission testing equipment, meteorological instruments, instruments for the physical, electrical, and chemical testing and inspection of equipment, research or survey instruments, detection instruments, and radiation monitoring equipment and the like.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of aircraft in group 303, including the repair and maintenance of drones, aircraft engines and their equipment. This group does not cover the conversion, inspection, and rebuilding of aircraft and aircraft engines, see group 303.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of metal products in group 252, namely the repair and maintenance of firearms and ordnance/artillery, including the repair of weapons for sporting or recreational use.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of fabricated metal products in group 251, such as the repair and maintenance of structural metal products, tanks, reservoirs, structural metal containers or vessels, steel shipping drums, steam generators or other steam-water generators, auxiliary machinery used in steam generators (condensers, heaters, collectors, and steam accumulators), nuclear reactors except isotope separators, parts of marine engines or power boilers, and working equipment for radiators and central heating, and the like.

This group covers the repair and maintenance of fabricated metal products in group 259, such as the repair and maintenance of cutting tools, hand tools and general implements (commonly used for agriculture, carpentry, and household purposes), non-structural metal containers, wire articles, safes, filing cabinets, and other metal goods, including itinerant (mobile) welding.
This group covers the repair and maintenance of car charging stations, batteries, and accumulators for electric motors and others included in group 272.
Kelompok ini mencakup satuan pendidikan: This group covers Islamic religious education units delivered through the non-formal education pathway, whether tiered or non-tiered. Included in this group are: madrasah diniyah takmiliyah education at the ula, wustha, ulya, and jami'ah levels; Qur'anic education other than that included in group 851, comprising Qur'an Kindergartens (TKQ), Qur'an Education Centres (TPA), Taklimul Qur'an Lil'aulad (TQA), and Qur'an Tahfidz Houses.
This group covers other religious education units besides Islamic religious education, delivered through the non-formal education pathway, whether tiered or non-tiered.

This group covers pesantren (Islamic boarding school) education units delivered through the non-formal education pathway, whether tiered or non-tiered, other than those included in the groups under subgroups 851–854, including also Qur'an Specialization Pesantren (Pesantren Takhassus Al-Qur'an) and Other Specialization Pesantren (Pesantren Takhassus Lainnya).
Kelompok ini mencakup seluruh kegiatan (: This group covers all activities (administrative, operational, and others) arising from community organizations and managed and financed by the community for the purposes of local security and order, for example civil defence organizations, people's resistance organizations, and people's security organizations.

This group covers all activities (administrative, operational, and others), including also civilian personnel within the armed forces and the dispatch of relief for its military members, except members of the armed forces seconded to or holding office in the government, for example government institutions in the field of defence and the Headquarters of the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI).

This group covers all activities (administrative, operational, and others), including also civilian personnel within the army, except members of the army seconded to or holding office in the government, for example the Headquarters of the Indonesian Army (TNI Angkatan Darat).

This group covers all activities (administrative, operational, and others), including also civilian personnel within the air force, except members of the air force seconded to or holding office in the government, for example the Headquarters of the Indonesian Air Force (TNI Angkatan Udara).

This group covers all activities (administrative, operational, and others), including civilian personnel within the navy, except members of the navy seconded to or holding office in the government, for example the Headquarters of the Indonesian Navy (TNI Angkatan Laut).
Kelompok ini mencakup seluruh kegiatan b: This group covers all activities of the judicial bodies responsible for providing legal opinions and rendering decisions in the field of law, for example the Supreme Court, government institutions in the field of law and human rights, the Public Prosecution Service, high courts, district courts, and the Constitutional Court.
Kelompok ini mencakup seluruh kegiatan p: This group covers all police activities (administrative, operational and others) that serve the general public, whether directly or indirectly, in various areas of security and public order, such as handling complaints, criminal matters, maintaining law and order, and investigating criminal offences, including also the activities of the secret police.

This group covers all activities of the governmental process of administration aimed at achieving the objectives of the state as established by the legislative body, namely activities carried out by the President, the Vice President, the Ministry of State Secretariat, the Cabinet Secretariat, the Ministry of Home Affairs, governors, regents, mayors, sub-district heads (camat), and village heads (lurah/kepala desa), who are responsible for planning, leading and overseeing the conduct of government.
Kelompok ini mencakup semua kegiatan pen: This group covers all activities of administering, organising and regulating traditional sports for the purpose of preserving traditional and cultural values, whether individually or in groups, such as pencak silat, stone jumping from Nias, the Sumba pasola, debus, and Minang silek.
Kelompok ini mencakup studi penelitian p: This group covers the study and research of markets regarding awareness, evaluation and use of goods and services, regarding the development and pricing of products, regarding media use, and regarding the recall and impact of advertising. This group also covers scientific market research and opinion polling using qualitative and quantitative methodological guidelines; reactive and non-reactive survey procedures; the collection of research data through interviews, observation, measurement and counting, face-to-face, by post, and by telephone.
This group covers research studies on public opinion regarding quality of life and lifestyle, social participants and political participants, party choice, and voting behaviour.
Kelompok ini mencakup suatu penyediaan j: This group covers the provision of beverage-serving services as the main activity, accompanied by the provision of a place and facilities for dancing to the accompaniment of live music, with light-show attractions as a supplementary service, as well as hostesses.
Kelompok ini mencakup suatu penyediaan t: This group covers the provision of premises and facilities for karaoke as the principal business and may be complemented by the provision of food and beverage services.

This group covers the provision of a venue and facilities for games of skill and/or coin- or card-operated gaming machines as the principal activity, which may be supplemented by the provision of food and beverage services.
Kelompok ini mencakup usaha Penyemprotan: This group covers the business of aerial spraying and dusting using special aircraft under specific conditions.
Kelompok ini mencakup usaha angkutan lau: This group covers the international sea transport business for specialized cargo, namely fish. This is specialized sea transport using Indonesian-flagged vessels whose specifications and requirements are adapted to the type of its principal business activity, serving non-scheduled and irregular routes between ports in Indonesia and ports abroad, including the chartering of foreign-flagged sea transport vessels agented by a non-fishery company, together with their operators.
Kelompok ini mencakup usaha atau kegiata: This group covers the business or activity of catching freshwater crustaceans, such as grago shrimp (Atya spp.), giant freshwater prawn (Macrobrachium rosenbergii), freshwater shrimp (Palaemon spp.), etc., in inland waters such as lakes, rivers, reservoirs, swamps and other standing waters.

This group covers the business or activity of catching crustaceans, including shrimp (tiger prawn, white shrimp, endeavour prawn), lobster, crab, swimming crab and other marine crustaceans in the sea, river estuaries, lagoons and other tidally influenced areas.
This group covers the business or activity of catching and collecting other marine biota such as marine worms and sea snails in the sea, river estuaries, lagoons, and other tidally influenced areas.
This group covers the business or activity of catching coelenterates such as sea anemones, polyps, jellyfish and the like in the sea, river estuaries, lagoons and other tidally influenced areas.
This group covers the business or activity of catching ornamental fish in inland waters such as lakes, rivers, reservoirs, swamps, and other standing waters, such as rainbowfish and botia.
This group covers the business or activity of catching broodstock/fry of eel, arowana and baung catfish in inland waters such as lakes, rivers, reservoirs, swamps, and other standing waters.

This group covers the business or activity of catching freshwater molluscs such as clams (Meretrix spp), snails (Philalanka sp), etc., in inland waters such as lakes, rivers, reservoirs, swamps and other standing waters.

This group covers the business or activity of catching molluscs, including squid, cuttlefish, octopus, and other types such as clams, scallops, blood cockles, green mussels, oysters, and other shellfish in the sea, river estuaries, lagoons and other tidally influenced areas.

This group covers the business or activity of catching freshwater finfish (Pisces), catching species such as climbing perch (betok), snakeskin gourami (sepat), bilih, depik, hampala barb, mahseer (kancera), kendia, lalang, common carp, lukas, repang, lampam (lampan), java barb (tawes), seren, tontong tebu, kissing gourami (tambakan), ikan tempe, archerfish (sumpit), swamp gourami (sepat rawa), berukung, hoven's carp (jelawat), wolf herring (parang), anchovy (teri), bentilak, sheatfish (lais), siamese gourami (sepat siam), marble goby (betutu), giant gourami (gurame), eel (sidat), baung catfish, keting catfish, snakehead (gabus), giant snakehead (toman), walking catfish (lele), hampala (hampal), lalawak, bonylip barb (nilem), semah mahseer, silih, featherback (belida), arowana (siluk/arwana), pangasius (patin), lempuk, mozambique tilapia (mujair), nile tilapia (nila), other finfish, beunteur, grass carp (koan), in inland waters such as lakes, rivers, reservoirs, swamps and other standing waters.

This group covers the business or activity of catching finfish (Pisces) including: skipjack tuna, yellowfin tuna, frigate tuna, kawakawa, other large pelagics, scad, indian mackerel, trevally, bali sardinella, porcupinefish (kembang), other small pelagics, barramundi, red snapper, jacks/trevally (kuwe), sea catfish, sharks, grouper, rays, threadfin bream, pike conger, fringescale sardinella (tembang), siro, rabbitfish, goatfish, narrow-barred spanish mackerel, mullet, halfbeak, other tunas, bigeye tuna, albacore, marlin, swordfish, emperor, ponyfish, reef fish, other demersal fish, in the sea, river estuaries, lagoons and other tidally influenced areas.

This group covers the business or activity of catching/collecting freshwater animals or biota such as frogs, softshell turtles, freshwater turtles, swamp eels, and the like in inland waters such as lakes, rivers, reservoirs, swamps, and other standing waters.

This group covers the business or activity of catching/collecting marine ornamental fish, such as seahorses (hippocampus), angelfish, clownfish, lionfish, sailfin tang, sand pufferfish, batfish, and other ornamental fish in the sea, river estuaries, lagoons, and other tidally influenced areas.

This group covers the business or activity of catching/collecting fish broodstock/fry, shrimp broodstock/fry, shellfish broodstock/fry, crab broodstock/fry, and broodstock/fry of other biota in the sea, river estuaries, lagoons, and other tidally influenced areas.

This group covers the business or activity of catching/collecting echinoderm species such as starfish, sea cucumbers, sea urchins, sea lilies, and the like in the sea, river estuaries, lagoons, and other tidally influenced areas.

This group covers the business or activity of catching/collecting all types of aquatic plants, such as algae, seaweed, marine algae, and ornamental plants in the sea, river estuaries, lagoons and other tidally influenced areas.

This group covers the business or activity of catching/harvesting all types of aquatic plants, such as algae, water hyacinth, moss, and ornamental plants in inland waters such as lakes, rivers, reservoirs, swamps, and other standing waters.

This group covers the business or activity of utilizing Algae and other aquatic biota that are protected and/or CITES Appendix-listed on a limited basis outside their protection provisions and/or whose utilization is restricted in accordance with the provisions of ratified international conventions, living in marine, freshwater, and brackish-water habitats, for research and development, captive breeding, domestic trade, foreign trade, and aquaria, derived from capture activities. This group does not cover the taking of Algae and other aquatic biota species that are fully protected under national regulations, including those listed in CITES Appendix I and/or whose capture/taking is prohibited under Government policy.

This group covers the business or activity of utilizing Amphibians that are protected and/or CITES Appendix-listed on a limited basis outside their protection provisions and/or whose utilization is restricted in accordance with the provisions of ratified international conventions, living in marine, freshwater, and brackish-water habitats, for research and development, captive breeding, domestic trade, foreign trade, and aquaria, derived from captive breeding.

This group covers the business or activity of utilizing Amphibians that are protected and/or CITES Appendix-listed on a limited basis outside their protection provisions and/or whose utilization is restricted in accordance with the provisions of ratified international conventions, living in marine, freshwater, and brackish-water habitats, for research and development, captive breeding, domestic trade, foreign trade, and aquaria, derived from capture activities. Examples of Amphibians included in this group: Amyda cartilaginea (Asiatic softshell turtle) and Orlitia borneensis (Malaysian giant turtle). This group does not cover the taking of Amphibian species that are fully protected under national regulations, including those listed in CITES Appendix I and/or whose capture/taking is prohibited under Government policy.

This group covers the business or activity of utilizing Coelenterates that are protected and/or CITES Appendix-listed on a limited basis outside their protection provisions and/or whose utilization is restricted in accordance with the provisions of ratified international conventions, living in marine, freshwater, and brackish-water habitats, for research and development, captive breeding, domestic trade, foreign trade, and aquaria, derived from capture activities. The list of Coelenterates included in this group may change in line with regulatory changes and/or decisions of the CITES Convention. This group does not cover the taking of Coelenterate species that are fully protected under national regulations, including those listed in CITES Appendix I and/or whose capture/taking is prohibited under Government policy. Example: hard corals of the Order Scleractinia.

This group covers the business or activity of utilizing Coelenterates that are protected and/or CITES Appendix-listed on a limited basis outside their protection provisions and/or whose utilization is restricted in accordance with the provisions of ratified international conventions, living in marine, freshwater, and brackish-water habitats, for research and development, captive breeding, domestic trade, foreign trade, and aquaria, derived from captive breeding. Examples of Coelenterates included in this group: Antipatharia spp, Helioporidae spp, Scleractinia spp, Tubiporidae spp, and Milleporidae spp.

This group covers the business or activity of utilizing Crustaceans that are protected and/or CITES Appendix-listed on a limited basis outside their protection provisions and/or whose utilization is restricted in accordance with the provisions of ratified international conventions, living in marine, freshwater, and brackish-water habitats, for research and development, captive breeding, domestic trade, foreign trade, and aquaria, derived from captive breeding. Examples of Crustaceans included in this group: Tachypleus gigas, Tachypleus tridentatus, and Carcinoscorpius rotundicauda.

This group covers the business or activity of utilizing Echinoderms that are protected and/or CITES Appendix-listed on a limited basis outside their protection provisions and/or whose utilization is restricted in accordance with the provisions of ratified international conventions, living in marine, freshwater, and brackish-water habitats, for research and development, captive breeding, domestic trade, foreign trade, and aquaria, derived from captive breeding. Examples of Echinoderms included in this group: Holothuria fuscogilva, Holothuria nobilis, and Holothuria whitmaei.

This group covers the business or activity of utilizing Echinoderms that are protected and/or CITES Appendix-listed on a limited basis outside their protection provisions and/or whose utilization is restricted in accordance with the provisions of ratified international conventions, living in marine, freshwater, and brackish-water habitats, for research and development, captive breeding, domestic trade, foreign trade, and aquaria, derived from capture activities. This group covers business services related to the preparation of planning and supervision documents for the acquisition of geospatial data (using terrestrial methods, photogrammetric techniques, remote sensing, and hydrography), the processing of aerial photographs and imagery, the design and development of database systems as well as spatial analysis, regional analysis, the presentation of geospatial information, and the management and dissemination of Geospatial Data/Geospatial Information
Kode subklasifikasi: IG002 Kelompok ini: Subclassification code: IG002. This group covers business services related to the acquisition of geospatial data using terrestrial methods, principally expertise in the 3 (three)-dimensional positioning of geodetic control points, the measurement of angles, distances, areas, and height differences within the scope of ground control point surveys, Horizontal Control Network surveys, Vertical Control Network surveys, detailed situation surveys, utility surveys, toponym surveys, boundary demarcation surveys, and gravity surveys
Kode subklasifikasi: IG003 Kelompok ini: Subclassification code: IG003. This group covers business services relating to Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing (Earth Observing and Scanning) to perform: (1) acquisition of airborne-platform geospatial data using photogrammetry, lidar, and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) methods; (2) acquisition of satellite-based remote-sensing geospatial data using optical, lidar, and radar sensors; (3) processing of photogrammetry and remote-sensing data acquisition outputs to produce, among others, orthophotos, Digital Surface Models (DSM), and Digital Terrain Models (DTM) in accordance with the applicable provisions
Kode subklasifikasi: IG004 Kelompok ini: Subclassification code: IG004. This group covers business services relating to the acquisition of hydrographic geospatial data, primarily for tidal observation, coastline measurement, and bathymetric sounding, including the processing of such data
Kode subklasifikasi: IG005 Kelompok ini: Subclassification code: IG005. This group covers business services relating to: (1) Compilation/extraction of data from aerial photographs and remote-sensing imagery to derive geospatial information; (2) Design and development of database systems and spatial analysis; (3) Regional analysis; (4) Presentation of geospatial information; (5) Management and dissemination of Geospatial Data/Geospatial Information
